Result: 1. 模型性能变化可通过所需技能类型预测，但部分问题无响应；2. 不同模型家族从更大骨干中获益相似，但从更多视觉token中获益差异显著；3. 该定律能在可用配置受限的情况下，识别出接近最优可行选择的模型和图像尺寸。

Conclusion: 工作提供了一种原则性的方法，根据任务所需的推理能力，决定模型在高分辨率下应被允许看到的视觉信息量，从而实现高效的计算资源分配。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) face a fixed-budget trade-off between processing more visual information for fine-grained perception and using a larger language backbone for complex reasoning. Existing studies do not tell us which combination of backbone size and input resolution to deploy, especially in high-resolution deployments. To address this gap, we propose the Separable Law that describes how VLM performance changes with language backbone size and visual token count. We fit the law to measurements from 26 InternVL and QwenVL models, with language backbone sizes from 1B to 72B, on four high-resolution benchmarks with image sizes from 224 pixels to 8K. We find that the questions responding to scaling can be predicted from the skill they require, while a substantial fraction never responds at all. We also find that the two model families gain similarly from a larger backbone, while their gains from more visual tokens differ sharply. Combined with a cost law, the Separable Law gives a closed-form rule for allocating compute between backbone size and visual tokens. When deployment is limited to available configurations, the law identifies model and image sizes that perform close to the best feasible choice under the same budget. We hope our work offers a principled way to decide how much a model should be allowed to see at high resolution, given what it must reason about.

</details>


### [115] [DiVid: Diagnosing Dimension-Specific Diversity Collapse in Video Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01661)
*Huanran Hu,Zihui Ren,Dingyi Yang,Zhinan Song,Guozheng Wu,Tiezheng Ge,Qin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiVid框架，将视频生成多样性分解为语义、风格、主体、场景、运动和镜头六个维度进行诊断，揭示模型在运动与镜头控制上的固有缺陷及“默认模式收敛”和“实现差距”两大瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型在相同提示下输出高度相似，且传统评估指标仅依赖全局标量分数，无法定位时空空间中多样性崩溃的具体位置。

Method: 构建DiVid多维诊断框架，通过可复现的计算机视觉管线测量六个维度的多样性，并结合质量与指令忠实度分析潜在权衡；同时通过受控提示干预识别瓶颈。

Result: 发现多样性具有高度维度特异性：即使全局多样性得分高的模型，在运动和镜头维度仍会崩溃；排名在过滤不忠实生成后依然稳健；文本单独控制时变因素（运动/镜头）存在较大的忠实度损失。

Conclusion: DiVid将多样性研究从“是否存在”转向“何处及为何崩溃”，为面向维度的训练目标和控制信号提供了 actionable 方向，并将开源以推动可控视频生成研究。

Abstract: Despite remarkable progress, video generation models often produce highly similar outputs when repeatedly sampled from the same prompt, limiting their usefulness for creative exploration. Existing diversity evaluations primarily rely on global scalar metrics, which obscure where diversity collapses in the spatiotemporal space of videos. We introduce DiVid, a dimension-level diagnostic framework that decomposes video generation diversity into six interpretable dimensions: Semantic, Style, Subject, Scene, Motion, and Camera. Each dimension is measured through a reproducible computer-vision pipeline and analyzed alongside quality and instruction faithfulness to examine potential trade-offs. Systematic evaluation of representative video generation models reveals that diversity is highly dimension-specific: models with strong global diversity scores still collapse on specific factors, particularly Motion and Camera. These rankings persist after filtering unfaithful generations, indicating genuine capability differences rather than off-prompt outputs. Beyond measurement, controlled prompt interventions identify two fundamental bottlenecks: default mode convergence, where models fall back to dominant patterns under open-ended prompts; and realization gaps, where models fail to faithfully realize diverse, explicitly requested alternatives, particularly for temporal factors. The larger faithfulness losses for temporal factors highlight the difficulty of controlling motion and camera variation through text alone. DiVid thus shifts the study of diversity from measuring whether it exists to diagnosing where and why it collapses, and provides actionable directions for dimension-aware training objectives and control signals. The framework will be released to facilitate future research on diverse and controllable video generation.

</details>


### [116] [Do MLLM Judges Judge the Edit? Auditing Bias in Image Editing Evaluation with Verified Quality Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01670)
*Yuan Huang,Zirui Song,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EditJudgeBias基准，通过验证编辑质量保留的对抗性线索，系统审计多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）作为图像编辑评判者的偏见，发现所有受试模型均存在显著偏见，且单一指标无法全面衡量鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MLLMs被广泛用于自动评判图像编辑质量和提供训练奖励信号，但现有方法难以系统审计其是否受到与编辑质量无关的线索干扰。由于视觉干预可能改变被评估的质量本身，因此只有在证实干预保留了底层编辑质量的前提下，才能将判断偏移归因于偏见。

Method: 构建包含1,196个真实编辑样本和13种注入线索的“EditJudgeBias”反事实基准。使用校准的多模态验证器、控制组和人工检查来验证所请求编辑的质量保留情况。在此基础上，从三个互补维度审计五个MLLM评判者：对质量保留线索的不变性、与人类判断的一致性以及成对偏好的稳定性。实验中将观察到的偏移与每个评判者自身的零剂量和重查询噪声基线进行比较，而非绝对零点。

Result: 所有受试评判者在质量保留线索的影响下，其判断偏移均超出了各自的噪声基线。具体表现为：伪造的大多数意见会提高评分；不相关的视觉元素比整图操作引起更大的偏移；交换候选顺序可逆转高达60.9%的成对决策；编辑区域线索倾向于降低与人类判断的一致性。

Conclusion: 质量保留线索会导致MLLM评判者产生显著偏见，且不同评判者在各项指标上表现各异。这表明仅凭单一指标无法全面捕捉评判者的鲁棒性，需要多维度综合评估。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for instruction-based image editing and as reward signals for model training. However, systematically auditing whether these judges are influenced by cues irrelevant to editing quality is challenging because visual interventions may themselves alter the quality being evaluated. A judgment shift can therefore be attributed to bias only when the intervention is verified to preserve the underlying editing quality. To address this challenge, we introduce EditJudgeBias, a counterfactual benchmark with verified quality preservation, comprising 1,196 real editing samples and 13 cues injected across four evaluation sites. We verify quality preservation for the requested edit using calibrated multimodal validators, controls, and human inspection. We then audit five MLLM judges along three complementary dimensions: invariance to quality-preserving cues, agreement with human judgments, and stability of pairwise preferences. Importantly, observed shifts are evaluated against each judge's own zero-dose and re-query noise floors rather than against zero. Experiments show that quality-preserving cues move every judge beyond its own noise. Fabricated majority opinions increase ratings, irrelevant visual elements cause larger shifts than whole-image manipulations, and swapping candidate order reverses up to 60.9% of pairwise decisions. Edit-region cues also tend to reduce human agreement. The three measures characterize judges differently, showing that robustness cannot be captured by a single metric.

</details>


### [117] [When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01681)
*Lidia Troeshestova,Alexander Ustyuzhanin,Sergey Kastryulin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“任务切换”策略，让统一编辑模型在去噪过程中动态切换到文生图（T2I）模式，以平衡编辑质量与图像保留度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的统一编辑模型在去噪过程中始终依赖源图像条件，但纯编辑模式下源注意力在某些编辑任务中会随采样轨迹下降，未能充分利用模型的T2I生成能力。

Method: 研究条件效应在不同编辑类型和去噪阶段的变化，提出“任务切换”机制：在受控的时间间隔内，将模型从纯编辑模式切换至T2I生成模式，利用其生成的先验知识辅助编辑。

Result: 在三个统一编辑器和四个基准测试上验证，该策略显著提升了编辑质量，同时保持了与纯编辑相近的感知保留率（perceptual preservation）。

Conclusion: 统一编辑器应结合使用其训练所得的两种条件模式；通过调整切换时机，可以在编辑质量和内容保留之间实现最佳平衡。

Abstract: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.

</details>


### [118] [Architectural Sampling: Test-Time Scaling via Computational Diversity in Frozen Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01687)
*Akshit Singh,Shyam Marjit,Wei Lin,Leonid Karlinsky,M. Jehanzeb Mirza*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出“架构采样”（Architectural Sampling），一种无需训练的方法，通过复用解码器层块生成具有计算多样性的候选答案，显著提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统温度采样在固定计算路径上生成所有候选项，缺乏计算多样性，限制了测试时扩展的效果。

Method: 在不更新权重或添加辅助参数的情况下，通过重用选定的解码器层块并改变其位置和重复次数，引导模型进行不同的前向计算以生成候选项。

Result: 在五个Qwen检查点和十二个多模态基准测试中，相比标准路径温度采样，在相同的9个候选预算下，平均pass@9提升了6.58个百分点；早期层复用效果最佳，且即使在贪婪解码下也能保持候选覆盖率的提升。

Conclusion: 架构采样不仅提高了候选覆盖率，还降低了词汇重叠度，作为无标签测试时强化学习的 rollout 数据时能提升准确性，证明了从模型自身输出中进行更有效学习的可能性。

Abstract: Test-time scaling often seeks better answers by sampling multiple responses from a frozen model, yet conventional temperature sampling generates every candidate along the same fixed computation path. We introduce architectural sampling, a training-free method that generates candidates through distinct forward computations by reusing selected blocks of decoder layers. Varying the block location and repetition count introduces computational diversity without updating model weights or adding auxiliary parameters. Across five Qwen checkpoints and twelve multimodal benchmarks, architectural sampling improves pass@9 over standard-path temperature sampling by 6.58 percentage points on average at the same nine-candidate budget. Reusing early layers yields the strongest gains, and the improvement in candidate coverage persists even under greedy decoding. The resulting candidates show lower lexical overlap and improve accuracy when used as rollouts for label-free test-time reinforcement learning. These findings extend the benefits of our architectural sampling beyond candidate coverage, demonstrating more effective learning from a model's own outputs.

</details>


### [119] [MEGA: Object-Level Mesh Extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting via Spatial Visual Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01707)
*Liwei Liao,Yingkui Zhang,Qianqian Tong,Ronggang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MEGA框架，通过“先分割后网格”策略，从3D高斯溅射中提取物体级、水密的网格，解决现有方法仅关注场景级且表面不封闭的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS网格提取方法主要聚焦于场景级，无法表示物体级占用率，且常产生非水密表面，限制了精确几何结构获取和复杂物理交互应用。

Method: 提出MEGA（Mesh Extraction from Gaussians）框架，核心包括空间视觉蒸馏（SVD）和掩码引导的神经表面重建模块。SVD将3DGS作为教师模型，对分割后的每个物体采样多样相机姿态并渲染视图，利用光度监督训练网格重建模型。

Result: 在多个基准测试上达到最先进性能，成功恢复准确的物体级3D占用率；结合高质量物体级网格与3DGS渲染，支持复杂的物理交互。

Conclusion: MEGA有效实现了从3DGS到物体级水密网格的转换，提升了几何精度并增强了应用场景的灵活性。

Abstract: Mesh extraction from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to endow 3D Gaussians with accurate geometric structures, enabling explicit and precise 3D occupancy. However, existing methods primarily focus on scene-level mesh extraction, making them unable to represent object-level occupancy and often resulting in non-watertight surfaces. To overcome these limitations, we propose \textbf{MEGA} (\underline{M}esh \underline{E}xtraction from \underline{GA}ussians), a ``segment-then-mesh'' framework for extracting object-level, watertight meshes from complex 3DGS scenes. At the core of MEGA are \textbf{Spatial Visual Distillation (SVD)} and a mask-guided neural surface reconstruction module. SVD treats the 3DGS model as a teacher, sampling diverse camera poses and rendering the corresponding views of each segmented object. These observations are then used to train a mesh reconstruction model through photometric supervision. Extensive experiments on several widely used benchmarks demonstrate that MEGA achieves state-of-the-art performance in recovering accurate object-level 3D occupancy. Moreover, MEGA enables complex physical interactions by combining high-quality object-level meshes for geometric occupancy with 3DGS representations for photorealistic rendering.

</details>


### [120] [Rethinking Memorization Mitigation in Diffusion Models: Reinforcing Text Conditioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01723)
*Hyungjun Joo,Sehwan Kim,Hyeonggeun Han,Sangwoo Hong,Jungwoo Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的扩散模型去记忆化方法，通过高斯平滑重新分配交叉注意力并调整内容/填充token贡献，在保持提示对齐的同时减少训练图像的重现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型虽然合成效果显著，但存在严重过拟合风险，即通过紧密复现单个训练样本来“记忆”数据。现有的缓解方法往往难以在去除记忆内容的同时保留有用的提示信息以引导生成替代图像。

Method: 引入一种无需额外去噪器评估的无训练方法：1. 在强化内容token贡献之前，使用高斯平滑重新分配交叉注意力；2. 衰减填充（padding）token的贡献；3. 通过增强内容条件来改善提示对齐度。该方法涉及局部分析以确定何时保留共享价值信息以及何时减少局部注意力质量。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion v1.4和v2.0上验证，所有评估的平滑宽度均位于训练图像相似度与提示对齐度及图像偏好之间的实证Pareto前沿上。在DeepFloyd IF模型中，基于Stable Diffusion选择的配置能有效降低模板重现，且无需进一步微调。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持通过联合控制条件分配（conditioning allocation）和强度，来生成既符合提示又避免过度复现训练数据的替代图像。

Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable progress in image synthesis, yet can exhibit memorization by closely reproducing individual training examples. Effective mitigation must preserve useful prompt information to guide alternative depictions. We introduce a training-free method that redistributes cross-attention with Gaussian smoothing before reinforcing content-token contributions and attenuating padding contributions, without additional denoiser evaluations. With this intervention, stronger content conditioning can improve prompt alignment at comparable training-image similarity. A local analysis identifies when reinforcement preserves shared value information while redistribution reduces localized attention mass. On Stable Diffusion v1.4 and v2.0, all evaluated smoothing widths lie on the empirical Pareto frontiers for training-image similarity versus both prompt alignment and image preference. A configuration selected on Stable Diffusion reduces template reproduction in DeepFloyd IF without further tuning. These findings support jointly controlling conditioning allocation and strength to generate prompt-consistent alternatives.

</details>


### [121] [ATI-VLA: Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action Models via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01741)
*Yijie Zhu,Rui Shao,Jie He,Wei Li,Bo Zhao,Yelin Wang,Xiaochen Yuan,Tao Tan,Miao Zhang,Xiaojiang Peng,Zitong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ATI-VLA框架，通过“动作对齐+自适应注入”解决VLA模型中的模态错位和联合优化冲突，实现以动作为中心的预测性视觉-语言-动作学习，在仿真和真实机器人任务中达到SOTA性能并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预测性VLA模型因观察与动作间的模态错位（modality misalignment）及联合优化冲突，导致无法充分发挥未来观测或世界动态预测的潜力，甚至表现不如直接动作预测模型。

Method: 提出ATI-VLA（Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action），包含两步设计：1) 动作表示对齐：通过共享码表（Shared Codebook）将预测观测和动作映射到统一的离散潜在空间，缓解模态错位；2) 动作中心自适应注入：通过轻量级自适应旁路，将预测观测潜在变量作为显式先验注入动作解码过程，在单一动作中心目标下提供自适应预测引导。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界机器人任务的广泛实验中，ATI-VLA实现了最先进的（SOTA）性能，并具有更快的收敛速度。

Conclusion: ATI-VLA通过动作-centric的设计有效解决了预测性VLA模型的局限性，证明了结合模态对齐与自适应预测注入能显著提升机器人操控性能。

Abstract: Predictive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to improve robotic manipulation via future observation or world dynamics forecasting. However, existing approaches often fail to realize this potential and underperform direct action prediction models. We argue that these limitations stem from modality misalignment between observations and actions, together with joint optimization conflicts that drive learning away from an action-centric objective. To this end, we introduce ATI-VLA, an Action-Centric Predictive Vision-Language-Action framework via Actionable Alignment Then Adaptive Injection. Specifically, it follows a two-step design: 1) Actionable Representation Alignment via a Shared Codebook. It aligns predictive observation and action representations by mapping both modalities into a shared discrete latent space via a unified codebook, making predictive observation latents readily usable for action generation and mitigating modality misalignment. 2) Action-Centric Adaptive Injection of Predictive Latents. Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

</details>


### [122] [3DROID: A Renderable 3D Gaussian Dataset with Measured Per-Scene Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01744)
*Wonguen Cho,Junhoo Lee,Nojun Kwak*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对3DGS在机器人操作中因相机外参不可靠导致度量尺度丢失的问题，提出一种校准感知流水线，通过姿态条件化将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间，并发布了包含场景级可靠性信息的3DROID数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器人操作模型主要基于2D观测进行3D物理世界的推理。虽然引入了深度、点云等几何先验及可渲染的3D高斯（3DGS）表示作为3D监督信号，但3DGS设计初衷侧重于光度保真度，当输入的相机外参不可靠时，往往无法保留真实世界的度量尺度，导致几何信息失真。

Method: 研究外参可靠性及姿态条件化对前馈3DGS的影响，提出一种校准感知流水线（calibration-aware pipeline）。该方法通过将重建场景锚定到机器人的度量工作空间，利用姿态条件化来增强几何一致性，从而解决外参不可靠带来的尺度问题。

Result: 实验表明，姿态条件化能提升新视角的重建保真度，但其几何增益取决于注入外参的可靠性。基于此流水线，构建了一个可渲染、具有度量-姿态锚定的数据集，并提供了场景级的可靠性信息。

Conclusion: 该研究解决了3DGS在机器人应用中因外参误差导致的度量尺度缺失问题，提出的校准感知流水线有效提升了重建的几何准确性，并为机器人操作研究提供了高质量的3DROID数据集。

Abstract: Robot manipulation models primarily reason from 2D observations while acting in the 3D physical world. To bridge this gap, recent work has augmented robot data with geometric priors such as depth, point clouds, and 3D trajectories, while renderable 3D Gaussian representations provide another promising form of 3D supervision. However, 3DGS representation is designed mainly for photometric fidelity and may not preserve real-world metric scale, particularly when the supplied camera extrinsics are unreliable. We study the effect of extrinsic reliability and pose conditioning on feed-forward 3DGS, and propose a calibration-aware pipeline that anchors reconstructed scenes to the robot's metric workspace. Our experiments show that pose conditioning improves novel-view fidelity, while its geometric benefit depends on the reliability of the injected extrinsics. Using this pipeline, we present a renderable, metric-pose-anchored dataset with scene-level reliability information for robot manipulation research. Our dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/wonguen/3DROID

</details>


### [123] [FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01750)
*Haoxin Wu,Xiaokai Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FFBL-Coop框架，通过“先融合后绑定”策略分离实例接入与身份管理，解决协同3D跟踪中的跨视图差异和空间对齐误差问题，在V2X-Seq和Griffin-25M数据集上取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同3D跟踪需整合多智能体互补观测并维持身份一致性。现有方法若将证据集成与身份继承耦合于同一匹配决策中，易受跨视图外观差异和空间错位影响，导致特征融合失败和轨迹中断。

Method: 提出FFBL-Coop（Fuse First, Bind Later）框架：1) 置信度排序槽位接入（CSA）基于置信度和空间邻近度分配查询；2) 统一表示聚合（URA）利用语义特征和对齐锚点引导特征检索，通过共享Transformer解码器细化查询库；3) 合作优先身份锚定（CPIA）结合学习关联与持久映射建立跨帧身份分配；4) 使用共享码本减少传输负载。

Result: 在V2X-Seq数据集上AMOTA/AP达到0.611/0.548，在Griffin-25M数据集上达到0.688/0.653，且压缩变体的性能接近未压缩版本。

Conclusion: FFBL-Coop通过解耦融合与绑定流程，有效提升了协同3D跟踪的准确性和鲁棒性，同时兼顾通信效率。

Abstract: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.

</details>


### [124] [Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01754)
*Mohd Ubaid Wani,Sara Atito,Josef Kittler,Muhammad Awais*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Cog-VADU框架，通过链式异常检测思维提示（CoADTP）将视频异常检测重构为序列认知推理任务，利用LVLM实现零样本、无需训练的鲁棒检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖数据集训练和标注，泛化能力受限；现有的零样本大视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）缺乏时间连续性和结构化推理能力。

Method: 1. 提出Cog-VADU全训练无框架；2. 引入CoADTP，将LVLM展开为跨视频片段的循环推理链，保持隐式时间记忆；3. 设计跨模态重排序阶段，对齐文本理由与视觉嵌入以增强语义一致性和时间连贯性。

Result: 在多个公开VAD基准测试中实现具有竞争力的零样本性能；CoADTP能以模型无关的方式 consistently 提升基于推理的异常检测效果。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了可解释且通用的异常理解，适用于现实世界应用，解决了开放场景下泛化和时间推理的难题。

Abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.

</details>


### [125] [GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01758)
*Jian Liu,Wei Sun,Zhenqi Dai,Hui Yang,Jian Xiao,Nicu Sebe,Na Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种仅依赖合成数据训练的类别级物体位姿估计（COPE）框架，通过2D/3D语义一致性约束和端到端跨模态融合，解决合成到现实（Syn2Real）的域差异问题，实现轻量级、高精度的泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有COPE方法需为新品类重新收集真实世界训练数据，成本高且扩展性差；旨在实现仅用合成数据训练即可直接部署于真实场景的通用模型。

Method: 1. 引入2D和3D语义一致性约束，减少特征编码器对域特定特征的敏感度，学习域不变表示；2. 构建端到端位姿回归框架，利用密集跨模态融合进行2D-3D交叉一致性学习；3. 仅使用全局特征，设计轻量高效架构。

Result: 在REAL275和Wild6D基准测试及真实机器人操作场景中，展现出优越的合成到现实（Syn2Real）泛化性能。

Conclusion: 该范式有效解决了合成与真实数据间的纹理域差异，实现了无需真实标注数据的零样本/少样本部署，具有实际机器人应用价值。

Abstract: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

</details>


### [126] [PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01759)
*Zhenyu Liang,Yining Huang,Yubo Zhao,Jack C. P. Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDEM是一种物理定义的扩散框架，通过结合偏微分方程（PDE）残差和稀疏观测数据，在无需完整数据集的情况下实现时空物理场的高效生成与推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据驱动的扩散模型依赖完整的场数据集，但在仅有稀疏观测的情况下，无法充分表征完整场的分布，导致生成和预测时空物理场面临挑战。

Method: 1. 构建Gibbs目标：利用PDE残差能量对测量条件的高斯参考进行重加权；2. 推导精确的条件均值恒等式：将去噪过程简化为标准化的能量诱导均值校正的监督学习；3. 引入物理位移概率流：消除高斯参考项，支持通过高斯条件进行摊销采样，且无需重新训练即可适应变化的测量值。

Result: 在合成PDE系统和真实世界应用中，PhysDEM实现了连贯的场恢复和高效采样，并在测试噪声水平下保持稳定的诊断性能。

Conclusion: PhysDEM是首个无需预组装完整场数据集即可实现摊销时空场推断的物理定义扩散模型，展示了其在场评估中的实用价值。

Abstract: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.

</details>


### [127] [OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01762)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Yuandong Yang,Zhiqiu Zhang,Yuhan Zhu,Xinhao Li,Qingyi Si,Dingyu Yao,Changlian Ma,Haoran Chen,Xinyu Chen,Yansong Shi,Junhao Zhou,Yifei Li,Jun Zhang,Chuanyu Qin,Chenxu Yang,Xinlei Yu,Kun Ouyang,Yuchen Shao,Qianshan Wei,Changhai Zhou,Jun Gao,Jiaqi Wang,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出OneStreamer，通过主动生成过程联合学习证据记录和任务响应，解决流式视频LLM中实时感知与事实记忆保留的矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频大语言模型需在证据相关性未知前保留证据，并在证据充足时响应；挑战在于形成可复用的事实记忆而不损害实时感知能力。

Method: 引入主动分层标题记忆（PHCM）生成时间锚定的局部细节和摘要；采用主动状态转换学习（PSTL）减少等待状态主导；开发流式数据合成管道构建OneStreamer-1M数据集。

Result: 4B模型在八个流式视频理解基准测试中取得最佳结果；消融实验表明保留生成的标题在不降低实时感知的前提下提升了历史问答性能；PSTL仅监督27.5%的状态标记即优于密集状态监督。

Conclusion: 主动生成作为连接感知、记忆形成和及时响应的共享学习接口，有效解决了流式视频交互中的关键挑战。

Abstract: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.

</details>


### [128] [GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01778)
*Baoke Dou,Ziye Wang,Hao Wang,Guoqing Cai,Wende Tan,Chenyang Si,Liucheng Guo,Yueming Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GIFTBench基准，包含11.5万张图像，用于评估和训练图像篡改定位模型，解决现有基准分布单一问题；同时开发ForenScope框架提升跨域性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像篡改定位（IFL）基准覆盖的篡改条件有限或在跨数据集评估中混淆多个因素，导致聚合性能无法完整反映模型的泛化能力。

Method: 1. 构建GIFTBench：涵盖篡改源、语义目标、编辑操作和组成复杂度四个轴度的多轴基准，支持特定轴向迁移分析和外部数据集评估。2. 利用其大规模多样性数据训练定位器。3. 基于诊断结果开发ForenScope框架，结合分类适应表示、多层深度/尺度空间特征、分层融合及选择性粗尺度条件。

Result: 诊断发现存在不对称跨源迁移、召回主导失败及异构退化现象；在GIFTBench上训练的模型显著提升了对外部数据集的迁移能力；ForenScope框架在保持图像级检测能力的同时改善了跨数据集的定位性能。

Conclusion: GIFTBench不仅作为评估工具揭示了现有模型的局限性，还作为有效的训练资源提升了跨域定位性能；ForenScope框架验证了所提方法的有效性。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.

</details>


### [129] [VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01785)
*Gueter Josmy Faure,Hao Ping Wang,Min-Hung Chen,Winston H. Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VETO是一种针对视觉-语言模型(VLMs)长视频处理的即插即用插件，通过空间和时间双重轴压缩解决视觉Token二次方计算成本瓶颈，实现最高45%推理加速且保持或提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLMs处理长视频时受限于视觉Token的二次方计算成本，导致长序列推理代价高昂；单一轴（仅空间或仅时间）压缩方法因独立处理时空冗余，存在效率上限。

Method: 提出VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization)，采用分层排序的双轴压缩策略：(1) 帧内压缩器利用最优传输启发式匹配合并语义相似Token；(2) 帧间压缩器识别并合并时间冗余帧。先进行空间压缩以降低后续全局时间匹配的开销。

Result: 在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上推理速度提升高达45%，精度保持不变或提升。在极端Token稀缺（10%预算）下，准确率达55.7%，优于VFlowOpt、VisionZip和FastV。在LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5和LongVA上均表现出零样本精度的保持或提升，具有通用性。

Conclusion: VETO通过双轴压缩有效突破了单轴压缩的效率瓶颈，显著降低长视频推理成本，同时保持高精度，适用于多种主流VLM架构。

Abstract: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage that grows with modern fully-fused attention infrastructure. Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.

</details>


### [130] [Continuous Conditioning of VLAs with Augmenting EMG and Visual Task Descriptors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01794)
*Edward W. Staley,Connor O. Pyles,Rahul Hingorani,Frank Camargo,Griffin Milsap,Jared Markowitz,Matthew S. Fifer,Michael Wolmetz*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EC-VLA和VA-VLA两种模型，通过引入肌电和视觉分割标注作为任务条件，在杂乱场景中显著优于纯语言提示的基线，证明多模态任务条件的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型过度依赖语言描述任务信息，假设状态空间中的其他模态（如肌电、视觉标注）可作为补充任务条件，尤其在杂乱或模糊场景中具有潜力。

Method: 1. EC-VLA：将8通道肌电包络作为连续条件输入拼接至本体感觉向量；2. VA-VLA：将视觉分割标注融入图像输入。在立方体选择任务中对三名参与者进行评估。

Result: 在无序、分布内条件下，两者与语言基线持平；但在杂乱、分布外场景中，EC-VLA大幅超越基线，VA-VLA亦有显著提升。

Conclusion: 实验结果有力证明了在语言之外利用其他模态进行任务条件设定的潜在优势，特别是在复杂场景下。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely strongly on language for describing task information, despite having multimodal inputs. We hypothesize that other modalities in the state space may present opportunities for supplemental task conditioning, which may be particularly relevant in cluttered or otherwise ambiguous scenes. We introduce two tuned models to test this hypothesis: (1) an electrophysiology-conditioned VLA (EC-VLA) that incorporates 8-channel electromyography envelopes as continuous conditioning input concatenated to the proprioceptive vector, and (2) a visually-annotated VLA (VA-VLA) that incorporates visual segmentation annotations to the image inputs. On a cube-selection task evaluated across three participants, EC-VLA matches a language-prompted baseline in uncluttered, in-distribution conditions and substantially outperforms it in cluttered, out-of-distribution scenes. Similarly, VA-VLA shows modest improvements over a language-prompted baseline in in-distribution scenes with substantial improvement in cluttered, out-of-distribution trials. Together, these results provide strong evidence for the potential benefit of task-conditioning beyond language.

</details>


### [131] [PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01807)
*Ahmed Sharshar,Asif Hanif,Naveen Kumar Kummari,Mohammad Yaqub,Mohsen Guizan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PhaseAT框架，通过在傅里叶域中对相位进行对抗性扰动，解决医学图像领域泛化中的分布偏移问题，显著提升单源和多源DG性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有领域泛化（DG）方法多关注风格或强度多样化，但网络仍可能依赖域特定的纹理相关性；且深度医学模型在跨扫描仪、站点和采集协议时面临分布偏移挑战。

Method: 引入PhaseAT框架：1) 在傅里叶域中迭代更新有界相位扰动（保持幅度谱不变），仅作用于YCbCr空间的亮度通道以避免色彩伪影；2) 使用相位显著性掩码聚焦关键频率；3) 结合干净样本与相位扰动样本的加权损失进行训练，支持单源和多源DG。

Result: 在两个具有挑战性的医学数据集上验证，PhaseAT在单源领域泛化任务中实现超过20%的性能提升，优于多种最先进（SOTA）的DG方法。

Conclusion: 通过强调匹配外观统计下的空间组织结构，PhaseAT能有效减轻对域特定纹理的依赖，提高医学图像模型的可靠部署能力。

Abstract: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.

</details>


### [132] [LiteReality-Agent: An Agentic System for Interactable 3D Indoor Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01863)
*Zhening Huang,Yueyan Li,Johnathan Chiu,Xiaoyang Lyu,Matt Zhou,Yuxin Yao,Joan Lasenby,Shangzhe Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiteReality-Agent是一个将3D重建转化为编码问题的智能体系统，通过迭代编辑Python脚本生成高保真、可仿真的室内3D场景，其精度和实用性优于Astra和Fable等前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决从RGB-D扫描重建真实室内环境时，如何获得既逼真又具备关节结构、且可直接用于仿真和具身AI任务的3D数字孪生的问题。

Method: 提出“观察-编辑-验证”框架：核心智能体利用专用工具收集证据，迭代修改Python脚本（Room.py）以执行生成3D场景；该过程包含测量、布局优化和质量控制环节。

Result: 生成的重建结果在几何准确性、视觉真实感和仿真兼容性上均优于Astra和Fable等最新前沿模型；该系统为未来智能体提供了强大的编排框架，提升了重建质量和可靠性。

Conclusion: LiteReality-Agent是构建稳健的“现实到仿真”（real-to-sim）系统的实用且重要的基础模块，其代码和数据采集应用已公开。

Abstract: We present LiteReality-Agent, an agentic system for reconstructing real indoor environments as realistic, articulated, and simulation-ready 3D scenes from RGB-D scans. At its core, LiteReality-Agent formulates 3D reconstruction as a coding problem, in which a coding agent gathers evidence using specialised tools and iteratively edits a Python script, Room.py, which can be executed to produce a 3D digital twin of the room. With this formulation, we develop a robust observe-edit-verify harness that supports evidence gathering, measurement, verification, layout optimisation, simulation readiness, and quality control throughout the reconstruction process. LiteReality-Agent produces high-quality reconstructions suitable for simulation and downstream embodied AI tasks. Furthermore, as agent capabilities continue to improve rapidly, the system introduced by LiteReality-Agent remains a strong orchestration framework for future agents: it equips them with specialised tools, structured workflows, and robust verification mechanisms that substantially improve reconstruction quality and reliability. We demonstrate that LiteReality-Agent produces reconstructions that are more geometrically accurate, visually realistic, and simulation-compatible than those generated by recent frontier models, such as Astra and Fable. We therefore view LiteReality-Agent as a practical and important building block for robust real-to-sim systems. Both the source code and the data-capture application are publicly available. Code:https://github.com/LiteReality/LiteReality-Agent/

</details>


### [133] [From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01870)
*Hosam Elgendy,Utkarsh Mall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VIDA-Geo多智能体系统，通过结合黑盒指标模型和生成编辑模型，自动发现并生成能改善城市环境指标（如安全性、绿化）的干预措施，为城市规划提供高效、低成本的数字化测试方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有地理空间视觉方法主要侧重于从航拍和街景图像中监测城市指标，而非提出干预措施并评估其效果；且传统评估方式成本高、耗时长，缺乏对潜在干预效果的直观预测能力。

Method: 构建VIDA-Geo多智能体系统，协调分割模型、基于扩散的去卷积修补（inpainting）模型和指标评分模型。利用黑盒指标模型作为隐式数字孪生，探索干预空间，生成既具感知真实性又符合现实政策的图像修改方案。

Result: 在8个城市指标（涵盖航拍和街景图像）上进行了评估，重点测量感知安全性和绿化等因素的变化。该方法在许多情况下优于现有基线，实现了高达2倍的感知质量和政策对齐得分提升。

Conclusion: VIDA-Geo成功实现了从被动识别到主动干预发现的转变，为城市规划师提供了多种候选干预方案，支持“专家在环”的工作流程，有效提升了城市环境优化的效率和科学性。

Abstract: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.

</details>


### [134] [EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01876)
*Tongyu Wu,Jacob Edwards,Ziteng Cui,Caigui Jiang,Cheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EvenSplat框架，解决3D高斯溅射中光照伪影与场景几何/颜色纠缠的问题，通过分离二维图像空间光照分解与三维高斯光照场，实现复杂光照下的高质量重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多视图重建方法（如3D Gaussian Splatting）将光照伪影错误地视为场景属性，导致捕获特定的光照条件与恢复的几何及颜色信息纠缠，特别是在不均匀光照、视角间曝光变化及局部强光源情况下表现不佳。

Method: 构建EvenSplat框架，耦合图像空间的光照分解与携带于高斯点上的三维光照场，使二维和三维场景对光照的解释保持一致；引入相机响应网络和本地曝光补偿模块，以吸收训练图像间剩余的全局和残差差异。

Result: 在多个数据集及真实世界采集与模拟基准上进行了广泛实验，涵盖跨视角曝光、空间光照变化和强光对比度等多种不均匀光照形式，结果表明EvenSplat通常优于最先进方法，尤其在强光对比度条件下表现显著。

Conclusion: EvenSplat成功解耦了光照伪影与场景几何/颜色，通过联合优化二维和三维光照表示，有效提升了复杂光照环境下多视图重建的性能和鲁棒性。

Abstract: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.

</details>


### [135] [Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01884)
*Cusuh Ham,Fabian Caba Heilbron,Josef Sivic,Bryan Russell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MemComposer是一种基于视频集合的B-roll序列生成系统，通过构建实体中心记忆、规划检索和迭代生成三个阶段，实现符合用户指令且保持视觉一致性的多镜头序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从用户的大量原始视频素材中选择合适的视觉证据，以生成补充主 footage（A-roll）的B-roll序列，同时保留原素材中的人物、场景、物体和风格特征，解决从长视频中选取有效视觉信息并保持一致性的挑战。

Method: 提出三阶段系统MemComposer：1. 离线阶段将原始视频转化为包含人物、场景、物体和风格的实体中心记忆；2. 利用记忆和用户指令规划序列并检索每镜头的条件帧；3. 迭代生成和批评序列以确保身份、场景和整体一致性。

Result: 在用户偏好研究中，相比无接地文本到视频规划器，MemComposer在提示遵循度上胜率为60.0%，在视觉对齐上胜率为92.8%；相比仅检索组装的序列，在提示遵循度上胜率为94.5%，但在视觉对齐上仅胜率为41.8%（即检索序列在视觉对齐上更受青睐）。

Conclusion: 集合记忆和参考检索显著提升了提示遵循度和视觉对齐效果，生成缺失镜头的价值得到验证，但纯检索序列在视觉保真度方面仍有优势，表明生成与检索结合仍有优化空间。

Abstract: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.

</details>


### [136] [Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01890)
*Victor Enescu,Assaad Zeghina,Matthieu Meignin,Nicolas Viltard,Cécile Mallet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于流匹配模型的非监督域适应方法，解决卫星辐射计图像因缺乏标注数据导致的领域偏移问题，通过条件化ODE实现精确域对齐，在GPM-Core星座数据上显著提升了降雨降水估计精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成网络在图像编辑中表现优异，但严重依赖大规模标注数据集。对于卫星仪器而言，获取标注数据极其困难，且常面临领域偏移问题，限制了模型的有效性。

Method: 利用流匹配模型（Flow Matching Models）中的确定性常微分方程（ODE），构建了一种非监督域适应方法。该方法以不同的卫星仪器为条件，通过对变换的双射特性保持信息完整性，实现不同领域间的精确对齐。

Result: 在GPM-Core星座上的广泛实验表明，该条件域适应方法有效改善了从辐射计图像中进行降雨降水估计的性能，证明了其在处理无标注卫星数据方面的优势。

Conclusion: 该方法成功解决了卫星影像中因缺乏标注数据而面临的领域适应难题，通过流匹配模型的数学特性实现了信息的无损迁移与领域对齐，为遥感图像处理提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.

</details>


### [137] [MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01905)
*Shen Zheng,Anurag Ghosh,Mani Ramanagopal,Srinivasa Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MapLightning，用紧凑的1D可学习地图token替代密集BEV网格，实现高效、高精度且对相机外参扰动鲁棒的在线矢量高精地图构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖密集BEV网格作为中间表示，存在计算冗余、内存占用高及对相机外参敏感等问题，难以满足安全自动驾驶对实时性和准确性的要求。

Method: 采用自注意力机制联合交互图像与地图token，通过Transformer Mapper聚合上下文后丢弃图像token，仅保留更新后的地图token用于解码；避免使用相机投影参数，提升鲁棒性。

Result: 在nuScenes和Argoverse 2上达到SOTA精度与效率；轻量版较MapTRv2分别提升10.1和16.2 mAP，推理速度提升1.73倍（40+ FPS），内存减少53%；同时改善不确定性感知建图与下游轨迹预测性能。

Conclusion: MapLightington通过稀疏token表示和自注意力设计，显著提升了高精地图构建的效率、准确性和鲁棒性，为自动驾驶提供了更优的解决方案。

Abstract: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [138] [DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01914)
*Junfeng Ni,Zirui Zhou,Yixin Chen,Yu Liu,Nan Jiang,Zhifei Yang,Song-Chun Zhu,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DecomVoxel框架，通过引导原位去噪优化解决重遮挡下分解式场景重建的质量问题，结合3D原生先验与神经场景重建，显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分解式场景重建在严重遮挡下质量不佳；2D图像先验存在多视图不一致性（缺乏3D感知），而3D原生先验虽结构性强但易导致复杂场景中的空间漂移和对齐错误。

Method: 提出DecomVoxel，将物体补全建模为引导的原位去噪优化过程。引入重构的基于epsilon的蒸馏损失以确保潜在层稳定细化，并使用自适应空间引导（利用占用/空闲锚点及时间退火）来抑制生成幻觉并缓解空间漂移。

Result: 在Replica和ScanNet++数据集上，DecomVoxel显著优于最先进方法，忠实保留了原始空间布局、结构保真度和风格一致的纹理，生成了具有干净拓扑、几何和外观的高质量纹理网格。

Conclusion: 该方法突破了分解式重建的边界，为复杂真实世界场景提供了鲁棒的解决方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.

</details>


### [139] [MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01917)
*Yingcheng Liu,Tianyi Jiang,Yujuan Ding,jiangbo Ai,Xun Jiang,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MoLE（混合潜在专家）框架，通过让不同的潜在视觉专家提取互补的视觉信息来解决现有方法中表征冗余的问题，在五个基准测试中显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在推理方法允许多个潜在令牌通过共享值投影访问相同的视觉证据，缺乏提取互补视觉信息的机制，导致增加潜在预算时产生冗余的潜在表征。

Method: 提出MoLE框架，隔离潜在视觉专家以控制其观察和转换视觉证据的方式，并使用专用的潜在摘要专家聚合互补表征。采用两阶段训练管道：先强制视觉证据通过潜在路径，再恢复直接视觉访问，无需预定义专家角色或中间视觉目标。

Result: 在五个视觉推理基准测试中平均得分为78.6，比数据匹配的监督微调高出4.9分，比同等潜在预算下最强的基线高出3.6分。表征分析显示潜在状态相似性降低且视觉注意力更多样化；屏蔽潜在路径导致平均性能下降9.2%。

Conclusion: 专业化潜在计算比单纯增加潜在令牌数量更有效，证明了让潜在令牌作为专门视觉专家提取互补信息的有效性。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.

</details>


### [140] [CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01927)
*Moyang Li,Zihan Zhu,Wei Zhang,Marc Pollefeys,Daniel Barath*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于流式重建基础模型的闭环方法，通过全局描述符检索和SE(3)流形优化，解决长序列重建中的累积漂移问题，实现公里级无漂移高精度重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的前馈基础模型在长上下文流式3D重建中存在因误差累积导致的大幅度跟踪漂移问题，缺乏公里级尺度下的准确性与一致性。

Method: 1. 利用全局描述符检索检测闭环候选帧；2. 构建闭环条件窗口以估计闭环帧间的相对位姿；3. 鉴于骨干网络具备全局一致尺度特性，直接在SE(3)流形上结合顺序约束和闭环约束对所有帧位姿进行优化，避免了传统Sim(3)或SL(4)流形的复杂优化。

Result: 显著降低了漂移现象，在公里级序列上生成了一致的几何结构，性能显著优于当前最先进方法（SOTA）。

Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了流式重建中的累积漂移难题，实现了准确、无漂移的公里级3D重建，为大规模场景重建提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Feedforward foundation models have recently shown remarkable 3D reconstruction capabilities. However, existing models exhibit large tracking drift in long-context streaming reconstruction due to error accumulation. In this paper, we revisit loop closure with streaming reconstruction foundation models to enable accurate, drift-free, kilometer-scale reconstruction. Specifically, our method detects loop candidates through global descriptor retrieval, and constructs loop-conditioned windows to estimate the relative poses between looped frames. Given the observation that our adopted streaming reconstruction backbone produces a globally consistent scale, we optimize all frame poses on the SE(3) manifold with sequential and loop closure constraints, avoiding the pose graph optimization on the Sim(3) or higher-dimensional SL(4) manifolds employed in prior works. Extensive experiments show that our method reduces drift and produces consistent geometry on kilometer-scale sequences, significantly outperforming the state of the art. Code is available at https://github.com/MoyangLi00/CLoSeR.git.

</details>


### [141] [Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01939)
*Ruiyang Si,Jianxin Bi,Shunyu Yang,Rui Ni,Wenbo Huang,Qiang Wang,Shulong Jiang,Duomin Wang,Xiuyu Li,Haiwen Feng,Zhen Dong,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PyRUA-Lean 是一种交互式代码执行框架，通过组合经典机器人原语和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，利用条件检查和局部重试机制，仅返回显式请求的反馈，从而显著降低 LLM 调用次数和输入 token 开销，在保持相同成功率的条件下提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体控制机器人时，由于重复的模型调用和冗余的观察数据，导致了巨大的 token 开销。

Method: 引入 PyRUA-Lean 框架，耦合反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观察。智能体将经典机器人原语和学习的 VLA 策略组合成 Python 单元，进行条件检查和局部重试，仅返回明确请求的图像和状态反馈以进行重新规划。

Result: 在 LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboCasa365 的 700 个模拟任务实例中，与使用相同 GPT-6 Astra 规划器和底层机器人原语的基线相比，在相同的 LLM 调用预算下，PyRUA-Lean 将整体成功率从 63.1% 提升至 71.7%。在两者均解决的任务实例中，LLM 调用减少了 49%，输入 token 减少了 65%。

Conclusion: PyRUA-Lean 通过优化反馈机制和减少冗余交互，有效降低了 VLM 智能体在机器人控制中的计算资源消耗，同时提升了任务执行的成功率。

Abstract: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

</details>


### [142] [Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01942)
*Efstathios Karypidis,Spyros Gidaris,Nikos Komodakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Latent-Foresight框架，通过端到端联合学习潜在标记器和基于流的生成动力学模型，解决现有两阶段方法在特征压缩与预测解耦导致动态结构不可靠的问题，显著提升未来场景预测的时序连贯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉基础模型（VFMs）的未来场景预测方法多采用两阶段流水线：先通过固定降维或独立训练的自编码器压缩特征，再在冻结的潜在空间上训练预测器。这种表示学习与时间预测的解耦，以及直接在原始VFM特征上应用预测器的做法，无法保证潜在空间具备支持可预测动态的结构特性。

Method: 提出Latent-Foresight端到端框架，联合优化潜在标记器（latent tokenizer）和基于流的生成动力学模型。引入关键设计选择以防止潜在崩溃（latent collapse），并确保重建目标与生成目标的一致性，从而实现稳定的联合优化。

Result: 实验表明，该方法学习到更具时序一致性的潜在表示，在多种未来场景理解任务和不同预测时间跨度上均优于两阶段基线方法，同时消除了包括高分辨率适配在内的单独训练阶段。

Conclusion: 通过端到端联合学习显式塑造支持时间可预测性的表示，有效提升了未来场景演化的建模能力，为无需分阶段训练的高效世界模型提供了新范式。

Abstract: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

</details>


### [143] [Anti-Persona: Disrupting Unauthorized Identity Binding and Recognition in Personalized Vision--Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01944)
*Abhishek Basu,Fahad Shamshad,Karthik Nandakumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Anti-Persona防御机制，通过在图像中添加视觉微扰破坏身份原型对齐，防止大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）进行未经授权的身份绑定和识别，保护率达到95.0%且保持高视觉保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决少样本个性化LVLMs带来的隐私风险：攻击者可通过少量参考图像绑定目标身份，并在后续图像中通过自然语言查询检测该身份。

Method: 1. 聚合多张参考图像的共享视觉特征构建身份原型；2. 在视觉编码器空间中优化细微的视觉扰动以破坏原型对齐；3. 引入空间平滑和低频率保留技术以提升视觉保真度和对图像压缩的鲁棒性。

Result: 在两个代表性个性化LVLM上实验证明，防护率高达95.0%，同时保持视觉保真度；方法对不同提示词变化稳定，支持主动反个性化和被动图像保护，并改善了编码器不匹配下的黑盒迁移能力。

Conclusion: Anti-Persona是一种有效的图像级防御手段，能显著抵御针对个性化LVLMs的身份绑定与识别攻击，兼顾安全性与实用性。

Abstract: Few-shot personalization enables large vision--language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to $95.0\%$ while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.

</details>


### [144] [EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01956)
*Griffin Hurt,Calvin Brinkman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EndoLive框架，通过实时风格迁移将离体标本内窥镜视频转化为活体视频，以解决训练模拟与真实手术场景的视觉差异问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统外科医生培训依赖离体标本，但其组织颜色、出血特征等与活体患者存在显著差异，导致关键解剖结构的识别在模拟与实战中存在偏差，影响培训效果。

Method: 构建EndoLive框架，结合ConStructS GAN（确保手术应用中的逼真风格迁移）与HyPER-GAN（实现复杂转换且支持实时处理），利用未配对的离体与活体内窥镜图像进行训练。

Result: 模型能在远高于实时需求的速度下完成离体到活体的视频转换，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性，并在多种设备上验证有效。

Conclusion: EndoLive能有效弥合离体训练与活体手术间的视觉鸿沟，为外科医生提供更贴近真实的实时可视化培训工具，代码已开源。

Abstract: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.

</details>


### [145] [RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01969)
*Yongliang Wu,Haori Lu,Yulun Wu,Jinqi Luo,Xingyu Zhu,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RASteer方法，通过构建保留子空间并正交化擦除方向，结合重叠自适应校准，在去除目标概念的同时更好地保留非目标概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的激活导向（activation steering）方法在擦除目标概念时，由于目标与保留概念在模型表示空间中存在重叠，导致擦除方向包含共享成分，从而抑制了非目标内容的生成，损害了模型的通用生成能力。

Method: 提出无需训练的Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer) 方法：1. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS)：从保留概念构建保留子空间，并从擦除方向中移除与该子空间对齐的成分；2. Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC)：根据擦除方向与保留子空间的重叠程度，动态控制各层和去噪步骤中共享成分的移除比例，以平衡擦除效果与概念保留。

Result: 在不安全内容、实例和艺术风格擦除任务上，针对多种骨干网络和基准进行测试，结果表明RASteer匹配或优于现有的激活导向和权重编辑基线方法，实现了更佳的擦除与保留平衡。

Conclusion: RASteer通过解决目标与保留概念在表示空间中的重叠问题，有效提升了文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除性能，同时保持了对非目标内容的生成能力。

Abstract: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model's representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation.

</details>


### [146] [Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01973)
*Yifan Wang,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Yanyu Li,Anil Kag,Yun Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning (TVRL)框架，通过冻结的视觉语言模型生成token级别的信用分配，解决传统标量奖励无法定位视频生成中具体错误的问题，显著提升了视频生成的整体质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视频生成强化学习通常对整段视频赋予单一标量奖励，导致优化过程无法精准定位需要修正的视觉token，容易扰动已满足提示的部分，而忽视真正需要改进的区域。

Method: 引入TVRL框架，利用冻结的视觉语言模型的输出答案 likelihood 贡献于视频级奖励，并通过其输入梯度揭示哪些生成token对分数影响最大。具体实现上，在Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)中，将基于提示的问题奖励平均化为组相对优势，并使用解耦的、问题条件的token信用图来重新加权裁剪策略比率内的密集去噪过渡对数概率。

Result: 在VBench-2.0基准测试中，TVRL达到57.69的整体得分，比基础模型高出3.60分。相较于三种SDE采样器（SAGE, Flow, Dance）的基线，提升2.68-3.15分；相较于四种奖励模型（VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, Qwen3.5-9B）的基线，提升1.33-3.15分。

Conclusion: TVRL通过细粒度的token级别信用分配机制，有效解决了视频生成强化学习中的误差定位难题，显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68--3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33--3.15 points.

</details>


### [147] [Continual Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models by Suppressing Cross-Edit Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01989)
*Yongliang Wu,Haori Lu,Jinqi Luo,Wei Cao,Xingyu Zhu,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CEASE方法，通过自适应子空间编辑解决扩散模型持续概念擦除中的干扰累积问题，实现高效且无干扰的擦除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在持续擦除过程中缺乏对编辑间干扰的限制，导致残差扰动积累，不仅损害无关生成质量，还可能使已擦除目标重新出现。

Method: 提出CEASE（Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing），一种无需训练的闭式求解器方法。该方法施加两个子空间约束：将共享替换标记表示加入不变性矩阵，并在检测到干扰时将当前更新投影到由历史更新主导输出方向构成的正交补空间中。

Result: 在名人、艺术风格和实例的持续擦除任务中，CEASE实现了最一致的“擦除-保留”权衡效果；相比之下，现有方法要么降低通用生成质量，要么无法充分擦除目标。

Conclusion: CEASE通过抑制重复激活和更新方向重叠引起的干扰，有效解决了持续擦除中的累积误差问题，提升了内容治理的合规性与稳定性。

Abstract: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE (Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver's invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase-preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets.

</details>


### [148] [Comparing a gradient boosting algorithm to the GOES FDC for wildfire detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01994)
*Asaf Vanunu,Boaz Nadler,Arnon Karnieli*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究提出一种基于CatBoost的机器学习方法，利用GOES ABI图像进行野火检测。该方法在多个指标上显著优于现有的GOES FDC产品，尤其在夜间检测和早期预警方面表现突出，证明了机器学习在提升卫星野火监测精度和时效性方面的巨大潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野火对人类生命、生态系统和财产构成严重威胁，现有的地球静止轨道卫星（如GOES）野火检测产品（FDC）存在精度不足、夜间召回率低及早期预警能力有限等问题，亟需更先进的检测技术以提升监测效果。

Method: 构建并训练了一个CatBoost模型，使用包含数千张ABI图像的庞大数据集以及超过30万条匹配的VIIRS火点探测数据进行训练。随后在五个不同区域的独立数据集上对模型进行评估，并与操作性的GOES FDC产品进行对比分析。

Result: 1. 性能优势：CatBoost模型在精确率、召回率和F1分数上均优于GOES FDC，F1分数高出0.16至0.38。
2. 早期检测：在51个历史火灾事件中，CatBoost比VIIRS和GOES FDC更早检测到26起火灾，而GOES FDC仅早于6起。
3. 夜间检测：CatBoost在夜间仍能实现准确检测，而GOES FDC的夜间召回率极低（约0.03）。

Conclusion: 机器学习模型（如CatBoost）能够显著提升地球静止卫星野火产品的性能，提供更准确的检测结果、更少的误报以及更早的火情预警，特别是在夜间监测方面具有决定性优势，为改进现有监测系统提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Wildfires pose severe risks to human life, ecosystems, and property. This study presents a machine learning approach for wildfire detection from GOES ABI imagery. A CatBoost model was trained on a large dataset with thousands of ABI images and over 300,000 matching VIIRS fire detections. An evaluation on a separate dataset across five regions showed that the learned CatBoost model outperformed the operational GOES Fire Detection and Characterization (FDC) product. It achieved higher precision, recall, and F1 scores both within and outside the training area. The CatBoost model achieved F1 scores that were 0.16 to 0.38 higher than the GOES FDC in all regions. In addition, out of 51 historical fire events, the CatBoost detected 26 fires before both VIIRS and GOES FDC, compared to only six earlier detections by the GOES FDC. Importantly, the CatBoost model achieved accurate wildfire detection also during nighttime, whereas the GOES FDC obtained very low recall values, around 0.03. This study demonstrates that machine learning models may offer significant improvements over existing geostationary fire products, including higher accuracy, fewer false alarms, and earlier detection.

</details>


### [149] [Where-OPD: Spatially Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation of MLLMs with Synthetic Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02117)
*Sophia Sirko-Galouchenko,Monika Wysoczanska,Andrei Bursuc,Nicolas Thome,Spyros Gidaris*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的新型在线策略自蒸馏方法，利用合成数据中的空间文本引导信息作为教师信号，无需人工标注即可显著提升模型在计数、文档和图表理解等任务上的性能，并实现从合成数据到真实世界基准的有效迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态自蒸馏方法主要依赖图像裁剪等视觉特权信息，其增益局限于特定任务且往往需要人工标注的接地数据或外部教师模型，应用范围受限。

Method: 引入基于文本空间接地指导的自蒸馏机制：利用程序化生成的场景自动获取物体身份和空间坐标；教师模型利用这些空间指导定位并整合多个相关图像区域的信息；学生模型仅凭图像和问题学习复现教师行为。整个过程无需人工标注，支持可扩展的后训练。

Result: 在多个模型的计数、文档和图表理解基准测试中一致提升了性能。尽管后训练仅使用合成场景，但改进效果成功迁移至真实世界感知基准（CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, MME-RealWorld），平均性能提升3.23分。

Conclusion: 空间接地的特权信息可以通过在线策略自蒸馏诱导更广泛的感知能力，实现了超越后训练任务和分布的合成到真实世界的有效迁移。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation has recently emerged as an effective approach for improving language-model reasoning by supervising students with a frozen or EMA version of themselves that receives privileged information. Its application to multimodal large language models (MLLMs), however, remains largely unexplored. Recent approaches use privileged visual information, such as image crops corresponding to a question, to improve fine-grained perception, but their gains are confined to tasks that benefit from such visual zooming and require either human-annotated grounding data or external teacher models. We introduce a different form of on-policy self-distillation for MLLMs that provides the teacher with textual, spatially grounded guidance identifying the visual elements relevant to a query. We use procedurally generated scenes with automatically available object identities and spatial coordinates, enabling scalable and annotation-free post-training. The teacher uses this spatial guidance to locate and integrate evidence from multiple relevant image regions, while the student learns to reproduce the resulting behavior from the image and question alone. Our approach consistently improves performance on counting, document and chart understanding benchmarks across multiple models. Importantly, although post-training uses only synthetic scenes, the resulting improvements transfer to real-world perception benchmarks, yielding a 3.23-point gain in average performance across CVBench, V*, ZoomBench, BLINK, HR-Bench, and MME-RealWorld. These results show that spatially grounded privileged information can induce broader perceptual capabilities through on-policy self-distillation, enabling substantial synthetic-to-real transfer beyond the task and data distribution used for post-training. Project page: https://github.com/sirkosophia/Where-OPD

</details>


### [150] [From Reasoning Failures to Composable Video Spatial Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01999)
*Pengzhan Sun,Junbin Xiao,Ramanathan Rajaraman,Shiu-hong Kao,Angela Yao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CROSS框架，通过解构空间推理中的感知、几何表示和推理能力，利用无训练几何算子库修复视觉语言模型在视频空间推理中的系统性错误，显著提升ReVSI和DSI-Bench基准测试成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间推理基准测试的任务级分数无法揭示导致成功或失败的具体底层能力缺陷；需要识别并解决空间证据恢复、几何表示及推理过程中的具体错误源。

Method: 1. 解构分析：通过比较预测与真实空间上下文，识别四类主要错误源（感知不准、上下文信息缺失、测量选择错误、参考系/方位跟踪错误）。2. 构建CROSS：开发一个无需训练的Typed几何算子和空间技能库，基于可用证据支持可靠的视频空间推理。3. 应用方式：为无编码能力的VLM提供验证后的上下文，或作为SpatialClaw代理的可调用技能。

Result: 在五个基准测试上评估CROSS：ReVSI平均得分从55.9%提升至60.2%；SpatialClaw在DSI-Bench上的结果从62.8%提升至66.3%。

Conclusion: 显式处理空间约定能够有效修复系统性的推理失败，且无需额外训练即可提升视觉语言模型的空间推理性能。

Abstract: Spatial reasoning benchmarks evaluate vision-language models across diverse tasks, but task-level scores do not reveal which underlying capabilities account for success or failure. Each task requires recovering spatial evidence, representing geometry, and reasoning over it. We disentangle these capabilities by comparing predicted and ground-truth spatial context under a shared schema and coordinate contract.
