This comparison reveals four recurring sources of error: inaccurate perception, missing information in the spatial context, selection of the wrong measurement, and errors in reference frames or in tracking position and orientation. Guided by this diagnosis, we develop CROSS, a training-free library of typed geometric operators and spatial skills that function over available evidence to support reliable video spatial reasoning. The resulting library supplies verified context to non-coding VLMs or callable skills to a SpatialClaw agent. We evaluate \methodname{} on five benchmarks. \methodname{} raises the average score from 55.9\% to 60.2\% on ReVSI and improves the SpatialClaw result from 62.8\% to 66.3\% on DSI-Bench. These gains demonstrate that explicit handling of spatial conventions can repair systematic reasoning failures without additional training.

</details>


### [151] [Weather-Aware Domain Adaptation for Street-View Weather Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02000)
*Hossein Maghsoumi,George Atia,Yaser P. Fallah*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WA-ADDA方法，通过条件域判别器解决非街景数据到真实驾驶场景的领域偏移问题，提升复杂天气下的相机感知性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雨、雪、雾、尘等恶劣天气对自动驾驶中的基于相机的感知构成挑战；现有训练数据多为非街景来源，与真实驾驶场景存在显著差异（领域偏移）。

Method: 提出Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA)，将域判别器建立在预测天气之上，以获取既具有域不变性又对天气敏感的特征；构建多数据集基准测试，统一非街景源数据和真实街景目标数据，并以宏准确率作为主要评估指标。

Result: 在ResNet-50、EfficientNet、VGG、DenseNet等多种骨干网络上，WA-ADDA一致提升了街景表现，在恶劣条件下实现了高类别召回率，同时保持了良好天气下的准确性。

Conclusion: 证明了经过领域适应的天气识别的可行性，并展示了所构建基准测试对于推动鲁棒车载感知发展的价值。

Abstract: Adverse conditions such as rain, snow, fog, and dust remain challenging for camera-based perception in autonomous driving. We study multi-class weather recognition from street-view images under domain shift, where most available training data come from non-street-view sources that differ markedly from real driving scenes. We propose Weather-Aware Adversarial Discriminative Domain Adaptation (WA-ADDA), which conditions the domain discriminator on predicted weather to promote features that are both domain-invariant and weather-sensitive. We also assemble a multi-dataset benchmark by unifying diverse non-street-view weather collections as sources and real street-view images as targets, and define a standardized evaluation protocol with macro accuracy as the primary metric. Across backbones (ResNet-50, EfficientNet, VGG, DenseNet), WA-ADDA consistently improves street-view performance and yields strong per-class recalls in challenging conditions while preserving clear-weather accuracy. These findings highlight the feasibility of domain-adapted weather recognition and the value of our benchmark for advancing robust, on-board perception.

</details>


### [152] [Exploring Weaknesses of Generative Image Watermarks against Latent Frequency Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02010)
*Kirill Aistov,Khaled Abud,Irina Serzhenko,Egor Kovalev,Aleksey Yakushev,Aleksandr Akimenkov,Dmitry Obydenkov,Yury Markin,Sergey Lavrushkin,Dmitriy Vatolin,Anastasia Antsiferova*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为“潜在频率掩码”（Latent Frequency Masking）的新型攻击方法，通过替换图像潜在表示中的傅里叶系数来消除AI生成图像的隐形水印，在保持图像质量和运行效率的同时显著削弱或移除多种扩散模型水印。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管隐形水印是追踪AI生成图像的核心工具，但其对抗自适应移除攻击的鲁棒性仍是一个未解决的安全问题，亟需评估现有水印方案在面对新型高效攻击时的安全性。

Method: 引入潜在频率掩码攻击，通过在潜空间中替换选定的傅里叶系数来擦除水印证据；替换来源可选用高斯噪声以提高效率，或采用扩散再生以更好地保留图像视觉质量；同时提供了重构对抗图像与掩码潜在频率扰动之间变化的理论失真界限。

Result: 在DiffusionDB和MS-COCO提示词生成的图像上，对六种扩散水印方法进行了评估；结果表明该攻击能有效移除或大幅削弱多种水印，同时保持感知质量，且相比现有攻击具有更优的运行时间性能。

Conclusion: 潜在频率操纵构成了一种切实可行的攻击面，强调在生成式图像水印的鲁棒性评估中必须纳入此类攻击，以完善安全测试体系。

Abstract: Invisible watermarking has become a central tool for tracing AI-generated images, but its robustness against adaptive removal attacks remains an open security question. We introduce Latent Frequency Masking, an attack that erases watermark evidence by replacing selected Fourier coefficients in the latent representation of a watermarked image. The replacement can be sampled from Gaussian noise for efficiency or derived from diffusion regeneration for improved image preservation. We provide a theoretical distortion bound relating the change between the reconstructed adversarial image and the masked latent-frequency perturbation. We evaluate the proposed attack against six diffusion watermarking methods on images generated from DiffusionDB and MS-COCO prompts. Latent Frequency Masking removes or substantially weakens several watermarks while preserving perceptual quality and achieving favorable runtime compared with existing attacks. These results identify latent-frequency manipulation as a practical attack surface and highlight the need to include such attacks in robustness evaluations of generative image watermarking.

</details>


### [153] [Task-Adaptive Grounded 3D-Programmers Using 2D VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02021)
*Arman Raayatsanati,Sombit Dey,Anna-Maria Halacheva,Jan-Nico Zaech,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出3D-Prog框架，通过引入规范坐标框架（CCF）和任务自适应反馈（TAF），无需重新训练即可将强大的2D视觉语言模型（VLMs）转化为具备几何感知能力的3D程序化模型，实现开放词汇的3D理解、操作与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有视觉语言模型在3D理解方面受限于数据规模、训练多样性和推理能力的问题，避免简单地将2D模型扩展至3D带来的局限性。

Method: 1. 规范坐标框架（CCF）：提供统一的视觉表示，将输入和输出锚定到共享的欧几里得坐标系，解决轴歧义、度量尺度不一致等问题；2. 任务自适应反馈（TAF）：构建闭环推理机制，使2D VLM能在原生视觉上下文中执行多样化开放词汇任务；3. 结合两者构建3D-Prog框架。

Result: 3D-Prog无需重新训练即可在物体级和场景级任务中执行开放词汇的3D理解、操作和生成；实验表明该方法能产生一致、可解释且高质量的3D结果，成功将2D VLMs转化为几何感知的3D程序员。

Conclusion: 通过CCF和TAF的结合，可以有效克服2D VLMs在3D应用中的局限，实现可靠、通用的3D理解与生成能力。

Abstract: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable generalization and reasoning abilities, yet 3D understanding in these models is limited by data scale, training diversity, and reasoning capacity. Instead of naively extending these models into 3D, we take a different approach: we enable powerful 2D VLMs to operate reliably in 3D by introducing 3D grounding and iterative feedback loops with two novel concepts: Canonical Coordinate Framing (CCF) and Task-Adaptive Feedback (TAF). CCF serves as a unified visual representation that anchors both inputs and outputs to a shared Euclidean coordinate system, solving common challenges in 3D grounding such as axis ambiguity, inconsistent metric scale, and floating references. Complementary to this structured framing of the 3D inputs, TAF closes the reasoning loop with task-adaptive dynamic feedback that enables 2D VLMs to perform varied open-vocabulary tasks within their native visual context.
  Building on this foundation, we introduce 3D-Prog, a 3D understanding, reasoning, and generation framework that jointly employs the capabilities of CCF and TAF together with powerful VLMs. Without requiring any retraining, 3D-Prog performs open-vocabulary 3D understanding, manipulation, and generation across both object-level and scene-level tasks. Our experiments show that the joint use of CCF and TAF transforms 2D VLMs into geometry-aware 3D programmers, achieving consistent, interpretable, and high-quality results across diverse 3D tasks.

</details>


### [154] [DiDE:Direct Injection with Color-Texture DEcoupling for 3D Stylization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02044)
*Tao Wu,Alexandra Gomez-Villa,Senmao Li,Yaxing Wang,Joost van de Weijer,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DiDE框架，实现无需训练的解耦3D风格化（Disen3D），独立控制纹理和颜色，通过通道划分机制在自注意力层无干扰合成风格信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于整流流的图像到3D生成模型虽能高保真生成3D资产，但现有训练-free风格化方法采用“全有或全无”范式，无法独立控制颜色和纹理转移，缺乏解耦机制。

Method: 提出DiDE框架，利用图像到3D模型潜在空间的过完备性（纹理仅占少数风格显著通道），设计通道划分机制，分别处理内容图、纹理参考和颜色参考，在各自注意力层无干扰地组合风格信号，同时保持内容几何结构。

Result: 在新增的Disen3D-Bench多参考基准测试中，DiDE在颜色保真度、纹理转移和内容保持方面均一致优于现有的2D和3D风格化基线方法。

Conclusion: DiDE是首个无需训练的解耦3D风格化框架，有效解决了颜色与纹理联合转移的限制，实现了高质量的独立风格控制。

Abstract: Recent advances in rectified flow-based image-to-3D generative models have enabled high-fidelity 3D asset generation. Building on this, a growing line of work has exploited these strong 3D priors for training-free stylization, transferring visual attributes from a reference image onto a generated 3D asset. However, existing methods enforce an all-or-nothing paradigm: color and texture are transferred jointly, with no mechanism to control them independently -- a limitation we formalize as Disentangled 3D Stylization(Disen3D). To address this, we propose DiDE, the first training-free framework for Disen3D. Key to our approach is the observation that the structured latent space of image-to-3D models is overcomplete with respect to texture: texture information occupies only a small subset of the style-significant channels, leaving a free subspace available for independent color encoding. DiDE exploits this via a channel partition mechanism that processes a content image, a texture reference, and a color reference through dedicated branches and composes both style signals interference-free at every self-attention layer, preserving content geometry throughout. Experiments on Disen3D-Bench, our newly collected multi-reference benchmark, show that DiDE consistently outperforms 2D and 3D stylization baselines in color fidelity, texture transfer, and content preservation.

</details>


### [155] [Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02045)
*Shiwen Wang,Jian Yang,Xu Wang,Xincan Wang,Weiming Dong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FaV-A多模态智能体，通过分阶段工作流程解决正负空间图像生成的难题，效果优于直接零样本提示基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正负空间是视觉构图的基础原则，但生成此类构图极具挑战性，因为需要协调控制共享共同边界的两个语义概念。尽管现有文本到图像模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）表现强劲，但在直接单次提示下，正负空间生成仍然困难。

Method: 提出形式与虚空智能体（FaV-A），采用渐进式工作流程：首先生成基础对象，然后分析其形状和空间结构以识别候选负空间语义，最后生成用于最终图像生成的组合指令。

Result: 实验结果和消融分析表明，FaV-A比直接的零样本MLLM基线能更有效地产生视觉上连贯且语义对齐的正负空间构图。

Conclusion: FaV-A为分阶段的正负空间生成提供了一个更有效的框架。

Abstract: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the \textbf{F}orm \textbf{a}nd \textbf{V}oid \textbf{A}gent (\textbf{FaV-A}), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.

</details>


### [156] [Learning from Failure: Leveraging Unreliable Predictions in Semi-Supervised Real-World Adverse Weather Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02051)
*Cap Dang Xuan Kiet,Tat-Jen Cham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种新颖的师生半监督框架，通过利用不可靠数据库（失败预测）和可靠数据库（高质量预测进行对比学习，并结合基于相位谱的语义约束及自适应相位一致性损失，有效解决了现有统一恢复模型在真实场景中泛化能力不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的统一图像恢复模型依赖合成数据监督且缺乏足够的语义约束，导致其在真实世界场景中的泛化能力有限。

Method: 1. 构建不可靠数据库存储失败的教师预测作为负样本，可靠数据库存储高质量预测作为正样本，进行对比学习以增强期望特征并避免常见错误；2. 提出基于相位谱的语义约束，替代昂贵的文本监督；3. 设计自适应相位一致性损失，根据退化程度动态平衡输入与教师伪真值的监督。

Result: 在真实世界基准测试中，该方法在恢复质量和感知保真度上持续优于现有的最先进方法，并在应对真实世界恶劣天气条件时表现出更强的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该提出的师生半监督框架能有效提升恶劣天气图像恢复的性能和鲁棒性，解决了合成数据依赖和语义约束不足导致的泛化瓶颈。

Abstract: Adverse weather image restoration aims to recover images degraded by rain, haze, snow, and other weather-induced artifacts, thereby improving the robustness of outdoor vision systems. Existing unified restoration models exhibit limited generalization to real-world scenes due to their reliance on synthetic supervision and insufficient semantic constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel student--teacher semi-supervised framework that addresses both challenges. Specifically, we introduce an unreliable database that preserves failed teacher predictions as informative negative samples for contrastive learning, while a reliable database stores high-quality teacher predictions as positive samples. By jointly exploiting reliable pseudo-ground truths and unreliable teacher outputs, the proposed framework learns to enhance desirable restoration characteristics while avoiding common failures. We further propose a phase spectrum-based semantic constraint that replaces computationally expensive text-based supervision with an efficient and naturally aligned semantic prior. An adaptive phase consistency loss is also designed to dynamically balance supervision between the degraded input and teacher pseudo-ground truths according to degradation severity. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in restoration quality and perceptual fidelity while exhibiting stronger generalization to real-world adverse weather conditions.

</details>


### [157] [GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02091)
*Yakun Zhu,Yi Bin,Yujuan Ding,Zheng Wang,Pengpeng Zeng,Duo Peng,Jingkuan Song,Heng Tao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GeoLatent模型，通过CR-GEO和路由优化解决2D图像3D空间推理中几何表示单一和潜在变量利用率低的问题，在SPAR-Bench和SPBench上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于文本的方法因离散token限制导致连续空间关系保真度低；单一连续潜在变量无法明确分离不同空间任务所需的线索；分解的潜在变量虽能区分位置、方向和全局几何，但易坍缩至主导方向且注意力机制可能导致潜在变量在答案学习中未被充分利用。

Method: 引入GeoLatent框架，结合共同-残差几何对齐（CR-GEO）与路由优化。CR-GEO将共享几何与残差教师几何分离；路由优化联合训练几何与语言，通过潜在变量临时引导视觉答案学习，并在几何监督下恢复全注意力机制。

Result: CR-GEO将几何有效秩从1.00提升至3.87；阻断瓶颈处潜在变量读取使方向准确率从89.1%降至25.8%，证明潜在变量的关键作用；最终在SPAR-Bench上达到73.0%，在SPBench上达到72.1%，均优于先前方法。

Conclusion: GeoLatent通过结构化的几何状态和潜在变量介导的答案学习路径，有效提升了2D到3D空间推理的精度和表征丰富度，证明了分解式几何潜在变量在视觉语言模型中的有效性。

Abstract: Despite progress in vision-language models, 3D spatial reasoning from 2D images remains challenging. Text-based methods describe intermediate geometry with discrete tokens, limiting fidelity for continuous spatial relations. Continuous latents offer richer representations, but a single latent type does not explicitly separate the cues needed across spatial tasks. Decomposed spatial latents address this by representing position, direction, and global geometry separately under geometric supervision. Yet the geometry representation can still collapse toward one dominant direction, and unrestricted attention can leave the latents underused during answer learning. We introduce GeoLatent, combining Common--Residual Geometry Alignment (CR-GEO) with routed optimization to structure the geometry states while promoting latent-mediated answer learning. CR-GEO separates shared from residual teacher geometry; routed optimization jointly trains geometry and language, temporarily directs visual answer learning through the latents, and restores full attention with geometry supervision. In controlled comparisons, CR-GEO raises geometry effective rank from 1.00 to 3.87, while blocking latent readout at the bottleneck lowers direction accuracy from 89.1% to 25.8% on 128 fixed questions. After recovery, the differentiated geometry representation and latent-mediated visual route remain available alongside direct image access. GeoLatent achieves 73.0% on SPAR-Bench and 72.1% on SPBench, outperforming previously reported methods on both.

</details>


### [158] [Surface-volume self-supervised representation learning of brain MRI for genetic discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02114)
*Tian Xia,Nuo Chen,Zihao Zhu,Huiwen Han,Ziqian Xie,Zhiwen Fan,Degui Zhi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MEVA框架，融合体积扫描与皮层网格几何特征进行自监督学习，在UK Biobank GWAS中发现更多全基因组显著位点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脑影像GWAS使用的表型（来自体积扫描或皮层网格）仅捕获部分遗传变异，未能充分利用大脑解剖结构的全部可遗传信息。

Method: 开发MEVA（Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder），一种自监督框架，将体素级图像强度与皮层网格几何（曲率、皮层厚度）编码为共享成像特征集。

Result: MEVA在年龄和性别预测上略优于单一输入模型；在UK Biobank GWAS中，基于MEVA特征发现了比单独使用体积或网格特征更多的全基因组显著位点。

Conclusion: 将皮层表面几何信息整合到体积自监督学习中，能捕获额外的可遗传变异，从而提高GWAS检测到的基因位点数量。

Abstract: Existing genome-wide association studies (GWAS) of brain imaging provide predefined or deep-learning-derived imaging phenotypes, yet these phenotypes come from either volumetric scans or cortical surface meshes, so each captures only part of the heritable variation in brain anatomy. Here we introduce MEVA (Mesh-Enhanced Volumetric Autoencoder), a self-supervised framework that encodes voxel-level image intensity together with cortical mesh geometry, including curvature and cortical thickness at each surface vertex, into one shared set of imaging features. Combining the mesh and volumetric inputs in MEVA yields modest performance gains in age and sex prediction over models that use either input alone. When these features serve as phenotypes for GWAS in the UK Biobank, they reveal more genome-wide significant loci than features learned from volumes alone or from meshes alone. These results suggest that adding cortical surface geometry to volumetric self-supervised learning captures additional heritable variation and so increases the number of loci detected.

</details>


### [159] [Harnessing Domain Specialists in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02123)
*Damiano Marsili,Raphi Kang,Aditya Mehta,Pietro Perona,Georgia Gkioxari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 研究发现多模态混合专家（MoE）模型中，稀疏性自发形成了具有语义特化的内在结构。基于此，提出无需数据的ExpertLens方法，通过解码路由器权重识别领域专家，仅微调21.7%-47.0%的参数即可在数学、医学和遥感任务中实现高效适配，性能超越LoRA并提升4倍训练速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索多模态MoE架构中的稀疏计算是否会导致 emergent intrinsic organization（涌现的内在组织），特别是专家是否会在未显式训练模块化的情况下发展出跨模态和领域的语义特化能力，以利用这种结构进行高效的模型适配。

Method: 提出ExpertLens，一种数据无关的方法。该方法直接从预训练模型权重中解码路由器权重为具有语义意义的词汇标记，从而识别出领域专用的专家。随后，针对目标领域选择性地微调这些相关专家，而非全量微调。

Result: 在数学、医学和遥感任务中，ExpertLens匹配或超越了全量微调的性能，同时仅更新21.7%至47.0%的模型参数，实现了平均4.0倍的训练加速。此外，其在适配性能和训练效率上均优于LoRA。

Conclusion: 为效率而引入的稀疏性不仅减少了计算量，还产生了具有语义模块化特性的内在结构。这种结构可直接用于高效的模型适配，证明了稀疏性与语义特化之间的有用联系。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity through sparse computation, routing each token through only a small subset of experts. In this work, we explore whether this sparsity gives rise to emergent intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs. We find that experts develop strong semantic specialization across modalities and domains despite not being explicitly trained for modularity. Building on this structure, we introduce ExpertLens, a data-free method that identifies domain-specialized experts directly from pretrained model weights by decoding router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens. We leverage this specialization for efficient multimodal adaptation by selectively fine-tuning experts relevant to a target domain. Across math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, ExpertLens matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating only 21.7 - 47.0% of model parameters and achieving a 4.0x average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in both adaptation performance and training efficiency. These results show that sparsity introduced for efficiency can give rise to semantic modularity that is directly useful for efficient adaptation.

</details>


### [160] [MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02136)
*Negin Kafee Hernashki,Soumick Chatterjee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MIRTO评估协议，显式量化无监督脑MRI异常检测中因对齐、阈值设定和评估指标选择导致的性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法排名依赖未报告的隐含假设（如地图对齐方式、阈值设定依据及假阳性预算），导致结果不可复现且难以公平比较。

Method: 构建MIRTO协议：通过配准检查和对齐验证控制几何比较；仅在验证数据上设定阈值并报告测试集实际假阳性体积；在15,552个评估管道中重复比较；使用配对受试者引导间隔进行多重性控制。应用于BraTS 2020数据集上的四种方法。

Result: 发现轴序不匹配可大幅降低体素AUROC（从0.873降至0.583）；不同指标对评估结果的解释力差异显著（Dice方差解释率为0.77，而病灶敏感性仅为0.14）；在同等假阳性负担下，某些方法的Dice优势消失；REFLECT模型的潜在聚合改进提升了Dice分数。

Conclusion: 评估协议的标准化选择对结果影响巨大，现有排名可能由评估设置而非模型能力决定。研究为探索性结论，强调了透明化评估流程的重要性。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. Applied to four UAD methods trained on the same healthy data and tested on 312 BraTS 2020 subjects, MIRTO showed that an axis-order mismatch between stored maps and the reference lowered a diffusion model's voxel AUROC from 0.873 to 0.583 whilst barely moving its slice-level AUROC. Within each metric, the method explained at least 0.95 of the variance in voxel AUROC and AUPRC and 0.77 in Dice, but only 0.14 in lesion sensitivity, where the lesion definition and hit criterion dominated. A Dice advantage that was significant at validation thresholds vanished at equal realised false-positive burden, and an exact identity attributes it to threshold transfer. A training-free change to REFLECT's latent aggregation raised Dice at equal burden by 0.052. Nine hypotheses were tested against explicit criteria; because the same cohort served to develop the protocol, all inference is exploratory.

</details>


### [161] [Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02148)
*Mohammed Irfan Kurpath,Jaseel Muhammad Kaithakkodan,Sahal Shaji Mullappilly,Ivan Laptev,Hisham Cholakkal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Omni-Embed-Mini (0.9B) 和 Omni-Embed (2.3B) 模型，通过冻结文本侧参数和使用级联标题作为教师信号，实现多模态嵌入而无需牺牲文本检索质量，显著减小模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展文本嵌入模型到新模态通常会降低文本检索质量，且现有全模态嵌入器依赖数十亿参数，导致资源消耗巨大。

Method: 1. 保持文本骨干网络权重完全冻结，确保文本检索能力不退化；2. 利用密集级联标题作为教师目标，因师生共享同一骨干权重，几何空间一致；3. 使用轻量级投影器和分阶段LoRA适配器对齐各模态编码器；4. 结合Matryoshka SigLIP对比损失与在线混合难负样本挖掘机制进行训练。

Result: 1. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B在MTEB-v2 BEIR-8上达到49.57 nDCG@10的文本检索性能，比现有开源全模态嵌入器小2.7至9.5倍；2. 2.3B变体在与Gemini-embedding-2的对比中，整体模态平均性能略胜一筹。

Conclusion: 该框架证明了在不更新文本参数的情况下，通过高效的对齐策略即可实现高性能、小尺寸的多模态嵌入，为资源受限环境下的多模态应用提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: Extending a text embedding model to new modalities typically degrades text retrieval quality, and existing omni-modal embedders compensate with multi-billion parameters. We present Omni-Embed-Mini, a 0.9B-parameter model that maps text, speech, audio, images, video, and visually-rich documents into a single shared cosine space without updating any text-side parameter. Our key insight is that the teacher signal requires no separate embedding model: each media sample is paired with a dense cascaded caption, and the teacher target is simply the frozen backbone's own embedding of that caption. Because teacher and student share the same backbone weights, they inhabit byte-identical geometry, and lightweight projectors plus phased LoRA adapters on the modality encoders suffice for alignment. Training combines a Matryoshka SigLIP contrastive loss with an online hybrid hard-negative miner whose negatives sharpen as the encoder improves. The recipe carries over to a 2.3B variant by swapping in a native vision-language backbone. Omni-Embed-Mini-0.9B keeps its text weights bit-identical to the backbone, so training cannot regress text retrieval (49.57 nDCG@10 on MTEB-v2 BEIR-8), while extending it to five additional modalities, and is ~2.7x to 9.5x smaller than every open omni embedder we compare against. The 2.3B variant is competitive with the closed gemini-embedding-2, edging ahead of it on the overall-modality average. Models, code, data and evaluation harness are on our project page: https://omniembed.cvmbzuai.com

</details>


### [162] [MosaiChunk: Compositing Spatio-Temporal Memory for Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02153)
*Yiwen Zhang,Haocheng Xi,Michael Tian-Yue Liu,Alexei A. Efros,Hadar Averbuch-Elor,Qianqian Wang,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MosaiChunk机制，通过时空记忆拼接历史KV条目解决长视频生成中的细节丢失问题，并引入RememBench基准测试验证其在重访一致性上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视域自回归视频生成受限于有限的上下文窗口，导致物体或场景在脱离上下文后，其细粒度视觉细节难以在重新出现时恢复。

Method: 1. 构建MosaiChunk：一种时空记忆机制，将选定的历史键值（KV）条目组合成马赛克形式；2. 固定冻结的视频生成器，仅训练一个轻量级路由器以在固定内存预算下决定包含哪些历史部分；3. 建立RememBench基准，涵盖提示驱动的文生视频（T2V）和相机驱动的图片生视频（I2V）两种长视域重访场景。

Result: 在匹配的内存预算下，MosaiChunk在T2V和I2V设置中均显著优于滑动窗口推理和整块检索方法，一致性地提升了重访一致性。

Conclusion: 通过利用非连续的历史KV信息并优化选择策略，有效解决了长视频生成中的细节保持难题，为长视域视频生成提供了更高效的记忆解决方案。

Abstract: Long-horizon autoregressive video generation is limited by a finite context window. When an object or scene falls out of context, its fine-grained visual details may be lost and difficult to recover upon reappearance. To retain access to such visual details, we introduce MosaiChunk, a spatio-temporal memory mechanism that composes a mosaic of selected historical key-value (KV) entries across space and time. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a frozen video generator can directly consume such non-contiguous historical KV and recover the corresponding visual content. We therefore keep the generator fixed and learn only a lightweight router that determines which historical sections to include in the mosaic under a fixed active-memory budget. We further introduce RememBench, a benchmark of long-horizon revisits with prompt-driven text-to-video (T2V) and camera-driven image-to-video (I2V) splits. Our experiments show that MosaiChunk consistently improves revisit consistency over both sliding-window inference and whole-chunk retrieval under matched memory budgets, across both T2V and I2V settings.

</details>


### [163] [4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02160)
*Wei Cao,Hao Zhang,Vikram Voleti,Yuqun Wu,Mallikarjun B R,Shimon Vainer,Mark Boss,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出4Director，一种基于显式4D场景表示的视频世界模型，通过重建对象为规范网格并应用刚性变换实现精确的相机和物体运动控制，解决了现有方法在深度、旋转及跨视角一致性上的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专业视频制作需要精确控制相机和物体运动，但现有方法仅能通过图像平面线索粗略控制物体，存在深度和旋转模糊问题；或使用3D轨迹和色块，缺乏完整几何结构且在视角变化时失去一致性。

Method: 1. 构建4Director视频世界模型，条件为显式4D场景表示：将输入图像中的每个对象重建为规范网格（canonical mesh），每帧施加一个指定的刚性变换进行移动。2. 渲染受控场景为深度视频，引入Motion Adapter将几何支架转化为视频，合成视图一致的外观、光照和非刚性动态。3. 构建RealCOD-Rigid数据集（20,774个标注了刚性3D场景的视频片段）。4. 提出Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU)指标联合评估运动遵循度和身份保持。

Result: 实验表明，4Director在视觉质量和相机/物体控制方面持续优于先前方法。

Conclusion: 4Director提供了一种直观的3D控制接口，防止未观察到的几何结构在各帧中独立再生，实现了更精确、一致的视频生成与控制。

Abstract: Precise control over camera and object motion is essential for professional video production. Existing methods control objects only coarsely, through image-plane cues that are ambiguous in depth and rotation or through 3D tracks and blobs that lack complete geometry and lose consistency across viewpoint changes. We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame. This representation provides an intuitive 3D control interface and prevents unobserved geometry from being regenerated independently in every frame. We render the controlled scene as a depth video and introduce a Motion Adapter that transforms this geometric scaffold into video while synthesizing view-consistent appearance, illumination, and non-rigid dynamics. For training, we construct RealCOD-Rigid, a new dataset of 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes by our automatic pipeline. We further introduce Identity-Gated IoU (IG-IoU), which jointly evaluates adherence to prescribed object motion and preservation of object identity. Experiments demonstrate that 4Director consistently outperforms prior methods in visual quality and in camera and object control.

</details>


### [164] [World Observer: Joint Actor-Observer Generation for Persistent World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02162)
*Hyunwook Choi,Dahyun Chung,Hyunsung Kim,Siyoon Jin,Jinhyeok Choi,Junyoung Seo,Seungryong Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出World Observer，通过解耦观察与行动，利用全景观察者持续追踪离开视野的物体，解决视频世界模型中物体出界后状态丢失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型以智能体为中心，当物体离开智能体视野时，无法维持其状态和动态变化，导致重新进入视野时出现不一致或错误。

Method: 引入World Observer框架，联合生成基于智能体的视角和多个全景观察者；通过共享全景源进行几何对齐，并使用Observer Sink恢复高分辨率细节；观察者可自由放置、扩展覆盖范围并由控制信号驱动。

Result: 在保持视觉保真度、相机控制和3D一致性方面具有竞争力，显著提升了出视野物体的动态演化表现；建立了新的世界空间指标和基准测试（涵盖真实和合成场景）。

Conclusion: World Observer有效解决了视频世界模型中视野外物体状态维持难题，为更连贯的环境模拟提供了新范式。

Abstract: How can a world model continuously observe regions beyond the actor's current view? Video world models simulate how an environment evolves from an agent's actions, yet remain actor-centric. Once an object leaves the actor's view, they lose direct evidence of its evolution, often failing to preserve its state and dynamics upon re-entry. To address this, we introduce World Observer, which decouples observing from acting by jointly generating a perspective actor for the agent-centric view with one or more panoramic observers that watch selected world regions. This allows objects that leave the actor's view to remain visually evolving in an observer, so their updated states are reflected when they re-enter. We ground the actor and observers by warping from a shared panoramic source for explicit geometric correspondence, and introduce an Observer Sink of high-resolution perspective references to restore fine appearance upon re-entry. Since the observers are decoupled from the actor, they can be placed freely across the scene, extended to multiple locations for broader coverage, and driven by control signals to steer out-of-view evolution. To evaluate out-of-view evolution, we further introduce world-space metrics and a benchmark spanning real and synthetic scenes. World Observer substantially improves out-of-view dynamics while remaining competitive in visual fidelity, camera control, and 3D adherence.

</details>


### [165] [Generative Cinematographer: Composing Camera and Object Motion in 3D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02180)
*Jiahan Zhang,Chaohao Yang,Namitha Guruprasad,Vivekjyoti Banerjee,Trong-Tung Nguyen,Alan Yuille,Anand Bhattad*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GenCine系统，通过单图构建可编辑3D场景，利用局部3D运动手柄和相机路径控制视频生成，解决2D轨迹模糊性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可控视频生成依赖2D运动轨迹或稀疏拖拽信号，存在歧义性（同一2D轨迹对应不同3D运动），尤其在相机与物体同时移动时难以精确控制。

Method: 1. 从单图重建可编辑3D场景脚手架；2. 艺术家指定相机路径并使用局部3D运动手柄独立移动前景区域，实现非刚性运动的分段刚性近似；3. 将控制信号投影为引导地图（记录帧内位置、固定颜色标识手柄、编码世界坐标系下的3D位置）以适配预训练视频模型；4. 在Wan模型上训练轻量级引导分支和LoRA适配器，利用真实视频恢复的控制数据和合成视频的几何/轨迹数据进行训练。

Result: 实验表明，该方法实现了稳定的相机相对运动，在视角变化下具有更好的几何一致性，并在 diverse 真实场景中展现出强大的可控性。

Conclusion: GenCine通过引入3D场景表示和基于世界坐标系的引导地图，有效解决了传统2D控制信号的歧义问题，提升了视频生成的几何一致性和控制精度。

Abstract: Current controllable video generation systems often rely on 2D motion trajectories or sparse drag signals for object motion. These controls are ambiguous because the same 2D trajectory can correspond to different 3D motions, especially when the camera and objects move simultaneously. We present Generative Cinematographer (GenCine), a system that lifts a single image into an editable 3D scene scaffold where artists jointly author camera and foreground motion. Artists specify a camera path and move selected foreground regions using local 3D motion handles. Several handles can move different parts of a subject independently, providing a piecewise-rigid approximation to non-rigid motion without a physics simulator or category-specific prior. To communicate these controls to a pretrained video model, we project them into guidance maps. These maps record where the controlled regions appear in each frame, assign each handle a fixed color across frames and encode the current 3D positions of its controlled points in the same world coordinate system as the background. This lets us describe object motion relative to the scene even as the camera moves. For training, we recover controls from the motion observed in real videos and use ground-truth geometry and trajectories from synthetic videos. We train a lightweight guidance branch and LoRA adapters on a pretrained Wan model to follow these controls. Our experiments show consistent camera-relative motion, improved geometric consistency under viewpoint changes, and strong controllability across diverse real-world scenes.

</details>


### [166] [OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02181)
*Haibo Wang,Jiteng Mu,Jialu Li,Jingru Yi,Yuanjun Xiong,Jianming Zhang,Lifu Huang,Mingze Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: OmniSeek是一个将多模态大模型转化为主动式、多轮推理智能体的框架，通过动态选择“看”或“听”来检索关键证据，并利用合成数据引擎和强化学习优化，显著提升了长上下文中的音频-视觉推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Omni-Large Language Model通常被动地一次性处理整个音视频序列，无法在长上下文中主动获取稀疏但关键的证据。本研究旨在解决这一问题，使模型具备主动的证据获取能力和跨模态推理能力。

Method: 1. 提出OmniSeek框架，允许模型在多轮推理中动态决定何时、以何种时间窗口进行视听检索。
2. 构建数据引擎生成OmniTraj-170K数据集，包含带有交错音视频证据的多跳思维链轨迹。
3. 首先对模型进行监督微调以植入多轮工具使用行为，随后通过两阶段可验证奖励的强化学习进一步优化策略。
4. 引入“音视频必要性”目标，奖励依赖双模态的成功轨迹，防止单模态捷径。

Result: 实验表明，OmniSeek能够学习自适应的跨模态证据搜索，并在广泛的基准测试中一致提升了音频-视觉推理的性能。

Conclusion: 通过将证据获取整合到推理过程中，并结合合成数据和强化学习优化，OmniSeek成功实现了具有原生工具使用能力的主动式多模态智能体，为复杂长上下文下的多模态理解提供了新范式。

Abstract: We present OmniSeek, an agentic framework that transforms an Omni Large Language Model (Omni-LLM) into an active, multi-turn reasoning agent with native tool use. Rather than passively processing an entire audio-visual sequence in a single forward pass, OmniSeek makes evidence acquisition part of the reasoning process: it dynamically decides whether to look or listen, and over which temporal window, to retrieve sparse but critical evidence across different modalities within long contexts. Through an iterative multi-turn protocol, the retrieved raw audio or visual segments are appended back into the context to support subsequent reasoning. To cold-start this capability, we build a data engine that synthesizes OmniTraj-170K, a corpus of multi-hop Chain-of-Thought trajectories with interleaved audio and visual evidence. We first supervise the model on these trajectories to instill multi-turn tool-use behavior, and then further optimize the policy via a two-stage reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Moreover, we introduce an Audio-Visual Necessity objective that explicitly rewards successful trajectories whose reasoning depends on both modalities, discouraging single-modality shortcuts. Extensive experiments across a wide range of benchmarks demonstrate that OmniSeek learns adaptive cross-modal evidence seeking and consistently improves audio-visual reasoning performance.

</details>


### [167] [DMAD: Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation for Fast Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02188)
*Zhengming Yu,Junkun Yuan,Haotian Yang,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Yizhi Wang,Angtian Wang,Yiding Yang,Bo Liu,Xin Li,Wenping Wang,Chongyang Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DMAD（分布匹配对抗蒸馏），通过分类任务直接学习对数密度比，替代DMD中昂贵的辅助扩散模型拟合，实现高效少步生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) 需维护辅助扩散模型以拟合学生分布，导致额外内存和计算成本高的问题。

Method: 将分布匹配重构为分类问题，使用共享主干上的两个判别器头区分真实数据、教师样本与学生样本；引入基于gap的重加权机制适应不同噪声水平的教师监督；证明判别器最优时损失可恢复DMD的分布匹配梯度。

Result: 在ImageNet-64x64上单步生成FID达1.04；SDXL四步生成COCO-10K FID为14.47；Wan2.1-T2V-14B四步生成VBench总分85.15；MiniMax-H3-33B联合音视频生成中，人类偏好率优于DMD2 (79.1%) 和 rCM (84.6%)。

Conclusion: DMAD通过对抗式分类蒸馏有效降低了少步生成的计算开销，并在多项指标上达到对比方法中的最佳性能。

Abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) trains a few-step student from the difference between separately estimated target and student scores, so it must keep an auxiliary diffusion model fitted to the student's evolving distribution at extra memory and computation cost. We introduce DMAD, Distribution Matching as Adversarial Distillation, which recasts distribution matching as classification and learns the required log-density ratios directly. Two discriminator heads on a shared backbone distinguish real data and teacher samples from the student's, and linear losses on their logits train the student without auxiliary score fitting. We prove that at the discriminator optimum these losses recover the distribution-matching gradient underlying DMD, through the classical identity linking discriminator logits to log-density ratios. We further introduce gap-based reweighting, which adapts teacher supervision across noise levels from the real-data head's empirical logit gap between real and teacher samples. DMAD reaches a Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) of 1.04 with one-step generation on ImageNet-64x64, 14.47 with four-step SDXL on COCO-10K, and a VBench total score of 85.15 with four-step Wan2.1-T2V-14B, the best values among the compared few-step methods and the multi-step teachers. On MiniMax-H3-33B, our four-step student achieves overall human preference rates of 79.1% over DMD2 and 84.6% over rCM for joint audio-video generation, excluding ties. Our code, models and demos are available at https://yzmblog.github.io/projects/DMAD.

</details>


### [168] [HiPhy: Hierarchical Alignment for Physically-Plausible Multi-Principle Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02197)
*Tahira Kazimi,Shubhankar Borse,Munawar Hayat,Fatih Porikli,Pinar Yanardag*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HiPhy框架，通过强化学习和双层目标解决视频生成中多物理原理共存时的不连贯问题，显著提升了物理常识和语义对齐能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽视觉逼真，但难以遵循物理定律，特别是在需要多种物理原理（如浮力与流体动力学）同时作用的复杂场景中，现有方法往往忽略多原理间的相互作用。

Method: 提出HiPhy（分层物理对齐）强化学习框架，采用双层目标：局部层面强制执行单个物理原理的时间动态，全局层面确保场景整体的物理和语义一致性；构建50K提示数据集及MultiPhyBench基准测试。

Result: HiPhy在各项基准测试中显著优于先前方法和基线，特别是在涉及多个并发物理原理的场景中表现最佳，大幅提升了物理常识和语义对齐能力。

Conclusion: 通过分层物理对齐机制，可以有效解决多物理原理共存的视频生成难题，为通用世界模拟器的发展提供了重要进展。

Abstract: Video generation models have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and have strong potential to become general-purpose world simulators. Despite this progress, they still fail to generate videos which adhere to laws of physics. The problem becomes even more apparent in realistic settings where multiple physical principles must work together within the same video; for example, "a balloon floating upward while steam rises from a pot" requires buoyancy and fluid dynamics to unfold coherently and simultaneously. Yet existing methods largely ignore multi-principle interactions, focusing on a single principle per video. We propose HiPhy (Hierarchical Physical Alignment), a reinforcement learning framework that grounds video generation in physical laws through a dual-level objective: locally enforcing the temporal dynamics of individual physical principles, and globally ensuring the physical and semantic coherence of the entire scene. To support multi-principle generation, we construct a 50K-prompt dataset and introduce a prompt benchmark MultiPhyBench, spanning a diverse range of co-occurring physical events. Our experiments show that HiPhy significantly outperforms prior methods and baselines, improving physical commonsense and semantic alignment significantly across various benchmarks, with the largest gains on scenes involving multiple concurrent physical principles where competing methods degrade most sharply.

</details>


### [169] [SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02201)
*Tianjiao Yu,Xinzhuo Li,Yifan Shen,Ying Shen,Kiet A. Nguyen,Adheesh Sunil Juvekar,Ismini Lourentzou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SILSA框架，利用滑动窗口切片潜在变量替代体素token，实现高效、拓扑一致的3D生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高分辨率3D生成依赖体素潜在变量和多阶段管道，导致表面碎片化、生成成本高且薄结构或高连通形状的拓扑一致性差。

Method: 使用沿三个主轴的重叠固定切片表示形状，通过Slice VAE编码表面样本为多轴切片潜在变量，结合Volumetric Anchor Lattice协调方向流，并引入基于持久同调的切片级拓扑监督。

Result: 相比最强基线，PSNR提升8.7%，覆盖率增加5.96个绝对点，Betti误差降低9.2%；Token数量减少70%-98%，训练内存降低40.4%，推理时间缩短58.5%，显著改善薄结构和长程连通性保留。

Conclusion: SILSA通过拓扑感知的切片表示和单阶段生成，在保持高结构保真度的同时大幅降低了计算成本。

Abstract: High-resolution 3D generation increasingly relies on voxel latents and multi-stage pipelines that first predict active structure and then synthesize local geometry. While effective, this design fragments continuous surfaces into many local tokens, inflates generation cost, and often weakens topological consistency for thin or highly connected shapes. We introduce SILSA, a topology-aware 3D generation framework that represents shapes with compact sliding-window slice latents. Instead of generating expensive voxel tokens, SILSA uses a fixed set of overlapping slices along the three canonical axes, where each token summarizes a local depth window to preserve cross-sectional continuity and support single-stage rectified-flow generation. A Slice VAE encodes oriented surface samples into multi-axis slice latents and reconstructs them with a sparse volumetric decoder, while a Volumetric Anchor Lattice coordinates directional slice streams through a shared 3D workspace. To preserve structural correctness, we introduce slice-level topology supervision that matches persistence diagrams and aligns Betti transitions across neighboring slices. Experiments show that SILSA improves structural fidelity while substantially reducing generation cost. SILSA improves PSNR by $8.7\%$, coverage by $5.96$ absolute points, and Betti error by $9.2\%$ over the strongest baseline, while using $70.0\%$ fewer tokens than the next-most compact baseline and over $98\%$ fewer tokens than sparse or hierarchical tokenizers, effectively reducing training memory by $40.4\%$ and inference time by $58.5\%$. Qualitative results further show improved preservation of thin structures, repeated components, and long-range connectivity.

</details>


### [170] [Embedding Prediction Helps Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02203)
*Sihan Xu,Ji Xie,Zilin Wang,Hui Shen,Stella X. Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出NEPA方法，通过预测连续嵌入序列动态调整扩散模型（DiT）的去噪条件，以更低算力实现更高质量的图像生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散Transformer在去噪的每一步重复使用相同的初始条件（如类别标签或文本提示），缺乏对当前噪声状态的适应性；研究是否可用预测的嵌入作为动态条件来改善生成效果。

Method: 提出Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA)，训练Transformer预测下一个连续嵌入；采用Multi-Embedding Prediction一次性预测所有嵌入；在Embedding Conditioned Generation中，DiT生成器每步根据预测结果重新计算条件信号，使其适应当前噪声状态。

Result: 在ImageNet 256×256类别条件下实验，最终模型NEPA-DiT-XL结合REPA达到FID 1.32，且训练算力消耗仅为REPA的约三分之一。

Conclusion: 动态嵌入条件机制能有效提升扩散模型效率与性能，在显著降低计算成本的同时实现高保真图像生成。

Abstract: In diffusion transformers, a class label or a text prompt is embedded once, and the same condition is reused at every denoising step. We ask whether predicted embeddings can serve as this condition instead. Next-Embedding Predictive Autoregression (NEPA) trains a Transformer to predict the next continuous embedding in a sequence. In generation, the clean image follows the noisy image, so its embeddings are the next embeddings after the condition and the noisy image. We train a NEPA model to predict them all at once with Multi-Embedding Prediction, and in Embedding Conditioned Generation, a DiT generator is conditioned on these predictions, recomputed at every denoising step, so the conditioning signal adapts to the current noisy state. Experiments on class-conditional ImageNet $256\times256$ study the condition of the generator, the design of Multi-Embedding Prediction, and the scaling of both models. The NEPA model adds a second network to every sampling step; with it, and combined with REPA, our final model, NEPA-DiT-XL, reaches an FID of 1.32 using about a third of the training compute of REPA.

</details>


### [171] [ROWBench: Do Video Models Render What the Program Specifies?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02205)
*Zheng-Hui Huang,Guixu Lin,Yu-Ju Tsai,Jian-Kai Zhu,Fengbo Lan,Yu-Lun Liu,Yung-Yu Chuang,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PROWBench基准，通过程序生成的世界记录和代理视频，评估可编程世界模型在细粒度、程序指定事件上的视觉忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估视觉质量、可控性及物理遵循性，但缺乏对细粒度、程序指定世界事件的视觉忠实度的充分评估。

Method: 构建包含170个程序化剧集和600个代理视频的PROWBench，记录实体状态和时间戳事件作为可重播的世界记录；利用可扩展框架渲染不同视角和表示（如3D、边界框）；采用两个基于VLM的指标（Logic-Render Alignment和Interaction Success Rate）进行评估。

Result: 提供了涵盖多种场景和交互、支持第一/第三人称视角及多视图同步观测的基准，能够检查生成视频与程序执行可见后果的一致性。

Conclusion: PROWBench为评估可编程世界模型在时间线遵循性和事件视觉实现方面的表现提供了新的评估框架。

Abstract: Programmable world models separate executable dynamics from visual generation, offering a promising foundation for next-generation game engines. However, their visual adherence to explicit rules and interactions remains insufficiently evaluated. Existing benchmarks assess visual quality, controllability, and instruction or physical adherence, but rarely test fidelity to fine-grained, program-specified world events. We introduce PROWBench, comprising 170 programmatically constructed episodes and 600 proxy videos covering diverse scenes and interactions. PROWBench logs entity states and timestamped events, including those outside the camera's field of view, as replayable world records, from which it renders synchronized views and proxy representations. This enables generated videos to be checked against the observable consequences of program execution. An extensible framework constructs scenes, controls behaviors, and can render each camera view in different representations, such as coarse 3D, and bounding boxes. The benchmark covers first- and third-person perspectives, with synchronized multi-view observations available for a subset of episodes. Grounded in these records, PROWBench evaluates entity control, long-horizon memory, and, with two VLM-based metrics, Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate, adherence to the prescribed timeline and the visual realization of timestamped engine-recorded events.

</details>


### [172] [One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02207)
*Ramazan Fazylov,Stamatis Lefkimmiatis,Ivan Laptev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出GALA方法，通过线性近似和蒸馏技术，将3D Gaussian Avatar的昂贵神经推理替换为轻量级系数预测器，实现移动端60fps实时动画，推理成本降低三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决3D Gaussian Avatar在实时动画中因昂贵的神经推理导致的性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出GALA（Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation）蒸馏方法：1) 证明预训练Avatar动画可由身份无关的混合形状（blendshapes）线性组合近似；2) 使用基于渲染感知度量和内存预算的分块局部PCA构建基；3) 学习浅层MLP网络预测混合形状系数，替代逐帧重型神经解码。

Result: 在三种不同Avatar模型（面部表情及带服装动态的全身体）上验证，泛化至未见身份，CPU动画成本降低高达三个数量级，保留大部分渲染质量，在移动设备上达到最高60fps帧率。

Conclusion: 确认了所学Avatar表示中存在共享的线性结构，该方法实现了高效、准确的实时动画，适用于资源受限设备。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian avatars support fast rendering, however, their real-time animation is often challenged by the costly neural inference. We address this bottleneck and show that the animation of pretrained avatar models can be closely approximated by a linear combination of identity-independent blendshapes. Building on this finding, we introduce GALA (Gaussian Animation via Linear Approximation), a distillation method that replaces per-frame heavy neural decoding with a shallow coefficient predictor and a linear blend. To improve fidelity and reduce memory requirements, we propose to construct the basis using block-local PCA under a rendering-aware metric and a memory budget. Our method learns a shallow MLP network to predict blendshape coefficients and applies to various animation architectures without retraining original models. We validate GALA by accelerating the inference of three distinct avatar models for 3D animation of facial expressions and full-bodies with clothing dynamics. Across these models, our distillation generalizes to held-out identities and reduces CPU animation cost by up to three orders of magnitude while preserving most of the rendering quality. Excellent results of our method confirm the shared linear structure of learned avatar representations and enable highly efficient and accurate animation at frame rates reaching up to 60fps on mobile devices. Project page: https://ramazan793.github.io/gala/

</details>


### [173] [Sphere Encoder 2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02208)
*Kaiyu Yue,Sean McLeish,Ruchit Rawal,Brian Bartoldson,Menglin Jia,Tom Goldstein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sphere Encoder 2，通过解决原始模型中潜在空间点分布不均和像素级重建损失导致的模糊问题，显著提升了基于高维潜在球面解码的图像生成质量，同时保持了自编码器的速度与简洁性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始Sphere Encoder存在两个限制：1) 随机点在潜在空间中集中在赤道附近，而训练旋转未覆盖极点区域，导致一步生成能力受限；2) 像素级重建损失促使解码器对可能的图像取平均，产生缺乏高频细节的模糊图像。

Method: 提出Sphere Encoder 2架构，旨在解决上述两个局限性，优化潜在空间利用并改进重建策略以保留高频细节。

Result: 在保持自编码器速度和简洁性的同时，显著提高了图像生成的质量。代码已开源。

Conclusion: Sphere Encoder 2有效克服了原始模型的缺陷，为基于潜在球面的图像生成提供了一种更高质量且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Sphere Encoder is an autoencoder that generates images by decoding random points from a high-dimensional latent sphere. We identify two limitations of the original formulation that reduce its generation quality. First, random points concentrate near the equator relative to the pole on an encoded latent, but the training rotation never reaches this region, leaving a gap that limits one-step generation. Second, training for generation with pixel-wise reconstruction loss encourages the decoder to average over plausible images, producing blurry images that lack high-frequency details. We present Sphere Encoder 2 to address both limitations, substantially improving image generation quality while maintaining the speed and simplicity of a autoencoder. Models are released at \href{https://github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}{github.com/kaiyuyue/sphere2}.

</details>


### [174] [Moore, Escher, Penrose: A Conformal Golden Braid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02210)
*Sophia Feldman,Assaf Shocher*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于冻结文本到图像扩散模型的新方法，通过交织正向变换T和广义逆变换T†的去噪步骤，生成具有自referential（自我指涉）递归几何结构的图像，解决了传统后处理或提示词无法维持复杂几何约束的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受M.C. Escher 1956年版画《Print Gallery》中自我指涉几何结构的启发，旨在利用数学分析揭示其几何原理，并尝试在AI图像生成中重现此类递归、扭曲且结构连贯的视觉场景。

Method: 构建非可逆图像变换T的广义逆T†，利用Penrose恒等式TT†T=T形成幂等投影；设计一种“编织”策略，在扩散模型的采样过程中交替进行源空间（untwisted scene）和变换空间（transformed space）的去噪步骤，使场景发展与几何畸变同步进行。

Result: 成功生成了类似《Print Gallery》的自我指涉构图，实现了场景内容与几何扭曲的协同演化，克服了仅靠提示词、后处理或单纯在采样中应用变换所导致的结构断裂或几何漂移问题。

Conclusion: 通过在扩散去噪过程中整合几何变换及其逆变换，能够有效地生成具有复杂递归几何约束的高质量自指涉图像，为探索艺术风格与数学几何在生成式AI中的结合提供了新途径。

Abstract: I don't think I have ever done anything as peculiar in my life. Among other things, it shows a young man looking with interest at a print on the wall of an exhibition that features himself. How can this be? Perhaps I am not far removed from Einstein's curved universe.'' So wrote M.C. Escher about his 1956 lithograph Print Gallery. Nearly half a century later, a mathematical analysis related its geometry to an untwisted source image through a conformal power map $z \mapsto z^α$, $α\in \mathbb{C}$. Building on this construction, we use a frozen text-to-image diffusion model to generate new self-referential scenes. Prompting alone does not enforce the recursion, while a post-hoc transformation can leave structures poorly connected. Applying the transformation during sampling is also insufficient: the denoiser may "repair" the intended distortion or drift out of the prescribed geometry. We construct a generalized inverse $T^\dagger$ of the non-invertible image transformation $T$, adapted to its recursive constraint. In the idealized formulation, the Penrose identity $TT^\dagger T = T$ makes $TT^\dagger$ an idempotent projection onto geometrically admissible images. Yet denoising only the transformed image remains an out-of-distribution task, even with projection. We therefore braid denoising steps with $T$ and $T^\dagger$: source-space steps develop the untwisted scene, while transformed-space steps refine its appearance and connections in the final geometry. We generate Print Gallery-like compositions and explore further transformations. Rather than distorting a finished image, we let the scene and its distortion develop together.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [175] [On-Device Named-Entity Recognition: A Deployability Study of Accuracy, Cost, Reliability, and Confidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00007)
*Vinay Kumar Chaganti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估了本地部署的NER模型（传统标签器、编码器专家、生成式LLM）在准确性、延迟和输出有效性方面的表现，发现小型编码器在部署性上优于生成式LLM，且提出了基于LLM裁判的银标构建方法及置信度校准策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 满足命名实体识别（NER）在端侧部署的需求（无API、低延迟、数据本地化），解决 practitioners 关注的模型可部署性、无需人工标注的评估方法以及置信度可信度问题。

Method: 1. 对比9个系统（3种范式：spaCy, GLiNER, Qwen/DeepSeek系列LLM）；2. 使用RSS-News数据集，通过跨家族LLM裁判面板构建“银标”，并与基准金标及人工复核验证其保真度；3. 评估指标包括准确率、延迟和输出有效性；4. 分析GLiNER的单跨度置信度表现及温度缩放等校准方法。

Result: 1. 数据源影响排名：从LLM生成的银标转为人工金标后，编码器性能提升，生成式模型性能下降；2. 部署性优势：4B指令LLM在准确率上具有竞争力，但小型编码器以1/9至1/24的参数量实现毫秒级延迟，且零无效输出，而最小生成式模型在长输入下产生高达27%的无效输出；3. 置信度分析：GLiNER置信度与正确性相关性良好（AUROC 0.76-0.86），但存在过度自信（ECE 0.24-0.47），温度缩放可降低ECE，阈值调整带来小幅F1增益。

Conclusion: 对于本地部署场景，小型双向编码器在部署效率（速度、大小）和输出稳定性上优于生成式LLM，尽管后者在特定任务上准确率相当。研究者应关注输出有效性和置信度校准，而非仅看准确率榜单。

Abstract: Named-entity recognition (NER) is increasingly wanted on-device (no API, low latency, data kept local). The practitioner's question is not the leaderboard but which model is deployable, how to evaluate it without human annotation, and whether its confidence can be trusted. We answer these jointly. We place nine systems across three paradigms and 13 M to 8 B parameters: a classical tagger (spaCy), bidirectional-encoder specialists (GLiNER, 166 to 460 M), and generative LLMs run locally (Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B-Instruct, DeepSeek-R1-1.5B/8B), on three datasets of differing character, and report accuracy plus two axes the literature omits: latency and output validity. Because our corpus (RSS-News) had no gold, we built silver gold from a cross-family LLM judge panel, then measured its fidelity against benchmark gold and a full human re-validation of the corpus (strict F1 0.95, an upper bound since the human gold was silver-seeded); gold provenance flips the paradigm ranking, moving from LLM-authored silver to human gold raises every encoder and lowers every generative model. On accuracy alone a 4 B instruct LLM is competitive (it leads on clean newswire), so the encoder's case is deployability: it matches or slightly trails at one-ninth to one-twenty-fourth the size, at millisecond-to-second latency, with zero malformed output, while the smallest generative models emit up to 27% invalid output on long inputs, a failure fixed by scale, not output budget. We then characterize GLiNER's per-span confidence: it ranks correctness well (AUROC 0.76 to 0.86) but is overconfident (ECE 0.24 to 0.47, halved by temperature scaling); thresholding gives a small honest out-of-sample F1 gain; an all-local small-to-large cascade gives a modest, corpus-dependent gain over cost-matched random routing; and confidence tracks correctness but not novelty. Every number recomputes offline from per-span records.

</details>


### [176] [SCM-based Fairness and Faithful Explainability for Legal Document Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00045)
*Yasmina El Kacemi,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，在LegalBERT中通过去偏正则化提升公平性时，虽然未改变分类性能和人口统计学公平性，但显著降低了模型解释的忠实度（SHAP sufficiency）。这表明公平性与解释忠实度之间存在解耦，评估公平性需直接进行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer模型在法律决策支持中广泛应用，但其公平性和解释透明度通常被单独评估。本研究旨在探究去偏干预是否会影响模型解释对推理过程的忠实反映，特别是在改变公平性的同时是否改变了解释行为。

Method: 使用LexGLUE中的ECtHR涉嫌侵犯人权语料库，对比LegalBERT基线与一种在微调期间惩罚刻板印象温暖度和能力度表征的去偏变体。评估指标包括预测性能、人口统计学公平性和基于SHAP的解释忠实度，实验涵盖五个随机种子及两种公平性定义。

Result: 在最优化正则化强度下，干预措施未减少人口统计学差异（公平性保持不变），分类性能也基本不变。然而，该干预在所有五个种子和三个阈值下 consistently 降低了解释充分性（explanation sufficiency）。对照实验表明，这种退化源于对比表征正则化本身，而非特定的温暖度/能力度结构。

Conclusion: 公平性与解释忠实度之间存在解耦关系：解释行为的改变并不必然意味着公平性的变化。因此，必须直接评估公平性，而不能仅通过观察解释行为的变化来推断公平性的改善或恶化。

Abstract: Transformer models such as LegalBERT are increasingly used in legal decision support, raising concerns about both fairness and the transparency of model explanations. These properties are usually evaluated separately, leaving open whether a debiasing intervention that changes fairness also changes how faithfully explanations reflect model reasoning. This study investigates that relationship on the ECtHR alleged-violations corpus from LexGLUE. It compares a LegalBERT baseline with a fairness-regularized variant that penalizes stereotypical warmth and competence representations during fine-tuning. The evaluation covers predictive performance, demographic fairness, and SHAP explanation faithfulness across five random seeds. At the performance-optimal regularization strength, the intervention does not reduce demographic disparity. This null result holds across two fairness definitions and a conventional word-pair control on the gender axis. Classification performance is largely unchanged. However, the intervention consistently degrades explanation sufficiency across all five seeds and three thresholds. A shuffled-pair control reproduces this degradation while leaving performance and fairness unchanged, indicating that the effect arises from contrastive representational regularization rather than specifically from the warmth and competence structure. The results demonstrate a dissociation between fairness and explanation faithfulness: changes in explanation behavior do not necessarily indicate changes in fairness, and fairness must therefore be evaluated directly.

</details>


### [177] [The First Token Is Not the Verdict: Hidden Costs of Reading LLM Judges Without Generating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00054)
*Gnaneswar Villuri,Hashmath Shaik,Alex Doboli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 直接读取大语言模型（LLM）裁判首token logits来判定立场存在严重的位置偏差高估问题，建议报告“首token即判决”的比例以辅助评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估方法常通过读取生成第一个token的logits来获取LLM裁判的裁决，这种方法成本低且无需完整生成，但需验证其准确性及是否存在系统性偏差。

Method: 分析Qwen3和Llama-3.1等模型在924对样本上的表现，对比强制读取首token与完整生成后的位置偏差差异，并统计裁判是否以判决token开头的比例。

Result: 1. 强制读取首token会严重高估位置偏差（移动42个点），而实际生成仅影响不到1个点的准确率；2. 12%-49%的Qwen3样本中裁判不以判决开头，此时强制读取导致89.7%的结果随展示顺序翻转；3. Llama-3.1等模型该现象较少（<3%）。

Conclusion: 直接读取首token logits作为裁决依据会误导对裁判能力的审计，建议在报告位置偏差指标时，同时报告裁判首token即为判决的比例（仅需一次前向传播）。

Abstract: Reading an LLM judge's verdict from the logits of its first generated token is cheap, requires no generation, and is exactly what constrained decoding and likelihood-scoring evaluation harnesses produce. We show that this readout distorts position bias in one direction: it overstates it in every condition we test, so figures obtained this way behave as upper bounds. The mechanism is that judges do not always lead with a verdict token, on 12% to 49% of pairs for three Qwen3 judges and under 3% for Llama-3.1-8B and Phi-3.5-mini, and forcing a read on those pairs returns whichever response was shown first rather than a judgment. Pooled over the 924 pairs where a judge did not commit, the forced read flips on 89.7% of them when the responses are swapped, against 47.5% read after generation (paired difference +0.422, 95% CI [+0.365, +0.467]). The distortion is specific to what is measured: it moves position bias by 42 points while moving judge accuracy by under one point in seven of ten conditions, so it misleads whoever audits a judge rather than whoever uses one. A second, smaller failure occurs even when the judge does lead with a verdict token, since it sometimes opens with one letter and reasons its way to the other, on 0 to 5.5% of pairs at a rate uncorrelated with compliance. We recommend reporting the rate at which a judge leads with a verdict token, which costs one forward pass and no labels, alongside any position-bias figure.

</details>


### [178] [Measuring Human-Like Bias in LLMs? A Critique of Human-Derived Bias Constructs in LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00070)
*Antonela Tommasel,Markus Schedl*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批判了将人类中心化的偏见构建直接应用于大语言模型（LLM）评估的做法，指出了由此产生的推理鸿沟，并提出了一种分析框架以提供更合理的解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着研究者越来越多地使用源自人类的认知和社会偏见构建（如内隐偏见、锚定效应等）来研究LLM，虽然这提供了替代显式偏见探测的方法，但直接将人类心理测量工具应用于LLM存在显著的“推理鸿沟”，可能导致对模型偏见的误解或模糊解释。

Method: 1. 批判性分析：揭示了导致推理鸿沟的三个主要不匹配点：源自人类的构建本身、人与模型的差异、以及评估语境的不同。2. 提出框架：引入一个新的分析框架，通过关注目标构建、操作化定义、推理范围以及人类类比的局限性，为关联这些元素并提供 warranted interpretations（有根据的解释）提供分析视角。

Result: 明确了在LLM评估中直接借用人类偏见构建所带来的解释模糊性问题；确立了一个能够更严谨地连接模型行为与偏见构建的理论框架，强调了区分不同解释的重要性。

Conclusion: 在使用人类偏见构建评估LLM时，必须谨慎处理推理鸿沟。提出的框架有助于更准确地界定模型偏见的性质和范围，避免简单类比带来的误导，为未来LLM偏见评估提供了方法论指导。

Abstract: Researchers increasingly use human-derived bias constructs to study Large Language Models (LLMs), including social-cognitive constructs such as implicit bias and stereotype activation, and cognitive biases such as anchoring, framing effects, and confirmation bias. Such approaches offer alternatives to overt bias probes, particularly when direct questioning may obscure bias or when model behaviour appears normatively acceptable. However, adapting human bias constructs to LLMs introduces an inferential gap. Psychological instruments were developed to study human cognition and social behaviour, whereas LLM evaluations rely on probabilities, text completions, rankings, or simulated decisions. This paper critiques human-centered bias evaluation in LLMs. We show how this gap arises from mismatches pertaining to human-derived constructs, human-model differences, and evaluation contexts, which can blur distinct interpretations of model bias. We then introduce a framework providing an analytical lens for relating these elements to warranted interpretations, with attention to target constructs, operationalizations, scope of inference, and limits of human analogy.

</details>


### [179] [Legal text classification in Korean sexual offense cases: from traditional machine learning to large language models with XAI insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00087)
*Jeongmin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估了多种NLP模型在韩语性犯罪判例分类中的表现，发现经过领域微调的小规模模型（KLUE-BERT）优于大型通用模型和传统机器学习方法。结合可解释AI（XAI）分析揭示了模型在处理隐含语境线索时的局限性，强调了领域适应性和模型透明度在法律AI中的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律文本复杂且类别间差异细微，导致法律文档的准确分类具有挑战性；旨在探索不同规模和技术类型的模型在法律分类任务中的性能，并解决模型决策的可解释性问题。

Method: 使用包含十个类别的韩国性犯罪判例数据集，对比评估从传统机器学习到大型语言模型（LLMs）的各类文本分类模型。特别针对小规模模型KLUE-BERT进行法律数据微调，并应用可解释AI（XAI）技术分析预测结果、误分类案例及关键语言特征。此外，使用接近真实世界记录的KICS数据评估模型的泛化能力。

Result: 1. 微调后的小规模模型KLUE-BERT准确率高达99.3%，显著优于GPT-3.5/4.0等通用大模型及传统机器学习模型。
2. XAI分析识别出影响模型决策的语言特征，并指出模型在捕捉微妙文本线索方面的局限。
3. 在泛化能力测试中，模型难以解释隐含的语境线索。

Conclusion: 在法律文档分类中，领域适应性和微调比模型规模更为重要。同时，结合XAI提升透明度对于理解模型局限性和辅助法律专业人士（如文档分类、信息检索和案件评估）至关重要。

Abstract: The advancement of natural language processing (NLP) has expanded AI-based text classification in the legal domain. However, accurately classifying legal documents remains challenging due to the complexity of legal texts and subtle differences between legal categories. This study evaluates legal text classification models ranging from traditional machine learning techniques to large language models (LLMs) using ten categories of Korean sexual offense precedents. The results show that fine-tuning small-scale models such as KLUE-BERT on legal data outperforms general-purpose models such as GPT-3.5 and GPT-4.0, as well as traditional machine learning models. KLUE-BERT achieved the highest accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that domain adaptation and fine-tuning can be more important than model size for legal document classification. We further employ explainable AI (XAI) techniques to analyze model predictions and misclassification cases. XAI analysis identifies linguistic features influencing model decisions and limitations in capturing subtle textual cues. Using KICS data, which closely resembles real-world legal case records, we further evaluate the model's generalization capabilities and find that it struggles to interpret implicit contextual cues. These findings highlight the importance of both performance and interpretability in legal AI and demonstrate how XAI can improve transparency in legal text classification. AI-assisted tools can support legal professionals in tasks including document classification, legal information retrieval, and case assessment.

</details>


### [180] [BudgetSchemaBench: A Budget-Swept Diagnostic for Schema Context in Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00092)
*Chen Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出BudgetSchemaBench诊断工具，评估结构化数据源中Schema上下文预算对LLM执行准确率的影响。发现当检索受覆盖率限制时，增加Schema预算比优化序列化格式更能提升性能；密集检索器在小预算下已能覆盖大部分表，且模型具备从参数知识重构缺失Schema的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大型数据库目录（数千列）超出模型上下文窗口的问题。在成本约束下，需在表覆盖率与序列化细节之间进行权衡，缺乏针对此场景的执行导向诊断基准。

Method: 构建BudgetSchemaBench：基于80个数据库的合并目录，机械地从黄金SQL生成相关性标签。设置四种Schema上下文预算，比较三种表示方式，固定检索器的表排序。包含端到端检索、冻结黄金表（保证所需表可用）及移除所需表的探测三种条件，并通过源命名空间检查排除错误数据库产生的正确答案。

Result: 1. 在词汇检索下，将预算从2.5%提升至50%，执行准确率提高18个百分点；而在密集检索下仅提高3点（因小预算已覆盖大部分表）。2. 移除所需表后，94.6%的正确预测仍能精确命名这些表，表明模型能从参数知识重构缺失Schema。3. 在冻结黄金条件下，不同表示方式的差异不超过2个百分点。

Conclusion: 当检索受覆盖率限制时，执行准确率对Schema预算的敏感度高于对序列化格式的敏感度。该诊断工具及代码已公开，为Schema压缩与检索策略提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Data agents over structured sources must fit database schema into the model's context window. Large catalogs can span many databases and thousands of columns, so cost constraints may require choosing between table coverage and serialization detail well before the context window is full. We introduce BudgetSchemaBench, an execution-grounded diagnostic for this setting. Its construction derives relevance labels mechanically from gold SQL, without human- or LLM-authored ground truth. Using a pooled 80-database catalog, we sweep four schema-context budgets and compare three representations while keeping each retriever's table ranking fixed. A source-namespace check rejects queries that obtain the correct result from the wrong database. The evaluation covers three conditions: end-to-end retrieval; frozen-gold, in which the required tables are guaranteed; and a probe that removes those tables. For the primary solver with raw serialization, raising the budget from 2.5% to 50% of the catalog improves execution accuracy on 1,279 held-out questions by 18 percentage points under lexical retrieval but only 3 under dense retrieval; the dense retriever already finds most required tables at the smallest budget. When the required tables are removed, 94.6% of correct predictions name one of them exactly, consistent with reconstruction of absent schema from parametric knowledge. For the two main solvers in the frozen-gold condition, the three representations differ by at most 2 percentage points, and the widest paired 95% confidence interval bounds the difference within +/-4 points. We observe the same qualitative patterns with one reasoning model from a different family. When retrieval is coverage-limited, execution accuracy is more sensitive to the schema budget than to the tested serializations. The diagnostic and the code used to construct and evaluate it are publicly available.

</details>


### [181] [FACET at WMT 2026 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00096)
*Ahrii Kim,Chanjun Park,Seong-heum Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FACET，一种无需训练组件的参考自由机器翻译评估框架，通过提示单一固定模型进行流畅度、准确性和一致性三次传递，分别利用源文本或目标文本上下文来检测特定错误类型，并生成错误跨度、质量分数和标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同错误类型需要不同的证据：意义保留需对照源文本判断，而目标文本的语法良好性或实体命名一致性仅需目标文本即可判断。现有方法难以灵活适配这种差异。

Method: 构建FACET系统，将评估分解为流畅度（Fluency）、准确性（Accuracy）和一致性（Consistency）三个独立传递阶段。每个阶段仅使用其所需错误类型的上下文（源文本或目标文本）。使用单一固定模型进行三次提示，合并产生的错误跨度以输出任务结果。同时提交简化版FACET-C（省略一致性传递）。

Result: 在无金标准标签情况下对预测进行了特征描述。系统排名显示人工编辑后的翻译位列第一。一致性传递更改了约十分之一的片段评分，但几乎未改变整体排名。

Conclusion: FACET通过解耦评估维度并针对性地提供上下文，实现了有效的无参考翻译质量评估，证明了基于固定模型提示的方法在无需训练的情况下也能产生有意义的评估结果。

Abstract: Different error types in machine translation require different evidence. Whether meaning is preserved can be judged only against the source, while whether the target is well-formed, or whether it names one entity consistently, can be judged from the target alone. We present FACET, our reference-free submission to the WMT26 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Task, which decomposes evaluation into Fluency, Accuracy, and Consistency passes and gives each pass only the context its error type requires. A single fixed model is prompted three times, and the merged error spans yield the three task outputs, error spans, quality scores, and error-free labels, with no trained components. We also submit FACET-C, which omits the Consistency pass. Without gold labels, we characterize the predictions of FACET. Its system rankings place post-edited human translation first, and the Consistency pass changes about a tenth of segment scores while leaving the ranking nearly unchanged.

</details>


### [182] [Metric-Construction Coupling Inflates Measured Synthetic Dialect Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00164)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过构建KoDialectBench基准测试，评估了合成数据在恢复韩语方言监督信号方面的有效性。研究发现，传统的基于标记词汇的生成指标会因训练与评估数据重叠而严重高估合成数据的恢复效果；只有在排除这种构造依赖后，才能真实反映模型对区域识别和语言理解的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 韩国方言语料库存在但不可重新分发，导致无法直接复现基于原始数据的训练和评估。研究人员希望量化合成数据能在多大程度上恢复这些监督信号，并探索一种独立于合成流程的方法来衡量这种恢复程度，以避免评估偏差。

Method: 1. 提出KoDialectBench：包含五个地区、三个轴线的1,000项测试集，以标识符哈希和评分代码形式发布，允许用户从自有许可副本重构项目。
2. 对比实验：比较最佳合成臂与真实数据增益在区域识别和理解上的表现。
3. 指标分析：使用部署的标记词汇（marker lexicon）评估方言性（dialectness）和区域匹配度，并与基于参考的生成结果对比。
4. 构造访问测试：设计一个精确形式构造不相交的实验组，从规则中扣留20%的标记类型，以测试构造访问对结果的影响。
5. 定义度量-构造覆盖率（MCC）：通过评估器扫描，分析随着MCC从0增加到1，测得的方言性恢复程度的变化趋势。

Result: 1. 恢复效果存在轴线依赖性：最佳合成臂在区域识别上达到真实数据增益的91.2%，但在理解上仅为63.7%。
2. 生成指标差异显著：标记词汇报告方言性为92.3%，区域匹配为119.3%（超过真实数据参考），而基于参考的生成仅为72.4%。
3. 构造依赖导致高估：当扣留20%标记类型时，方言性恢复从91.8%骤降至8.1%，区域匹配恢复从101.9%降至25.6%，而三个独立于管道的测量值未下降。
4. MCC影响：测得的方言性恢复随MCC增加单调上升，表明共享构造和评估库存会大幅 inflate（膨胀）合成数据恢复的估计值。

Conclusion: 传统的基于标记词汇的评估指标由于训练规则和评估库存的高度重叠，会严重高估合成数据在方言任务上的恢复能力。为了实现更公正、独立的评估，必须减少合成管道与评估标准之间的构造共享，否则得出的恢复率估计将缺乏可信度。

Abstract: Korean dialect corpora are available but not redistributable: weights may be released, while reproducing training and evaluation from the underlying data cannot be. We ask how much of that supervision synthetic data recovers, and whether that recovery can be measured independently of the synthesis pipeline. We contribute KoDialectBench, 1,000 items across five regions on three axes, released as identifier hashes and scoring code so users reconstruct the items from their own licensed copy. Recovery is strongly axis-dependent: our best synthetic arm reaches 91.2% of the real-data gain on region identification but 63.7% on comprehension. On generation the answer depends on the metric: the deployed marker lexicon reports 92.3% on dialectness and 119.3% on region match, the latter exceeding the real-data reference, whereas reference-based generation reaches 72.4%. We find the marker metrics' scoring inventory is entirely contained in the inventory our transformation rules can emit. We test the effect of construction access directly with an exact-form construction-disjoint arm that withholds 20% of marker types from the rules. At exactly matched training size (8,600 examples) it reduces dialectness recovery from 91.8% to 8.1% and region-match recovery from 101.9% to 25.6% on the held-out marker inventory, while the three pipeline-independent measurements do not fall at all. A complementary evaluator sweep defines metric-construction coverage (MCC) and finds measured dialectness recovery increasing monotonically as overlap rises from MCC=0 to MCC=1. Shared construction and evaluation inventories can therefore substantially inflate estimates of synthetic-data recovery.

</details>


### [183] [When a Data Artifact Isn't a Shortcut: Causal Auditing of Synthetic RLVR Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00202)
*Esther Xin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文审计了RLVR训练数据中“正确答案为人类文本、干扰项为合成文本”这一不对称性是否会被模型利用。通过分类器分析和干预实验发现，尽管存在可检测的统计信号（尤其在代码领域），但在固定预算下，模型并未利用该信号进行作弊，证明数据构造的对称性设计在现有条件下是安全的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期RLVR训练方法通过掩码真实语料并让语言模型生成错误选项来构建数据，导致正确答案具有真实性（genuine human prose），而干扰项均为合成内容。这种正确性与来源的纠缠可能导致策略模型学习到的是“哪个选项更像人类写的”而非“哪个选项是正确的”，从而产生评估偏差。

Method: 1. **表面统计分类**：仅使用5种表面统计特征（不涉及语义）构建分类器，在315,499个选项中测试区分真假的能力。
2. **人工检查与异常分析**：针对表现不佳的代码领域进行深入分析，发现代码干扰项仅是单算子变异，与正确答案高度相似。
3. **干预实验**：构建词法匹配的对照语料库，保持训练集大小和计算预算一致，对比原始数据与控制组训练出的策略模型的利用差距（exploitation gap）。

Result: 1. 整体AUROC为0.562，略高于随机水平；但代码领域AUROC仅为0.416（低于随机），因为代码干扰项与正确答案构造上过于相似。
2. 干预实验显示，未修改数据组的利用差距为0.021，对照组为0.027。这表明在给定预算下，可检测的数据伪影未被模型利用。

Conclusion: 尽管数据中存在可检测的不对称性信号，且在某些领域（如代码）构造上存在缺陷，但在当前训练条件下，模型并未利用这些信号进行作弊。研究建议任何构建此类语料库的人都应关注这种解耦现象及领域特定的构造问题，并发布了基于CPU的低成本审计协议。

Abstract: Several recent pipelines build RLVR training data by masking a span of real corpus text and asking a language model to invent plausible wrong answers around it. The correct option is therefore genuine human prose; every distractor is synthetic. Correctness and provenance become entangled, and a policy could in principle learn the second instead of the first. We audit that possibility in GooseReason-0.7M. First we ask whether the asymmetry is visible at all: a classifier reading only five surface statistics (never the meaning) reaches AUROC 0.562 over 315,499 options, barely above chance. The aggregate hides something, though. Code sits at 0.416, below chance, and manual inspection explains why: code distractors turn out to be single-operator mutations of the gold answer rather than freely written alternatives, so the two classes are nearly identical by construction. Detecting a signal is not the same as showing a model uses it, so we then run an intervention. We build a paraphrase-matched control corpus, hold training-set size identical across arms, and train two policies under one fixed budget. The exploitation gap does not favour the unmodified-data arm: 0.021 against 0.027 for the control. Under our budget, in other words, a detectable artifact went unexploited. We think that dissociation, along with the domain-specific construction finding, is worth knowing for anyone curating corpora of this kind, and we release the audit as a mostly CPU-only protocol.

</details>


### [184] [A Holistic Assessment of the Carbon Footprint of Noor, a Very Large Arabic Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00223)
*Imad Lakim,Ebtesam Almazrouei,Ibrahim Abu Alhaol,Merouane Debbah,Julien Launay*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）的环境影响，提出了一种对极端规模阿拉伯语模型Noor的全生命周期碳足迹评估方法。研究指出，传统的碳排放报告仅关注训练阶段，而本研究发现推理成本和外部因素对总预算有显著影响，并提出了降低碳足迹的路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大型语言模型日益普及，其巨大的资源消耗和碳足迹受到批评。尽管机器学习论文中关于碳排放的报告增多，但通常仅限于计算资源的训练阶段，缺乏对模型全生命周期的全面评估。

Method: 构建了一个全面的评估框架，用于衡量极端规模语言模型Noor的总碳账单。评估范围涵盖数据收集与存储、研发预算、预训练成本、未来服务（推理）估算以及国际合作所需的其他外部成本。

Result: 通过对Noor项目（旨在开发多达130亿参数的多任务阿拉伯语大模型）的全面评估发现，推理成本和外部因素对总碳预算的影响显著，远超仅关注训练阶段的传统评估结果。

Conclusion: 为了应对极端规模模型的环境影响，必须采用holistic（整体/全生命周期）视角来评估碳足迹，识别关键排放源（如推理和外部成本），并据此制定减少碳足迹的具体路径和策略。

Abstract: As ever larger language models grow more ubiquitous, it is crucial to consider their environmental impact. Characterised by extreme size and resource use, recent generations of models have been criticised for their voracious appetite for compute, and thus significant carbon footprint. Although reporting of carbon impact has grown more common in machine learning papers, this reporting is usually limited to compute resources used strictly for training. In this work, we propose a holistic assessment of the footprint of an extreme-scale language model, Noor. Noor is an ongoing project aiming to develop the largest multi-task Arabic language models -- with up to 13B parameters -- leveraging zero-shot generalisation to enable a wide range of downstream tasks via natural language instructions. We assess the total carbon bill of the entire project: starting with data collection and storage costs, including research and development budgets, pretraining costs, future serving estimates, and other exogenous costs necessary for this international cooperation. Notably, we find that inference costs and exogenous factors can have a significant impact on total budget. Finally, we discuss pathways to reduce the carbon footprint of extreme-scale models.

</details>


### [185] [CAVE-Mem: Boundary-Aware Experience Validation for Memory Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00238)
*Xinyu Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CAVE-Mem框架，通过类型化干预算子解决长程记忆代理中经验复用相关性与适用性不匹配的问题，实现基于条件匹配的精准经验注入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验-记忆系统主要优化相关性检索，但仅凭表面相似性检索过去的经验可能导致有害结果，因为记忆底物、问题意图、答案粒度或证据边界可能发生变化。

Method: 提出无训练框架CAVE-Mem，将经验表示为带有适用性、边界和效用条件的类型化干预算子。首先获取基础记忆搜索答案，然后仅在算子与当前底物、答案契约、证据边界及交叉拟合效用完全匹配时才允许修改答案，否则系统拒绝介入。

Result: 在长期对话记忆、多跳问答和长文档叙事推理实验中，该方法相比仅依赖相关性的经验复用策略，均展现出一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过引入严格的条件匹配机制而非单纯的相关性检索，能有效提升长程记忆代理中经验复用的安全性和准确性。

Abstract: Long-term memory agents increasingly rely on it- erative search and reusable experience to answer questions over large personal, factual, or narrative histories. However, current experience-memory systems largely optimize relevance: they re- trieve past search lessons that appear similar to the current state and inject them into the prompt. A relevant experience can still be harmful when the memory substrate, question intent, answer granularity, or evidence boundary changes. We propose CAVE- Mem, a training-free framework that represents experience as a typed intervention operator with applicability, boundary, and utility conditions. CAVE-Mem first obtains a base memory-search answer, then allows an operator to change it only if the oper- ator matches the current substrate, answer contract, evidence boundary, and cross-fitted utility; otherwise the system abstains. Experiments across long-term conversational memory, multi-hop question answering, and long-document narrative reasoning show consistent gains over relevance-only experience reuse.

</details>


### [186] [JoinGR: Learning to Traverse Join Graphs for Table Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01064)
*Sandipan De,Abhijit Chakraborty,Sambaran Bandyopadhyay,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出JOINGR，一种基于数据库连接图的表格检索方法，通过利用表间的连接关系提升Text-to-SQL中的表格召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有密集表格检索器独立对模式元素进行排名，忽略了关键证据：某些所需表未在问题中提及，仅能通过其与已相关表的连接关系来识别。

Method: 将数据库连接图作为检索空间，列表示为节点，表内和主外键关系表示为类型化边。给定问题后，选择语义相似的锚点表，使用查询条件评分器遍历连接边，并将边缘沉积聚合为表分数。评分器是基于冻结嵌入的轻量级MLP，使用成对边际损失训练。

Result: 在BIRD和Spider数据集上具有竞争力；在BEAVER基准测试上显著提高了密集检索和重排序基线的召回率；跨域实验表明该方法具有可迁移性。

Conclusion: JOINGR通过捕获可复用的连接图遍历行为，有效解决了复杂数据库中多跳表检索的问题。

Abstract: Retrieving the right tables is a prerequisite for Text-to-SQL over realistic databases. Dense table retrievers rank schema elements independently, but this ignores a key source of evidence: some required tables are not mentioned in the question and become identifiable only through their join relationships to already relevant tables. We introduce JOINGR, a join-aware table retrieval method that treats the database join graph as the retrieval space. Columns are represented as graph nodes, while intra-table and foreign-key relationships are represented as typed edges. Given a question, JOINGR selects semantically similar anchor tables, traverses join edges with a query-conditioned scorer, and aggregates the resulting edge deposits into table scores. The scorer is a lightweight MLP on top of frozen query, node, and edge embeddings, trained with a pairwise margin loss over gold tables. On BIRD and Spider datasets, JOINGR is competitive with the strongest retrieval baselines. On BEAVER, a challenging enterprise benchmark with multi-hop table requirements, JOINGR substantially improves recall over dense retrieval and re-ranking baselines.
