Cross-domain experiments show that the learned scorer transfers across benchmarks, indicating that the method captures reusable joingraph traversal behavior.

</details>


### [187] [Signed Lexical Confidence for Risk-Calibrated Intent Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00262)
*Yezhou Cheng,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种结合句子分类器logit边际和稀疏词汇模型支持的有符号词汇门控机制，用于增强意图路由的可信度校准，在多个数据集上显著降低风险-覆盖曲线面积并提高接受覆盖率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准置信度分数主要反映基础模型的表示，未能充分利用互补证据；现有方法（如无符号词汇置信度或硬性一致规则）信息保留不足，导致在不改变基础决策的前提下难以有效整合额外证据以提升预测可靠性。

Method: 引入有符号词汇门控（signed lexical gate），通过正证据（词汇与预测意图一致）和负证据（词汇支持竞争意图）结合句子分类器的logit边际与稀疏词汇模型的支持度；采用独立的二项式校准阶段为指定风险目标选择操作阈值。

Result: 在BANKING77、CLINC150和HWU64数据集的十次运行中，所提分数相比仅学习语义的门控，风险-覆盖曲线下面积分别减少15.8%、15.1%和11.8%；在5%错误目标下，BANKING77和HWU64的接受覆盖率分别提升1.83和5.14个百分点；在2%严格目标下，所有30个数据集-运行组合均产生非空策略。

Conclusion: 该双特征门控提供了一种紧凑、可解释的置信度增强方案，实现了风险校准的意图路由，同时保留了基础分类器的原始预测，优于无符号词汇置信度和二元一致性控制。

Abstract: Selective intent routing allows an assistant to act on reliable predictions while deferring uncertain requests. Standard confidence scores primarily reflect the base model's representation, leaving an opportunity to incorporate complementary evidence without changing its decisions. We introduce a signed lexical gate that combines a sentence classifier's logit margin with a sparse lexical model's support for the classifier's predicted intent. By assigning positive evidence to lexical agreement and negative evidence to a lexically favored competing intent, the gate retains more information than either unsigned lexical confidence or a hard agreement rule. An independent binomial calibration stage selects an operating threshold for a specified risk target. Across ten runs on BANKING77, CLINC150, and HWU64, the proposed score reduces area under the risk-coverage curve by 15.8%, 15.1%, and 11.8% relative to a learned semantic-only gate. At a nominal 5% error target, it increases accepted coverage by 1.83 and 5.14 percentage points on BANKING77 and HWU64, while CLINC150 is already near full coverage. At a stricter 2% target, the simultaneous binomial procedure yields a nonempty policy in all 30 dataset-run combinations at the available calibration budgets. Matched controls show that the proposed feature improves average error ranking over the tested unsigned lexical-confidence feature, with dataset-dependent gains over binary agreement. The resulting two-feature gate provides a compact, interpretable confidence enhancement for risk-calibrated intent routing while preserving the base classifier's predictions.

</details>


### [188] [Madeleine: Learning Involuntary Recall for Conversational Memory from Simulated Lives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01118)
*Zhiyun Shi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Madeleine，一种通过离线模拟人类生活学习“可学习的关联性”来优化长期对话记忆检索的系统。它无需在线LLM调用，仅替换查询编码器即可接入现有向量记忆库，在LoCoMo-Plus基准测试中显著提升了检索性能并大幅降低了上下文开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长期对话助手依赖大型语言模型（LLM）在写入或读取时进行推理以回忆关键记忆，这导致高昂的计算成本（每次记忆库需数百至数千次LLM调用，每查询数千个上下文token）。核心问题在于，最重要的记忆往往与用户当前输入不相似，传统相似度匹配失效。

Method: 引入Madeleine系统，采用“摊销关联”（amortized association）方法：1) 离线阶段：使用LLM生命模拟器生成模拟生活轨迹，利用提示-触发对（cue-trigger pairs）训练查询编码器，使其在冻结的相似度基础上学习残差关联；2) 在线阶段：无需调用LLM，直接替换现有向量记忆系统中的查询编码器即可运行。

Result: 在LoCoMo-Plus官方协议下评估：(I) 结合HyperMem使用时达到66.6分，为所有系统中最高；(II) 单独使用时得分52.4（接近原版HyperMem的52.9），但零LLM调用且上下文减少约21倍；(III) 使T-Mem提升26.2分，显著优于未训练的相同骨干网络，且在4B骨干网络上保持普通问答能力不变。

Conclusion: 将记忆关联视为一种可学习的概率相关性（点互信息），而非单纯的语义相似度，能够高效解决长期记忆检索中的关键记忆召回问题。Madeleine证明了通过离线预训练查询编码器，可以在消除在线LLM推理成本的同时，实现超越现有SOTA系统的检索精度和效率。

Abstract: A long-term conversational assistant must recall the right memory at the right moment, yet the memory that matters most is often not similar to what the user says now. Current systems recover such associations by letting an LLM reason at write or read time, at a cost of hundreds to over a thousand LLM calls per memory bank and up to several thousand context tokens per query. We argue that association is a learnable relevance: the pointwise mutual information of memories under how human lives unfold. We introduce Madeleine, which learns amortized association: offline, an LLM life simulator writes simulated lives, whose cue-trigger pairs teach a query encoder a residual association on top of frozen similarity; online, it calls no LLM and plugs into any vector memory by replacing only the query encoder. On LoCoMo-Plus under the official protocol, Madeleine (I) reaches 66.6 when plugged into HyperMem, the highest among all systems evaluated under this protocol; (II) used alone, reaches the score of HyperMem as released (52.4 vs. 52.9) with zero LLM calls and about 1/21 of its answer context; and (III) lifts T-Mem by 26.2 points, significantly outperforms the same untrained backbone inside both systems, and leaves ordinary QA intact on the 4B backbone.

</details>


### [189] [Can LLMs Reliably Annotate Bioassay Metadata to Improve Data Readiness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01616)
*Laura van Weesep,Riccardo Tedoldi,Jens Sjölund,Hossein Azizpour,Susanne Winiwarter,Ola Engkvist,Jon Paul Janet,Samuel Genheden,Juan Viguera Diez*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 针对PubChem中生物测定元数据注释严重缺失的问题，研究评估了开源和专有大型语言模型（LLMs）在预测和审计这些注释方面的可靠性。结果表明LLM具有高精度，能有效辅助大规模元数据标注与纠错，但需结合人工审核以确保下游机器学习管道的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子性质预测的基础模型需要高质量的数据准备，包括可靠的元数据注释。然而，现有的公共库和工业筛选数据库存在大量缺失、不一致或混淆的测定注释，亟需自动化的测试-元数据策展方法来解决这一瓶颈。

Method: 1. 量化PubChem中约200万个生物测定的BioAssay Ontology (BAO)格式和物理检测方法字段的注释缺失程度。
2. 使用源自PubChem和ChEMBL的评估集，评估七种开源及专有LLM与现有“银标准”标签的一致性。
3. 通过手动检查和与资深工业策展人的定性研究，分析LLM预测结果与专家判断的差异及其原因。

Result: 1. PubChem注释覆盖率极低：36%缺乏测定格式，89%缺乏BioAssay类型，超过99.9%缺乏BAO映射术语。
2. LLM在生化及细胞基测定格式上的召回率至少为0.96；许多LLM与银标准的差异源于银标准本身的不一致而非LLM错误。
3. LLM生成的证据促使专家修正了部分自身标签，证明其具备发现潜在错误标签的能力。
4. 专有模型与开源模型之间的性能差异很小。

Conclusion: LLMs能够支持大规模 assay 元数据的标注和审计工作。然而，在进入下游机器学习管道之前，仍需要进行每类可靠性的估算以及针对性的**人工审查**，以确保证据的准确性。

Abstract: The emergence of foundation models for molecular property prediction requires a high degree of AI data readiness, including reliable metadata annotation. However, both public repositories and industrial screening databases suffer from missing, inconsistent, or conflated assay annotations. In this work, we quantify the extent of missing annotations in PubChem for the BioAssay Ontology (BAO) assay format and physical detection method fields and investigate whether open-source and proprietary large language models (LLMs) can reliably predict and audit metadata annotations directly from the assay text. In our assessment, we found that the annotation coverage across PubChem's $\sim$2 million bioassays is critically sparse, 36\% lacking an assay format, 89\% a BioAssay type, and >99.9\% any BAO-mapped assay format or detection technology term. This motivates the need for automated test-metadata curation. Using evaluation sets derived from PubChem and ChEMBL, we assess the agreement of seven open-source and proprietary LLMs with existing silver labels. Recall is at least 0.96 for biochemical and cell-based assay formats, with a similar pattern for detection technology, although disagreements increase on under-represented classes. Manual inspection shows that many of these disagreements trace back to inconsistencies between silver sources rather than to LLM error. Moreover, in a qualitative study with a senior industrial curator, LLM-generated evidence prompted the expert to revise some of their own labels, showing LLMs can flag potentially mislabeled assays. Across the study, performance differences between proprietary and open-source models were small. Together, these results suggest LLMs can support the large-scale annotation and auditing of assay metadata, though per-class reliability estimates and targeted human review remain necessary before such labels enter downstream ML pipelines.

</details>


### [190] [Certainty Is Not Just Correctness: Rethinking Token-Level Certainty in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00296)
*Yunfan Zhou,Ye Zhu,Zhihai Wang,Jianguo Yao,Haibing Guan,Xijun Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过实证评估指出，LLM中的token级确定性分数在预测“模型更可能答对的问题”方面优于区分“同一问题的对错回答”。信息分布具有位置特异性：问题难度信息出现在生成早期，而答案正确性信息集中在末尾。基于此发现提出的动态分配策略（早期用确定性决定响应数量，晚期用确定性加权投票），在固定采样多数投票基线基础上，将准确率从78.71%提升至79.54%，同时降低82.4%的生成Token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管token级确定性常被用作LLM训练和推理中正确性的代理指标，但其性能依赖于分数包含的信息量及使用方式。现有研究缺乏对确定性预测能力的直接、受控实证评估，且未充分探讨其在不同预测目标和token位置上的表现差异。

Method: 1. 构建受控实验，跨模型和任务直接评估确定性的预测能力。
2. 区分两种预测目标：(a) 识别模型更可能答对的问题；(b) 区分对同一问题的正确与错误回答。
3. 分析确定性在不同token类型、词内位置及生成阶段的信息分布特征。
4. 提出并验证一种结合确定性信息的测试时计算优化策略：早期根据确定性分配响应数量，晚期根据确定性加权答案投票。

Result: 1. 确定性在识别“易答对问题”方面的表现优于区分“具体回答的对错”。
2. 确定性随token类型和位置系统变化：问题难度信息在生成早期出现，答案正确性信息集中在末尾。
3. 确定性提供的信息价值取决于预测目标、模型、度量方法及聚合的token位置。
4. 实践应用：新策略相比固定采样多数投票基线，准确率提升（78.71% → 79.54%），生成Token成本降低82.4%。

Conclusion: token级确定性并非均匀有效的正确性代理，其效用高度依赖于具体的预测任务和token位置。合理利用确定性在不同生成阶段的信息分布特性，可以在显著降低计算成本的同时提升推理准确性，为高效LLM推理提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Token-level certainty is widely used as a proxy for correctness in LLM training and inference. However, the performance of certainty-based methods depends both on the information in certainty scores and on how those scores are used. We therefore directly assess certainty's predictive ability through controlled empirical evaluations across models and tasks. We distinguish two prediction targets: identifying questions a model is more likely to answer correctly and distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. In our experiments, certainty is generally better at identifying questions a model is likely to answer correctly than at distinguishing correct from incorrect responses to the same question. Certainty also varies systematically across token types and positions within words, reflecting local properties of words and text form. Information about question difficulty appears early in generation, while the weaker information about answer correctness is more concentrated near the end. These findings show that the information certainty provides for decisions depends on the prediction target, the model, the certainty metric, and which token positions in the response are included in aggregation. We further demonstrate the practical value of these findings for test-time compute. We allocate the number of responses using certainty early in generation and weight answer votes using certainty near the end of each response. Compared with a fixed-sampling majority-voting baseline, this approach increases overall accuracy from 78.71\% to 79.54\% while reducing generated-token cost by 82.4\%.

</details>


### [191] [Argo-Bench: Evaluating Data Agents on Enterprise-Scale Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02122)
*Gabriel Tomitsuka,Arman Raayatsanati,Emma Xing,Duke Gand,Joseph J Ma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文介绍了Argo-Bench，一个包含210个数据科学和分析任务的评估框架。该框架模拟了纽约市食品配送平台的真实规模（8100万订单、235张表、75亿行数据），旨在解决现有文本到SQL基准测试仅关注查询生成且答案常出错的问题。Argo-Bench要求智能体在ERP仓库中导航并重建事实，然后执行如封禁欺诈账户等具体操作，通过模拟器后果评分。目前最强模型仅在34.8%的任务上得分95以上，平均分为59.5，表明当前AI在复杂企业数据环境中的理解和行动能力仍有巨大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的文本到SQL基准测试主要评估单一表的查询生成，而现实企业数据分析工作流涉及跨数十张表的推理、统计分析并采取行动。此外，现有基准测试的答案键常被审计发现存在错误，且真实企业数据因敏感性无法公开，导致现有基准缺乏真实性和复杂性。

Method: 构建了Argo-Bench评估框架，利用公共数据、行业文献和监管文件，模拟了一个具有真实经济基础、欺诈模式和激励措施的食品配送平台。将模拟世界导出为基于Oracle E-Business Suite模式的ERP仓库（235张表，75亿行）。任务设计为：智能体需先导航仓库重建事实，再执行具体动作（如封号、分配预算），并通过模拟器中的后果进行评分。每个任务都有可执行的参考解决方案。

Result: 对14个前沿和开源权重模型的测试显示，最强的模型仅在34.8%的任务上获得95分或更高，平均得分为59.5分。这表明当前最先进的模型在处理需要跨表推理、导航及采取行动的复杂企业级数据任务时表现不佳。

Conclusion: Argo-Bench提供了一个更接近真实企业数据环境的评估标准，揭示了当前AI代理在理解、导航和操作复杂数据环境方面的不足。该框架有望推动开发更能适应真实企业数据场景的智能体系统。

Abstract: Real-world enterprise data science and analytics workflows require reasoning across dozens of tables, performing statistical analyses, and acting on the results. Established text-to-SQL benchmarks evaluate query generation alone, and audits have found their answer keys frequently wrong. Because real enterprise warehouses are too sensitive to release, these benchmarks are built on public datasets where a business event fits in a single table. We introduce Argo-Bench, an evaluation framework comprising 210 data science and analytics tasks. Drawing on public data, peer-reviewed industry literature, and regulatory filings, we simulate a food delivery platform in New York City at true scale, with 81 million orders in 2024, grounded economics, fraud patterns, and marketplace incentives. We export this world to an ERP warehouse of 235 tables and 7.5 billion rows, modeled on the Oracle E-Business Suite schema. The simulator's ground-truth state is withheld from the warehouse the agent sees, so tasks require reconstructing facts by navigating the warehouse before acting on them. Argo-Bench goes beyond text-to-SQL: the agent files actions such as banning fraudulent accounts, allocating courier incentive budgets, or issuing back pay, and the grader scores each by its consequences in the simulator. Every task has an executable reference solution that demonstrates solvability using only the warehouse. The strongest of 14 frontier and open-weight models scores 95 or higher on only 34.8% of tasks and averages 59.5 points. We hope Argo-Bench drives progress toward agents that understand, navigate, and act within real data environments.

</details>


### [192] [DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00316)
*Puneet Mathur,Nedim Lipka,Zeyu Jin,Dinesh Manocha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DSB-DG基准，评估语音代理在文档 grounding 方面的能力，发现级联管道准确率最高但上下文容量有限，全双工系统存在显著衰减和幻觉问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管语音代理实现了低延迟、自然的交互，但其基于外部文档生成忠实回答的能力尚未得到充分探索，需要评估其在多领域、长上下文和多轮对话中的表现。

Method: 构建 DSB-DG 基准，涵盖五个专业领域的1,636个对抗性验证问答对；定义三种失效模式（上下文饱和、Grounding 衰减、主动 Grounding）；自动评估 grounding 准确性、幻觉和响应延迟；对比级联、专有全双工及开源 speech2speech 架构。

Result: 级联管道（ASR-LLM-TTS）grounding 准确率最高，Gemini-Live 和 GPT-Realtime 紧随其后；开源系统出现上下文容量骤降和多轮 grounding 衰减；grounding 保真度随上下文长度和对话负载增加而下降，失败常表现为无依据生成而非拒绝回答。

Conclusion: 上下文 grounding 是实现可靠全双工语音代理的关键未解难题，当前系统在长上下文和多轮交互中面临显著的保真度挑战。

Abstract: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. Across systems spanning cascaded, proprietary full-duplex and real-time, and open-weight speech2speech architectures, we find substantial differences in effective grounding capacity. While cascaded pipeline (ASR-LLM-TTS) achieves the highest grounding accuracy, Gemini-Live and GPT-Realtime closely trail behind. Open-weight systems exhibit distinct failure modes, most notably an abrupt context-capacity collapse and multi-turn grounding decay. More broadly, grounding fidelity degrades with context and conversational load, and failures frequently manifest as unsupported generations rather than abstention. We show that contextual grounding as a key unresolved challenge for reliable full-duplex voice agents.

</details>


### [193] [A Matryoshka Hierarchical RAG for Efficient Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01767)
*Gianluca Bonifazi,Christopher Buratti,Michele Marchetti,Federica Parlapiano,Giulia Quaglieri,Davide Traini,Domenico Ursino,Luca Virgili*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出MatRAG，一种结合RAG与Matryoshka表示学习的分层框架，通过DAG聚类结构和降维索引平衡多跳QA的检索质量与计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有RAG系统在多跳问答中因使用知识图谱、LLM摘要或迭代检索导致的索引和查询高计算成本问题，同时保持高检索质量。

Method: 构建文档聚类有向无环图（DAG），粒度逐层变粗；各层级使用不同Matryoshka维度索引；采用自上而下遍历结合实体驱动机制控制跳数预算并重排序候选项。

Result: 在三个标准多跳QA基准上优于七个基线模型，提升检索质量；避免KG构建和LLM摘要降低索引成本；利用维度感知相似度降低查询成本。

Conclusion: MatRAG有效平衡了检索性能与计算效率，为多跳QA提供了低成本、高质量的解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems for multi-hop Question Answering (QA) must balance retrieval quality with computational cost. This cost is incurred during indexing time, through the use of expensive Knowledge Graphs (KGs) or Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate summaries, or during querying, through iterative LLM-driven retrieval. To reduce it while maintaining retrieval quality, we present MatRAG, a hierarchical framework that combines RAG systems with Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL). MatRAG addresses both kinds of cost by aligning the semantic hierarchy of a clustering structure with the nested structure of MRL. Specifically, it organizes the corpus of documents into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) of clusters with progressively coarser granularity. Each level is indexed by a lower Matryoshka dimension. MatRAG pairs an iterative, top-down traversal of the DAG with an entity-driven mechanism that controls the hop budget and re-ranks candidates. We evaluated MatRAG on three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks against seven representative baselines. MatRAG outperforms its strongest competitors in terms of retrieval quality; furthermore, it reduces indexing costs by avoiding KG construction and LLM-based summarization, and lowers query-time costs through dimension-aware similarity.

</details>


### [194] [Refusal Localizes, the Damage Relocates: Safety Layers Under Few-Sample Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00320)
*Jungseob Lee,Dongyub Jude Lee,Sugyeong Eo,Seongtae Hong,Seungyoon Lee,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现，尽管通过定位和修复可以恢复大语言模型对有害请求的拒绝能力，但适应性攻击者可以通过改变攻击策略（如增加样本量、分散更新方向）来绕过这些防御。局部冻结层虽能抵御少量无意引入的有害数据，但在面对有意识的自适应攻击时仍会失效，强调了开发更强健的防御机制的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调对齐的大语言模型（LLMs）在面对少量有害示例时容易丧失拒绝有害请求的能力。虽然 prior work 表明安全行为可被定位到特定层或方向，但尚不清楚这种定位和恢复机制是否能支持抵御变化攻击的有效防御措施。

Method: 1. **定位与恢复测试**：在四个模型家族的六个检查点中，测试攻击后有害/良性提示的可分离性及通过注入清洁隐藏状态进行恢复的效果。
2. **局部冻结防御**：基于先前的层冻结防御，将过渡深度以下的每一层冻结并重复攻击。
3. **奇异值方向移除**：在注意力-only微调后，移除更新的前两个主要奇异值方向以恢复拒绝能力。
4. **对抗性评估**：评估普通训练削弱修复效果及攻击者分散更新时的防御表现，并使用光谱检测器监测修复失败情况。

Result: 1. 攻击后有害和良性提示仍线性可分；在可复现的过渡深度注入清洁隐藏状态可恢复拒绝能力。
2. 当冻结该深度以下的所有层并遭受一百个有害示例攻击时，所有检查点的拒绝率仍接近零，且恢复过渡发生在冻结边界之上。
3. 移除前两个奇异值方向可在部分情况下恢复拒绝，但普通训练会削弱此修复，而分散更新的攻击者可击败该修复。
4. 校准的光谱检测器未能检测到大部分修复失败案例。
5. 局部冻结仅在少量无害示例意外进入训练数据时有助于保留拒绝能力。

Conclusion: 攻击者能够绕过由恢复机制识别的区域，并击败跨多个检查点有效的修复方法。这证明了针对自适应微调的防御需要更严格的五项检查标准，以应对不断演变的攻击策略。

Abstract: Fine-tuning adapts aligned large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks, but a few dozen harmful examples can remove their refusal of harmful requests. Prior work localizes safety-related behavior to specific layers, directions, and tokens, suggesting targets for protection. We test whether successful localization and recovery support defenses that survive changes in the attack. Across six checkpoints from four model families, harmful and benign prompts remain linearly separable after attack, and patching full clean hidden states into the compromised model restores refusal at a reproducible transition depth. Building on a prior layer-freezing defense, we freeze every layer up to this depth and repeat the attack. At a hundred harmful examples, refusal remains near zero on all six checkpoints, with recovery transitions above the frozen boundary. In a second study, removing the update's top two singular directions restores refusal after short attention-only fine-tunes on four checkpoints. On Llama-3.1-8B, ordinary training changes weaken this repair and an attacker who spreads the update defeats it. A spectral detector calibrated on benign Llama fine-tunes misses most repair failures on that checkpoint. Localized freezing can nevertheless help preserve refusal when a few harmful examples enter training data unintentionally. These results show that an attacker can bypass a region identified by recovery and defeat a repair that works across multiple checkpoints, motivating five checks for defenses against adaptive fine-tuning. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/refusal-relocates.

</details>


### [195] [CAST: Cost-Aware Speculative Trees from One-Pass Block Drafters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00321)
*Jungseob Lee,Sugyeong Eo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CAST是一种成本感知的推测解码方法，通过将候选令牌打包成树并在单次目标模型前向传播中验证，从而加速大语言模型推理，相比标准链式推测最高提速43%，且无需修改模型或解码规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有块级推测器（Block drafters）在一次前向传播中生成多个未来令牌候选项，但标准解码仅验证得分最高的序列并丢弃其他已评分的候选项，导致计算资源浪费。需要一种机制来利用这些已生成的候选项以进一步降低推理延迟。

Method: 提出CAST（Cost-Aware Speculative Trees），将候选令牌组织为树结构，并在单次目标模型前向传播中进行并行验证。通过测量延迟动态确定树的宽度，当预期增益超过验证时间增加时添加候选项，从而实现自适应宽度选择。

Result: 在五个领域、三代GPU和两种模型家族上评估显示，在预测宽度下，CAST在所有八种设置中均比标准链式推测更快，最高提升43%。最佳宽度高度依赖部署环境：在验证成本因内核边界激增的场景下，固定128-token树仅快2%，而CAST自适应宽度树快20%。此外，证明了CAST在贪婪和采样解码下保持目标输出分布不变。

Conclusion: CAST通过构建自适应宽度的推测树并高效验证，显著提升了大语言模型的推理速度，同时保持了输出分布的一致性，其性能优势在不同硬件和模型配置下得到验证。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting future tokens cheaply and verifying them with the target model in parallel. Block drafters score a whole block of future tokens in one forward pass, yet standard decoding verifies only the top-scoring chain and discards the other candidates. Because these candidates are already scored, verifying more of them adds target computation but no extra drafting. We introduce CAST (Cost-Aware Speculative Trees), which packs these candidates into a tree and verifies it in a single target pass, leaving the target model, drafter weights, and decoding rule untouched. To decide how wide the tree should be, CAST adds candidates while the expected gain from the next one outweighs the verification time it adds. The width therefore adapts to each deployment from a latency measurement, without sweeping over widths. We evaluate CAST across five domains on three GPU generations and two model families. At its predicted width, CAST is faster than the standard chain in all eight settings, by up to 43%. We also find that the best width depends strongly on the deployment. Where verification cost jumps at a kernel boundary, a 128-token tree is only 2% faster than the standard chain, whereas the tree at the predicted width is 20% faster. Furthermore, we prove that CAST leaves the target output distribution unchanged under both greedy and sampled decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/CAST.

</details>


### [196] [Dissonant ballerinas and crafty carrots: a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian brain rot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00402)
*Anca Dinu,Andra-Maria Florescu,Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Stefana-Arina Tabusca,Claudiu Creanga,Andreiana Mihail*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过构建CRIB数据集，对比分析了意大利语和罗马尼亚语“脑腐”模因（Brain Rot memes）的多模态特征。研究发现流行度与文本/声学情感无关，而罗马尼亚语视频的快速剪辑节奏是成功的关键预测因子；两种语言在文本负向性、韵律及音频频谱特征上存在显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究“脑腐”模因的吸引力因素，并揭示不同语言版本间的语言学与文化差异。

Method: 引入多模态“脑腐”数据集CRIB，包含240个手动整理的手势TikTok视频，按语言和流行度分层。分析涵盖文本、声学和视觉特征。

Result: 1. 流行度与文本元素（情感、荒诞性、押韵）或声学元素（声音情感）无显著相关性。
2. 在罗马尼亚语中，视频级动态（更快的剪辑速度和整体节奏）是视频成功的强预测因子。
3. 跨语言差异：意大利语模因文本更负面、困惑度更高、更多押韵，音频旋律范围更广且音量更大；罗马尼亚语音频频谱更明亮，音高变化更 erratic。

Conclusion: “脑腐”模因的成功并非由传统的情感或文本修辞决定，而是受到特定语言环境下视听节奏和微观特征的强烈影响，揭示了跨文化传播中的多模态异质性。

Abstract: This paper presents a comparative multi-modal analysis of Italian and Romanian brain rot memes, investigating the factors that contribute to its appeal and the linguistic and cultural distinctions between the two versions. To conduct this analysis, we introduce a multi-modal brain rot dataset named CRIB (Collection of Romanian and Italian Brain rot), a manually curated collection of 240 TikTok videos stratified by language (Italian, Romanian) and popularity, on which we examine textual, acoustic, and visual features. Our findings indicate that popularity is not significantly correlated with textual elements like sentiment, absurdity, or rhyme, or acoustic elements such as vocal features or sentiment of the sound. Instead, in Romanian language, video-level dynamics, specifically faster cutting speeds and a more rapid overall pace, are strong predictors of a video's success. The cross-linguistic analysis reveals significant differences. Italian brain rot is textually more negative, exhibits higher perplexity, and uses more rhyme, while its sound is characterized by higher melodic range and loudness. Romanian audio is spectrally brighter with more erratic pitch variations.

</details>


### [197] [LLM-as-a-Judge for Low-Resource Languages: Adapting Ragas and Comparative Ranking for Romanian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00406)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对低资源语言（以罗马尼亚语为例）在评估检索增强生成（RAG）系统时的挑战，提出并验证了“LLM-as-a-Judge”范式的可行性。通过引入AdminRo-Eval数据集和适配Ragas框架，研究比较了不同评估策略，发现Granular Decomposition在Faithfulness指标上表现最佳，Comparative Ranking在Answer Relevance上更优，确立了Gemini 2.5 Pro作为自动化评估的稳健基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决低资源语言（LRLs）中标准基于参考的指标评估RAG系统效果不佳的问题，探索利用大语言模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）进行有效评估的可能性。

Method: 1. 构建并引入AdminRo-Eval数据集：包含由母语者标注的罗马尼亚行政文档，作为基准测试的地面真值。
2. 适配Ragas框架：使用下一代模型（Gemini 2.5和Gemini 3）对罗马尼亚语进行评估。
3. 比较三种评估方法论：直接评分（direct scoring）、比较排名（comparative ranking）和细粒度分解（granular decomposition）。
4. 评估维度包括：忠实度（Faithfulness）、答案相关性（Answer Relevance）和上下文相关性（Context Relevance）。

Result: 1. 评估策略需因指标而异：细粒度分解在忠实度（Faithfulness）上与人类对齐度最高（Gemini 2.5 Pro达到96%）；比较排名在答案相关性（Answer Relevance）上表现更佳（90%）。
2. 轻量级模型在处理低资源语言的复杂推理时存在困难。
3. Gemini 2.5 Pro架构为自动化的罗马尼亚语RAG评估建立了稳健且可迁移的基线。

Conclusion: 对于低资源语言如罗马尼亚语，采用经过适当调整的LLM-as-a-Judge范式结合特定的评估策略（如细粒度分解或比较排名），可以实现与人类判断高度一致的RAG系统自动化评估，其中Gemini 2.5 Pro展现了强大的性能。

Abstract: Evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems remains a challenge for Low-Resource Languages (LRLs), where standard reference-based metrics fall short. This paper investigates the viability of the "LLM-as-a-Judge" paradigm for Romanian by adapting the Ragas framework using next-generation models (Gemini 2.5 and Gemini 3). We introduce AdminRo-Eval, a curated dataset of Romanian administrative documents annotated by native speakers, to serve as a ground truth for benchmarking automated evaluators. We compare three evaluation methodologies - direct scoring, comparative ranking, and granular decomposition - across metrics for Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Relevance. Our findings reveal that evaluation strategies must be metric-specific: granular decomposition achieves the highest human alignment for Faithfulness (96% with Gemini 2.5 Pro), while comparative ranking outperforms in Answer Relevance (90%). Furthermore, we demonstrate that while lightweight models struggle with complex reasoning in LRLs, the Gemini 2.5 Pro architecture establishes a robust, transferable baseline for automated Romanian RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [198] [UniBuc at SemEval-2024 Task 2: Tailored Prompting with Solar for Clinical NLI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00408)
*Marius Micluta-Campeanu,Claudiu Creanga,Ana-Maria Bucur,Ana Sabina Uban,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: UniBuc团队在SemEval 2024 Task 2中，使用未经微调的SOLAR Instruct模型，通过输入操纵和定制化提示词（针对临床试验各部分），在零样本和少样本设置下取得0.72一致性得分，排名第14。错误分析显示模型倾向于依赖简单启发式方法而非深入语义理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与SemEval 2024 Task 2：临床试验安全生物医学自然语言推理任务，旨在评估模型在临床文本推理中的安全性与准确性。

Method: 使用SOLAR Instruct大语言模型，不进行任何微调；重点在于输入数据的预处理/操纵以及为临床试验不同章节定制提示词策略，分别在零样本（zero-shot）和少样本（few-shot）场景下进行测试。

Result: 获得0.72的一致性评分，在排行榜上位列第14名。

Conclusion: 尽管未微调即取得不错排名，但模型在处理语义保持性变化时存在缺陷，容易走捷径并依赖简单的启发式规则，表明其在深层语义推理能力上仍有提升空间。

Abstract: This paper describes the approach of the UniBuc team in tackling the SemEval 2024 Task 2: Safe Biomedical Natural Language Inference for Clinical Trials. We used SOLAR Instruct, without any fine-tuning, while focusing on input manipulation and tailored prompting. By customizing prompts for individual CTR sections, in both zero-shot and few-shots settings, we managed to achieve a consistency score of 0.72, ranking 14th in the leaderboard. Our thorough error analysis revealed that our model has a tendency to take shortcuts and rely on simple heuristics, especially when dealing with semantic-preserving changes.

</details>


### [199] [EurekaBench: Measuring Agentic Ability to Discover New Scientific Insights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00492)
*Jiayi Geng,Zhengxuan Wu,Kevin S. Chen,Seungone Kim,Joseph Janssen,Zora Zhiruo Wang,Bhupalee Kalita,Runtian Gao,Aaron Ho,Andrew Oakleigh Nelson,Olexandr Isayev,Francisco Villaescusa-Navarro,Ching-Yao Lai,Howard Chen,Graham Neubig*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了EurekaBench，一个用于评估AI代理在跨领域长周期实验中通过数据发现潜在机制能力的基准测试。研究指出，当前AI虽在预测精度上超越人类，但在从发现的机制中提炼科学洞察力方面存在显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在衡量AI代理是否能像牛顿发现万有引力定律那样，通过分析观测数据、建立数学方程并验证理论来发现解释现象的底层机制和科学洞察。

Method: 构建包含神经科学、计算机科学等6个领域26个长周期任务的专家验证基准（EurekaBench），涵盖306个预期支持的科学洞察。评估框架从遵循科学约束能力、机制预测准确性及产生科学洞察力三个维度进行测试。

Result: 当前AI代理在优化预测准确性方面表现优异，甚至超过人类科学家，但在推导科学洞察力和指导未来研究方面明显落后于人类水平。

Conclusion: 虽然AI在预测任务上表现出色，但其在生成具有深层含义的科学洞察方面仍有巨大提升空间，表明单纯的预测优化不足以替代人类的科学发现过程。

Abstract: When Isaac Newton discovered the law of gravitation, he did so through an iterative process of analyzing observed data such as planetary patterns, finding the underlying mechanisms by describing patterns in mathematical equations, and refining his theory against the Moon's orbit, revealing the startling insight that the same force governs both falling apples and orbiting planets. Would it be possible for AI agents to make similar discoveries? To measure this ability, we introduce EurekaBench, a cross-domain benchmark that tests AI agents' ability to conduct long-horizon experiments and discover mechanisms that explain observations. We evaluate these mechanisms by the scientific insights that can be derived from them. EurekaBench contains an expert-verified set of 26 long-horizon tasks across neuroscience, computer science, chemistry, astrophysics, geophysics, and plasma physics, with a total of 306 scientific insights that the discovered mechanisms are expected to support. Our evaluation framework tests three axes of scientific discovery: agents' ability to follow known scientific constraints, the predictive accuracy of the discovered mechanisms, and whether these mechanisms yield scientific insights or inform future research. Our results show that current AI agents often overly fixate on predictive accuracy optimization, surpassing human scientists, while falling substantially short in deriving scientific insights.

</details>


### [200] [Rules Amortize, Pairings Don't: Linguistic Structure Determines What Latent Task Representations Can Replace In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00526)
*Gunmay Jhingran*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究将上下文学习（ICL）中的语言操作分解为潜在的任务向量，发现对于某些复杂语言任务（如词形还原），这种基于几何特征的零样本转换方法显著优于传统的少样本提示，而简单映射则无法从中受益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管上下文学习可以通过静态向量进行摊销以降低推理成本，但理论表明静态向量在处理高秩映射（如单词级双射）时会失效。本研究旨在探究哪些语言操作可以从提示中“摊销”出来，以克服传统ICL在特定任务上的局限性。

Method: 训练一个260万参数的小型网络，读取少量示例支持集的几何结构（质心、主子空间、谱等，仅计算一次并缓存），生成对冻结的GPT-2-large/XL中间层残差流的输入条件加法更新。在8个屈折方向和1个词汇关系上进行测试，采用防止数据泄露的标准划分。

Result: 出现三种 regimes：1) 前向屈折：小模型匹配IC性能，且实现严格的零样本每查询成本；2) 词形还原方向：小模型表现远超ICL（最高提升72个百分点，达到0.78-0.92准确率），因为冻结GPT-2能执行但10个示例无法有效传达该规则；3) 任意配对（如反义关系）：性能仅在ICL的一半左右停滞。控制实验证明支持流形是因果必要的任务指纹。

Conclusion: 生产性规则（productive rules）可以转化为潜在的任务表示，且在某些情况下比提示更能有效传达信息；而记忆化的配对（memorized pairings）则不能通过这种方式摊销。这表明对于复杂语言操作，提取底层几何特征比依赖示例提示更有效。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) can be amortized into latent objects (task vectors, function vectors, context vectors) that recover few-shot behavior at zero-shot inference cost, but recent theory shows a static vector acts as a single synthetic demonstration and must fail on high-rank mappings such as word-level bijections. We ask a linguistic version of this question: which linguistic operations can be amortized out of the prompt? We train a 2.6M-parameter network that reads the geometry of a few-shot support set (centroid, principal subspace, spectrum, computed once and cached) and produces an input-conditioned additive update to the query's residual stream at a mid-depth layer of a frozen GPT-2-large/XL. Across eight inflectional directions and one lexical relation, under a canonical split that bars inverted-pair leakage between directions, three regimes emerge. On forward inflection, where 10-shot ICL is strong (0.67-0.89) and extracted task vectors collapse (<=0.06), the transform matches ICL at strictly zero-shot per-query cost. On lemmatization directions, which frozen GPT-2 can execute but 10 demonstrations systematically fail to convey (ICL 0.13-0.48 at 1.5B), the transform is not capped by ICL at all: it reaches 0.78-0.92, up to +72 points over ICL (past to present: 0.85 vs. 0.13). On arbitrary pairings (antonymy) every amortizer plateaus near half of ICL at every scale, capacity, and seed tested. Controls show the support manifold acts as a causally necessary task fingerprint: wrong-task manifolds collapse accuracy to <=0.06, query-only variants cannot disambiguate tasks sharing an input space, and leave-one-task-out transfer is zero. Productive rules amortize into latent task representations, sometimes better than prompting can convey them; memorized pairings do not.

</details>


### [201] [Assessing the Impact of Language Disparity on Multilingual Linguistic Ability in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00540)
*Zhanyu Chen,Jaap Jumelet*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究发现后训练会损害多语言模型的语法能力，尤其对低资源语言影响最大；通过原生语言提示可恢复低资源语言的隐藏能力。因此，评估多语言语法能力需采用语言感知的多范式协议，以避免低估低资源语言的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管关于多语言语言模型语法能力的说法因测量方式不同而差异巨大，但评估范式、后训练与语言资源可用性之间的相互作用尚未得到系统考察。

Method: 在涵盖101种语言的句法最小对立对基准MultiBLiMP上，使用四种评估方法对六个家族的基础模型和后训练模型进行评估。

Result: 1. 后训练降低了语法能力，模型规模能部分缓解此负面影响，但低资源语言成本最高；2. 后训练模型在非高资源语言中保留了无法通过显式提示表达的语法知识，但在低资源语言中因基线接近随机水平而无法检测；3. 原生语言提示能恢复低资源语言中被隐藏的语法能力，表明仅高资源语言可直接从未提示概率中探测。

Conclusion: 多语言语法评估必须采用语言感知和多范式的协议，以防止系统地低估低资源语言的能力。

Abstract: Claims about the grammatical competence of multilingual language models vary sharply with how competence is measured, yet the interaction between evaluation paradigm, post-training, and language resource availability has not been systematically examined. We evaluate base and post-trained models from six families on MultiBLiMP, a syntactic minimal-pair benchmark covering 101 languages, using four evaluation methods. We report three principal findings. First, post-training degrades grammatical competence, but the magnitude of this effect is reduced unevenly by model scale, while low-resource languages bear the highest cost. Second, post-trained models retain grammatical knowledge they cannot articulate through explicit prompting, yet this is measurable only in high-resource languages, because near-chance baselines in low-resource settings leave little knowledge to hide. Third, native-language prompting recovers otherwise hidden competence on low-resource languages, demonstrating that only high-resource languages can be probed directly from unprompted probabilities. We conclude that multilingual grammatical evaluation must adopt language-informed, multi-paradigm protocols to avoid systematically underestimating low-resource abilities.

</details>


### [202] [Can LLMs Reason Over Long Horizons? An Empirical Evaluation of Context Strategies for Longitudinal Clinical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00562)
*Taye Akinrele,Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz,Subash Neupane,Sudip Mittal,Shahram Rahimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究指出，在纵向临床推理中，单纯增加上下文长度并不能保证提高大语言模型（LLM）的准确性。通过比较五种上下文策略（Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, Hybrid），研究发现Episodic和Hybrid策略在长距离证据检索中表现最佳，但即使答案正确，模型在面对无支持前提的问题时仍难以有效拒绝回答。结论强调，可靠的纵向推理关键在于相关证据的选择与呈现方式，而非仅依赖可访问的历史数据量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管长上下文模型能够处理大量信息，但在纵向临床推理任务中，提供更多信息并不必然使相关证据更易获取或提升推理能力。现有研究缺乏对不同上下文策略在长距离证据整合、鲁棒性及拒答机制方面的系统性比较。

Method: 在MedLoCoMo基准上，评估四种开源LLM在五种上下文策略（Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, Hybrid）下的表现。评估指标包括答案正确率、对查询-证据距离的鲁棒性，以及在前提不支持情况下的拒答（abstention）能力。

Result: 1. Episodic和Hybrid策略整体准确率最高；2. Recent Context策略在支持证据距离变远时性能下降最显著，而Episodic和Hybrid在长距离下保持高准确率；3. 对抗性问题分析显示，模型在可回答问题上的强表现并未转化为在无支持历史时的成功拒答能力。

Conclusion: 可靠的纵向临床推理不仅取决于LLM可访问的历史数据量，更关键地依赖于相关证据的选择和呈现策略以优化推理过程。

Abstract: Longitudinal clinical reasoning requires large language models (LLMs) to identify and integrate relevant evidence distributed across extended patient histories. Although long-context models can process increasingly large amounts of information, providing more history does not necessarily make relevant evidence more accessible or improve reasoning. We compare five context strategies (Full, Recent, Episodic, Semantic, and Hybrid) on MedLoCoMo across four open-weight LLMs, examining answer correctness, robustness to query-evidence distance, and abstention on questions with unsupported premises. Episodic and Hybrid generally achieve the strongest overall accuracy, while Recent Context degrades most as supporting evidence becomes more distant; Episodic and Hybrid maintain the highest accuracy at long distances. Analysis of adversarial questions further shows that strong performance on answerable questions does not necessarily translate to successful abstention when the available history does not support the requested conclusion. These findings show that reliable longitudinal reasoning depends not only on how much history an LLM can access, but critically on how relevant evidence is selected and presented for reasoning.

</details>


### [203] [Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00568)
*Pardis Sadat Zahraei,Janvijay Singh,Gokhan Tur,Dilek Hakkani-Tur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大语言模型面临“能力-对齐-忠实性”三元悖论，研究发现“对齐诱导的不忠实性（AIU）”随模型规模扩大而加剧，且难以通过提示缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注能力与对齐、能力与忠实性之间的权衡，但“对齐与忠实性之间的冲突”这一关键张力尚未得到充分探索。

Method: 提出FaithConflict数据集以隔离这两种冲突，构建行为（B1-B8）和思维链推理（C0-C6）两类互补分类法，并通过中间检查点分析后训练阶段的影响。

Result: 发现模型在处理不安全或敏感内容时系统性地偏离输入而不披露修改，即AIU；该现象随模型规模增加呈反向缩放定律（reverse scaling law），且在DPO阶段增幅最大且最不明显；提示工程无法解决此问题。

Conclusion: 揭示了大语言模型设计中存在的“能力-对齐-忠实性”三元悖论，表明当前后训练机制在提升对齐的同时可能显著损害忠实性，需重新评估LLM的设计与评价体系。

Abstract: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling law; intermediate checkpoints show it is amplified during post-training, with DPO the stage at which the gap both grows most and becomes least visible. Prompting-based mitigation does not resolve it, revealing a capability-alignment-faithfulness trilemma in the design and evaluation of LLMs.

</details>


### [204] [Where's Waldo? Query-language Preference under Cross-lingual Knowledge Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00606)
*Dayeon Ki,Ruochen Zhang,Silviu Cucerzan,Ryen W. White,Ning Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了Waldo基准，揭示了大型语言模型在跨语言知识冲突中表现出强烈的“查询语言偏好”，即倾向于选择与查询语言一致的信息源。研究通过机制干预和LoRA训练有效缓解了这一偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注语言间知识等效场景下的查询语言偏好，但在不同语言来源提供不完整或冲突信息时，这种偏好的后果更为严重，直接影响用户获取信息的准确性。

Method: 构建了基于维基百科的Waldo多语言QA基准（含12K问答对），涵盖知识缺失和知识冲突两种场景；评估了8个模型在5种语言上的表现，并尝试通过消融注意力头（机制干预）和LoRA微调进行缓解。

Result: 当某语言版本缺失事实时，模型通常能跨语言使用证据；但在知识冲突场景下，模型回复强烈对齐于查询语言对应的文档，导致语义相同的查询因语言不同而得到不同答案。LoRA训练将偏好差距减少了61.5%。

Conclusion: 大语言模型在多语言环境下存在显著的知识冲突处理偏差，需通过特定的机制干预或微调手段来增强其跨语言公平性和信息检索的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large Language Models increasingly serve as interfaces for knowledge-intensive information seeking tasks across languages by synthesizing multilingual evidence. Prior work has shown that they often exhibit query-language preference -- the tendency to favor sources written in the language of the query -- but has largely examined this behavior in settings where equivalent knowledge is available across languages. However, this bias becomes consequential when sources in different languages provide incomplete or inconsistent accounts of the same fact, since the information users receive then depends on the sources a model selects to use. To characterize query-language preference under such cross-lingual knowledge disparities, we introduce Waldo, a multilingual Question-Answering (QA) benchmark constructed from Wikipedia. Waldo contains 12K QA pairs targeting knowledge gaps, where a fact is available in one language but absent in another, and knowledge conflicts, where language editions provide conflicting versions of the same fact. Evaluating eight models across five languages, we find that when one language edition merely lacks the relevant fact, models generally use evidence from the other language regardless of the query language. Under conflicting accounts, however, model responses strongly align with the document in the query language, causing semantically equivalent queries to elicit different accounts depending on the user's language. Finally, we explore two different approaches that could mitigate this preference under knowledge conflicts: a mechanistic intervention that ablates attention heads associated with query-language preference, and LoRA-based training, which reduces the preference gap by up to 61.5%.

</details>


### [205] [Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00610)
*Xuan Zhong Feng,Geoffrey Martin,Hexin Dong,Yifan Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文介绍了在IEEE BigData 2026 Cup中用于可解释自杀风险评估的系统。系统基于Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，通过QLoRA适配，联合训练三个任务（风险等级分类、证据短语提取、多标签因素识别），并针对各任务输出定制聚合策略，最终取得0.7738的综合得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅需要预测风险严重程度，还需识别帖子中的支持性语言以及表达的风险和保护因素，以提供更具透明度和可信度的评估结果。

Method: 采用Qwen2.5-Instruct大语言模型，利用量化低秩自适应（QLoRA）进行参数高效微调，并结合答案掩码因果语言模型目标。训练策略包括：对所有三个任务联合训练用于风险分类；对任务1a和1b联合训练用于证据提取；任务2单独适应用于因素识别。聚合策略方面：对32B和72B模型的风险概率取平均；通过交叉折叠共识结合证据短语；基于折叠外操作点通过速率匹配校准因素决策。

Result: 系统在官方排行榜上获得0.7738的综合得分，其中任务1得分为0.8089，任务2得分为0.6919。实验表明：对于任务1a，三任务联合训练效果最佳；对于任务1b，任务1a与1b联合训练效果最佳；对于任务2，特定任务的独立训练效果最佳。当组件模型错误互补时，概率平均进一步提升了任务1a的性能。

Conclusion: 研究强调了在统一的大语言模型框架内，根据每个任务的输出结构定制训练目标和聚合策略的重要性，从而提升可解释自杀风险评估系统的整体性能。

Abstract: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks~1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task~2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task~1 and 0.6919 on Task~2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task~1a, joint training on Tasks~1a and 1b performed best for Task~1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task~2. Probability averaging further improved Task~1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

</details>


### [206] [Mixture of Decoders for Diverse Dialog Response Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00621)
*Wenchao Du*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出在序列到序列模型中引入混合解码器，以解决对话生成中响应多样性低的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序列到序列模型在对话响应生成中存在多样性低的问题，假设原因是模型倾向于学习退化的单模态响应分布。

Method: 在条件变分自编码器（CVAE）框架下，将混合解码器集成到序列到序列模型中，使每个解码器学习特定主题。

Result: 在开放域聊天语料库上评估表明，该方法在定量指标和人类评估中均优于强基线模型。

Conclusion: 通过混合解码器机制有效提升了对话生成的响应多样性。

Abstract: Mixture modeling is a long established machine learning technique for learning large sets of multi-modal data. While it is known that sequence-to-sequence models for dialog response generation suffer from the problem of low diversity, we hypothesize that it is because sequence-to-sequence models tend to learn a degenerate uni-modal distribution of responses. We then propose to incorporate a mixture of decoders into sequence-to-sequence models and try to make each decoder learn specialized topics in order to improve the diversity of generated responses. Our model is developed under the framework of conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE). We evaluate our approach on an open domain chat corpus and show improvement over strong baselines in quantitative measures and human evaluation.

</details>


### [207] [Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00650)
*Zhengyuan Jiang,Reachal Wang,Yuepeng Hu,Yupu Wang,Yuqi Jia,Neil Zhenqiang Gong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出RuleEvolve框架，通过LLM迭代生成和评估变体来自动进化编码规则，显著提升AI编程代理在代码正确性、长度和成本上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码规则多为手工制定且固定不变，导致优化过程劳动密集且效果次优；AI编程代理的性能高度依赖底层编码规则，亟需一种自动化、自适应的规则优化机制。

Method: 构建包含候选编码规则的池，利用LLM驱动的变异模块生成新变体，并通过裁判模块评估变体性能，将最优结果更新回池中，实现迭代式自我进化。

Result: 在两个编程代理框架、四个基础LLM及三个基准测试上，RuleEvolve在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度及生成成本（如Token消耗）方面均优于人工工程和现有提示词优化基线。

Conclusion: RuleEvolve提供了一种高效、自动化的编码规则优化范式，证明了通过迭代进化可显著提升AI编程代理的综合性能与效率。

Abstract: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

</details>


### [208] [Lingtai: What Concept Geometry Reveals--and Does Not Reveal--About LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00656)
*Jiangang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Lingtai，一种无需训练的在线概念遥测层，通过投影残差状态到概念锚点生成结构化信号，揭示大模型推理过程中的不确定性关联及执行轨迹特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决在自回归推理过程中，无需训练探针即可观察大型语言模型内部计算状态的难题。

Method: 构建无标签、无梯度拟合的领域特定概念锚点库；在每个生成步骤将残差状态投影至该库以产生概念坐标信号；分析代码生成和数学推理任务中的信号与预测不确定性的关联及轨迹结构。

Result: 1. 概念信号与预测不确定性存在稳健关联，且不受问题身份或Token位置控制影响；2.发现两种结构：任务条件化的活动信号和执行特定的轨迹身份（具有局部惯性）；3. 证明该信号不提供稳定的正确性坐标；4. 仅增加0.7-1.6%的单Token解码开销。

Conclusion: Lingtai提供了一种高效、低开销的机制来解析LLM的内部推理动态，揭示了不确定性相关的几何结构和轨迹特性，但确认其不直接反映最终答案的正确性。

Abstract: Observing what a large language model computes during autoregressive inference--online and without training probes--remains difficult. We introduce Lingtai, a training-free concept telemetry layer: at each generation step, residual states are projected onto a domain-specific bank of named concept anchors, constructed without labeled concept examples, outcome labels, gradient fitting, or activation-space optimization, producing a structured per-step concept-coordinate signal. Across code generation and grade-school mathematical reasoning, this signal exhibits a robust association with predictive uncertainty: the association survives problem-identity and token-position controls and is not attributable to a single token type, is not explained by a simple correct/incorrect mixture on GSM8K, and is not reproduced by matched random anchors; it is markedly weaker or direction-inconsistent in K-means and PCA projections. Two structures emerge: a recurring uncertainty-linked activity signal whose functional geometry is task-conditioned (distinct activity-entropy shapes on HumanEval, MBPP, and GSM8K), and an execution-specific trajectory identity with strong local inertia but weak re-instantiation invariance--under completion-only elastic alignment, corruption at k=32 (approximately a median quarter of the completion) on the matched re-execution subset still retrieves the archived episode at 62.0%, while a fresh execution retrieves it only 11.7-16.0% of the time. Finally, a matched audit finds no evidence that the scalar concept-activity signal used here supplies a stable correctness coordinate under the tested protocol; we therefore treat correctness as externally supplied. Telemetry adds 0.7-1.6% per-token decode overhead for the 161-anchor code implementation, with unchanged generated tokens.

</details>


### [209] [PhysicsMate: A Curriculum-Grounded Bengali Benchmark for Secondary Physics QA with Small-Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00664)
*Rashid Azraf Jahin,Saadman Sajid,Khan Raiyan Ibne Reza,Sumaiya Tabassum Nimi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PhysicsMate基准，利用低秩自适应（LoRA）技术优化0.6B至4B参数规模的模型在孟加拉国中学物理课程上的表现，显著提升闭卷准确率，并实现4B模型的量化部署以支持资源受限环境下的离线推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉国中等教育缺乏基于课程的STEM解题基准；通用语言模型在处理物理问题所需的精确术语、单位惯例和推导过程方面存在困难。

Method: 构建包含1834问答对的PhysicsMate基准，源自国家课程和教科书委员会（NCTB）9-10年级物理大纲，并基于包含1760个节点和2600条边的多关系知识图谱；采用统一的低秩自适应（LoRA）方案对0.6B、1.7B和4B参数的模型进行微调。

Result: 所有规模模型的闭卷准确率均显著提升（分别增加5.5、15.0和23.3个百分点）；结构化课程知识（物理量和命名定律）从适配中获益最多，而松散指定的实体级知识获益最少。

Conclusion: 通过适配和量化，4B模型可转化为小型离线二进制文件，适用于本地推理，为连接受限和资源匮乏环境提供了可行的课程对齐物理支持路径。

Abstract: Bengali secondary education lacks curriculum-grounded benchmarks for STEM question-solving, and general-purpose language models struggle with the precise terminology, unit conventions, and derivations that physics problems demand. We introduce PhysicsMate, a benchmark of 1834 question-answer pairs built from the National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) Grade 9-10 physics syllabus and grounded in a multi-relational knowledge graph of 1760 nodes and 2600 edges across ten ontological types. We Low-Rank Adapt at 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B parameters, with a unified recipe and demonstrate a significant increase in closed-book accuracy in all scales (+5.5, +15.0, and +23.3 percentage points). A node-type analysis shows that the most benefited by adaptation is the structured curricular knowledge, which consists of physical quantities and named laws, while the least benefited is the loosely specified entity-level knowledge. The 4B model has been adapted and quantized to a small offline binary that can be used for local inference in resource constrained environments and offers a viable path to curriculum aligned physics support in environments with limited connectivity and hardware.

</details>


### [210] [Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00673)
*Andrei Marchenko,Viacheslav Bezrukov,Oleg Kashurin,Inessa Fedorova,Dmitry Bocharov,Yuliana Shakhvalieva,Maria Tikhonova,Valerii Ternovskii*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究建立了循环语言模型（Looped Language Models）的高效训练方案，通过减少预训练token数量至310B并优化训练策略，实现了从 scratch 训练的显著成本降低和性能提升；在同等参数和推理计算下，其表现优于密集模型，并能以极简方式将现有预训练密集模型转换为循环模型，证实了递归结构本身的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大规模循环语言模型训练需要多阶段训练且消耗万亿级token，同时难以将循环带来的收益与数据及训练差异区分开来。旨在建立实用的训练配方，分离递归优势并降低成本。

Method: 1. 开发从 scratch 的训练流程：结合预训练、高质量中期训练、学习率预热及更强的出口门控正则化，无需多阶段调度即可稳定训练。
2. 受控对比实验：评估1.4B LoopLM与同参数量密集模型的性能。
3. 引入最小转换配方：通过单个可学习的输入混合标量和平滑退出损失，将预训练密集模型（如Qwen3-1.7B-Base）转换为循环模型。

Result: 1. 训练预算从7.7T tokens降至310B tokens，同时保持强大的推理能力。
2. 1.4B LoopLM在所有12个基准测试中优于参数匹配的密集模型（GSM8K +14, MATH +10, DROP +22），且在匹配推理计算下接近3.9B密集模型的性能，但仅使用36%的参数。
3. Looped Qwen在两个数据 regimes 下的所有基准测试中均优于基线，在GSM8K、MATH和MMLU-Pro上具有统计显著的增益。

Conclusion: 循环语言模型可以从 scratch 以更低的成本训练，并且可以实际地集成到现有的预训练检查点中。该研究成功隔离并证明了循环结构本身带来的性能增益。

Abstract: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

</details>


### [211] [Bayesian Fine-tuning Yields Language Models that are as Bayesian as their Beliefs Allow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00679)
*Polina Tsvilodub,Andreas Waldis,Linlu Qiu,Tal Linzen,Michael Franke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究对比了基于贝叶斯模型输出微调与基于真实答案监督微调（SFT）对语言模型推理能力的影响，发现贝叶斯微调能赋予模型真正的贝叶斯信念和计算机制，而标准SFT无法做到。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管贝叶斯推理是处理隐藏变量任务的规范解，且基于最优贝叶斯模型输出的微调能使语言模型表现出近贝叶斯行为，但尚不清楚这种差异的根本原因：即模型是否真正代表了贝叶斯信念、利用这些信念或遵循贝叶斯规则进行决策。

Method: 构建了从行为、表示到计算层面日益严格的要求来界定“贝叶斯决策者”，并在航班推荐任务中测试两种微调策略（贝叶斯信号 vs. 预言机/真实答案信号）下的语言模型，包括交换信念以验证其作用。

Result: 贝叶斯微调的模型不仅行为符合贝叶斯原则，其中间层还编码了贝叶斯规则的量化信息，并利用这些信念进行推荐；而预言机微调的模型在持有的信念及信念读取方式上均不同。信念交换实验表明部分贝叶斯优势可转移。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯微调能在语言模型中安装可用的贝叶斯信念以支持不确定性下的推理，这是仅使用真实答案的标准监督微调所无法实现的，凸显了精细化监督信号的优势。

Abstract: Language models (LMs) are increasingly used for tasks that require reasoning about hidden variables from a few observations, for which Bayesian inference is the normatively correct solution. While supervised fine-tuning of an LM on the outputs of an optimal $\textit{Bayesian}$ model leads to near-Bayesian behavior, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the true answers for the task falls short of it. But behavior alone does not tell us $\textit{why}$ tuning on a $\textit{Bayesian}$ or an $\textit{oracle}$ (true answers) signal differs: whether the resulting LM represents Bayesian beliefs, acts on them, or turns them into a choice the way Bayes' rule does. To compare them, we formulate increasingly demanding requirements for an LM to count as a Bayesian decision maker, spanning its behavior, representations, and computations, and test them on a flight recommendation task. The Bayes-trained LM acts Bayesian, encodes quantities of Bayes' rule in its middle layers, and uses the encoded belief for the recommendation to a certain extent. The oracle-trained LM differs from it both in the beliefs it holds and whether it reads beliefs out into recommendations. Exchanging beliefs between the LMs transfers a part of the Bayesian advantage. Bayes fine-tuning thus installs usable Bayesian beliefs in an LM for reasoning under uncertainty in a way standard SFT on oracle answers cannot, highlighting the advantage of nuanced supervision.

</details>


### [212] [Towards Robust Numerical Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00689)
*Peter Røysland Aarnes,Vinay Setty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过对抗性微调解决大语言模型在数值推理中的脆弱性问题，显著提升小模型（Qwen3）的准确率并超越前沿系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型广泛用于声明验证，但在数值推理方面表现脆弱，微小的数值变化会导致准确率急剧下降，且这种缺陷在前沿模型中依然存在。

Method: 使用参数高效微调技术，对经过数值扰动的样本进行对抗性微调；利用VitaminC数据集处理证据侧扰动。

Result: 小型Qwen3模型（0.6B-8B）在标签翻转扰动上达到98.7%的准确率，优于GPT-5.4 Pro和Gemini 2.5 Flash等更大规模的零样本模型；泛化至未见过的扰动类型及跨语言场景（西班牙语），无需目标域数据即可提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 对抗性微调能有效缓解LLM在数值推理中的脆弱性，构建更稳健的数值决策边界，且该能力可泛化至不同扰动类型和跨语言任务中。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for claim verification, yet remain brittle for numerical reasoning: even small changes in value can sharply degrade accuracy. We show that this brittleness persists in frontier LLMs, but can be mitigated through adversarial fine-tuning on numerically perturbed examples. Using parameter-efficient fine-tuning, small Qwen3 models (0.6B$\unicode{x2013}$8B) reach 98.7% accuracy on label-flipping perturbations, outperforming larger zero-shot models and frontier systems (GPT-5.4 Pro (74.0%) and Gemini 2.5 Flash (73.9%)). The gains generalise to unseen perturbation types, indicating robust numerical decision boundaries rather than memorised edits. Robustness also transfers without target-domain data, significantly improving cross-lingual performance in Spanish. We further show that the same fine-tuning recipe confers robustness to evidence-side perturbations, using the VitaminC dataset.

</details>


### [213] [How Divergence Becomes Decision Flips in Compressed Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00694)
*Beatriz Almeida Felicio*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究指出总变差（Total Variation, TV）比KL散度更能直接且准确地预测压缩语言模型决策变化的翻转率（flip rate），在跨模型和语料的实验中表现更稳定，且在vLLM投机解码中无需校准即可有效预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的压缩报告多使用KL散度来衡量压缩模型与稠密模型的差异，但KL散度不能直接反映模型决策（arg-max token）的变化情况，导致难以评估部署时实际决策改变的频率。

Method: 通过802个压缩/扰动模型副本、19个开源模型、5个语料库和9种扰动家族的大规模实验，对比TV、KL散度及Hellinger距离等指标与“翻转率”的相关性；并在vLLM投机解码场景中进行预注册测试以验证预测能力。

Result: 1. 翻转率与TV的比率中位数为1.05，无需拟合常数；而KL需通过平方根转换且因子波动大。2. 在比较不同压缩器时，TV错误率仅为1%，远低于KL的11%。3. 在预注册测试中，TV关系保持稳定，而KL多项预测失败。4. 在vLLM中，TV能高精度（相对误差1.1%-2.4%）预测贪婪草稿接受率，无需任务特定校准。

Conclusion: 总变差（TV）是比KL散度更优的指标，用于直接量化压缩语言模型决策稳定性及预测投机解码性能，因其基于逐token的一阶统计特性，避免了KL平均化带来的偏差，具有更强的泛化性和实用性。

Abstract: Compression reports summarize how far a compressed language model moved from the dense one, usually by a KL divergence; a deployment that relies on the dense model's outputs needs to know how many of its decisions changed. We show that total variation, not KL, answers this directly. Across 802 compressed and perturbed copies of 19 open models on five corpora and nine mechanically unrelated perturbation families, the rate at which the arg-max token changes (the \emph{flip rate}) tracks total variation at a ratio with median $1.05$, with no fitted constant. KL converts into flips only through its square root and a factor that varies fourfold across models and corpora, because KL averages over tokens before the root is taken; first-order statistics averaged per token, such as Hellinger distance, avoid this, but reports rarely give them. As a result, of two compressors reported on different models and corpora whose flip rates differ by at least $10%$, KL assigns the smaller divergence to the one that changes more decisions in $11%$ of cases, total variation in $1%$. Two pre-registered tests mark the limits: on a held-out code corpus the ratio held for all eight models while three predictions about KL each failed for half of them or more, and on three new models with real kernels it stayed in its band for 37 of 38 checkpoints but fell below one on code for two models. In vLLM speculative decoding, total variation measured under teacher forcing predicts greedy draft acceptance with a mean relative error of $1.1$--$2.4%$, without the task-specific calibration that KL needs.

</details>


### [214] [Sequential Functional Structured Tucker Compression for Large Language Model Attentions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00717)
*Jiangfeng Chen,Xinyu Wang,Tianshuo Yan,Hanwei Wu,Xiao-Wen Chang,Yang Zhang,Lei Ding*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出FTC框架，通过顺序结构化压缩和联合利用Q/K/V头结构，在固定存储预算下优化LLM注意力机制，无需微调即可实现更低困惑度和更好的下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM注意力后训练压缩方法通常将其表述为独立的矩阵近似，忽略了注意力投影之间的共享结构以及由早期压缩引入的表示偏移问题。

Method: FTC是一种顺序结构化压缩框架，它在当前压缩模型的基础上自适应地调整近似过程，并在固定存储预算下联合利用原生的Q/K/V头结构；输出投影单独处理以应对注意力后表示的变化。该方法不需要微调或基于梯度的恢复。

Result: 在7个从6B到32B参数的解码器专用LLM上进行了测试。FTC在所有测试的保持比率下，在5个现代GQA模型上的WikiText-2困惑度均低于对比方法，且在激进压缩条件下增益最大。这些改进能迁移到下游任务中，且在32B规模下保持显著效果。

Conclusion: FTC框架通过考虑共享结构和表示偏移，实现了比现有独立矩阵近似方法更高效的LLM注意力压缩，提升了模型性能和泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-training compression of LLM attention is often formulated as independent matrix approximation, ignoring both the shared structure among attention projections and the representation shift introduced by earlier compression. We propose FTC, a sequential structured compression framework that adapts the approximation to the current compressed model while jointly exploiting the native Q/K/V head structure under a fixed storage budget. The output projection is handled separately to account for the changed post-attention representation. FTC requires neither fine-tuning nor gradient-based recovery. Across seven decoder-only LLMs from 6B to 32B parameters, FTC achieves the lowest WikiText-2 perplexity among the compared methods at every tested keep ratio on five modern GQA models, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. The improvements transfer to downstream tasks and remain substantial at the 32B scale.

</details>


### [215] [Reason in Style: Discovering and Controlling Style in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00724)
*Ioana Marinescu,Eric Karl Oermann,Kyunghyun Cho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无监督算法，从语言模型输出中分离内容与风格表示。通过微调学生模型并显式控制风格，实现了回答风格的多样化与平衡，显著提升了数学推理任务的表现（Pass@$k$），证实了风格可控性及其对解题正确率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型联合学习内容与风格，导致其输出中的风格变化难以识别和控制。旨在研究能否在无监督情况下发现模型响应中的重复风格，并实现显式控制。

Method: 设计算法以分离语言和模型输出中的内容与风格表示；在受控的数学问题设置中验证有效性；应用该方法分析来自九个不同教师模型的10万+验证轨迹，发现六种重复但不平衡的风格；利用重要性加权平衡风格贡献，微调小型学生模型以在显式条件引导下遵循这些风格。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准测试中，该方法相比标准微调提高了Pass@$k$指标；证实了请求风格与实际生成风格之间的强对应关系；发现风格影响解题正确率，且不同问题受益于不同风格。

Conclusion: 模型生成数据中的风格变异可以通过无监督方式被发现并显式化，这不仅提供了对生成内容的控制能力，还能提升推理性能。

Abstract: Language models learn content and style jointly, making stylistic variation in their outputs difficult to identify and control. We study whether recurring styles in model responses can be discovered without supervision and explicitly controlled. We design an algorithm that learns to separate representations of content and style from language models' outputs and validate its effectiveness on math questions in a controlled setting. By applying this method to over 100K verified traces from nine distinct teacher models, we discover six recurring yet imbalanced styles. We then fine-tune smaller student models to follow these styles when explicitly conditioned on them, using importance weighting to balance the contribution of the styles represented in the corpus. This approach improves Pass@$k$ over standard fine-tuning on the same data across six math reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that we can diversify the style of answers effectively. We confirm that this also results in strong correspondence between requested and realized styles. We find that style affects correctness: the probability of solving a problem depends on the style we condition on, and different problems benefit from different styles. In summary, our results show that stylistic variation in model-generated data can be discovered in an unsupervised way, and made explicit, providing a source of both control and improved reasoning performance.

</details>


### [216] [Effective Synthetic Data Curation Requires Group-Level Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00779)
*Cathy Jiao,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出，仅依赖个体级信号（孤立评估数据效用）进行合成数据筛选不足够，必须引入考虑样本间相互作用的群体级信号。研究发现群体级信号对提升模型生成能力至关重要，且随着合成数据比例增加其价值更高。为此，作者提出了一种低成本诊断方法，能在有限计算预算下优先筛选需群体级评估的数据组，从而以极低成本获得接近全量群体级评分的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据对大语言模型（LLM）训练至关重要，但大规模使用可能导致模型生成能力退化。现有的数据筛选实践主要基于“个体级信号”（即孤立估计每个样本的效用），然而这种方法是不足的，需要确定哪些合成数据值得用于训练，并探索更有效的数据策展方法。

Method: 1. 理论分析：对比个体级信号与群体级信号（考虑样本间相互作用）在预训练和微调阶段的有效性。
2. 实证研究：验证不同合成数据集组成在两种信号下的表现差异，特别是在生成能力上的下游性能。
3. 实验比较：评估多种常用数据策展方法，分析其在合成数据管道中随群体级信号权重增加的性能变化。
4. 实用工具开发：提出一种低成本的诊断方法，用于识别最需要群体级估算的合成数据组，以优化计算资源分配。

Result: 1. 个体级信号无法捕捉样本间的联合影响，导致无法区分具有不同组成但个体效用相似的数据集；而基于群体级信号筛选的数据能显著提升下游性能，尤其是生成能力。
2. 随着训练管道中合成数据比例的增加，群体级信号的重要性日益凸显；只有纳入群体级信号的方法才能优于基线，且收益随样本间关系权重的增加而放大。
3. 提出的低成本诊断方法能够恢复大部分全量群体级评分的收益，但计算成本仅为其中一小部分。

Conclusion: 在合成数据驱动的大模型训练中，传统的个体级数据筛选策略已显不足，必须采用考虑样本间相互作用的群体级信号来有效策展数据。这不仅提升了模型的生成能力，也为在计算受限场景下高效利用合成数据提供了切实可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Synthetic data now is essential to LLM training, used to strengthen advanced capabilities such as autonomous and long-horizon task execution. Yet recent work shows that training on it at scale can degrade model generation, making it important to decide what synthetic data is worth training on. While current data curation practices do so with individual-level signals (i.e., estimates of each data sample's training utility in isolation), across pre-training and post-training settings we show that this is insufficient for synthetic data, and that group-level signals (i.e., estimates of utility that account for interactions among data samples) are necessary for effective data curation. First, we show that individual-level signals are blind to how samples jointly affect training: synthetic datasets with different compositions can be indistinguishable under individual-level influence yet differ sharply under group-level influence, and curating by the latter yields better downstream performance, particularly in generative capability. Second, we find that group-level signals matter more as training pipelines become increasingly synthetic: among widely used data curation methods, only those incorporating them improve over baseline, with gains increasing when weights capturing relations among samples are amplified. Finally, we translate these findings into practice -- for model developers under a compute budget, we offer a cheap diagnostic that prioritizes which groups of synthetic data most need group-level estimation, recovering much of the benefit of full group-level scoring at a fraction of the compute cost.

</details>


### [217] [Can large language models unlock discrete data in ophthalmic diagnostic reports?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00795)
*Umair A. Zaidi,An-Lun Wu,Wei-Chun Lin,Thomas S. Hwang,Michelle R. Hribar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估了GPT-4o辅助的大语言模型（LLM）通过两种提示策略从眼科诊断PDF报告中提取结构化数据的准确性与效率。结果显示，两种方法均实现了极高的值准确率（100%或接近），其中“仅提示”法在值准确率上表现最佳，“架构约束”法在格式合规性上达到100%。相比人工审核，LLM处理时间减少了约92%，证明了其在数据抽象中的高效性与高准确性潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）在处理眼科诊断PDF报告时，利用不同提示策略提取结构化数据的准确性和效率，以解决传统人工数据提取耗时的问题。

Method: 使用20份去标识化的眼科报告（涵盖视野、OCT青光眼概览、OCT视网膜神经纤维层单次检查、OCT厚度图四种类型，每种5份）。采用两种GPT-4o辅助管道进行处理：1. 架构约束法（Schema-Constrained）：使用预定义的JSON Schema的结构化输出模式；2. 仅提示法（Prompt-Only）：使用详细指令提示后通过Python转换为JSON。将结果与人工核对的真实标签进行比较，评估指标包括值准确率、格式准确率和提取时间。

Result: 1. 值准确率：“仅提示”法在所有四种报告类型中均达到100.00%的准确率；“架构约束”法在视野和RNFL单次检查中为100.00%，青光眼概览为97.45%，厚度图为98.00%。
2. 格式准确率：“架构约束”法在所有类型中均为100.00%；“仅提示”法除RNFL单次检查（90.14%）外均为100.00%。
3. 效率：人工审核平均耗时56.51秒/报告，而“架构约束”法为5.04秒，“仅提示”法为4.70秒，处理时间减少约92%。

Conclusion: 在小样本概念验证数据集中，通用LLM辅助管道能够从眼科诊断PDF中提取结构化数据，兼具高准确性和显著的时间效率提升。“仅提示”法在值准确率上最优，“架构约束”法在格式合规性上更稳定。两者的互补优势支持未来对混合、验证感知工作流的进一步评估，适用于研究和临床数据抽象。

Abstract: Objective: To assess the accuracy and efficiency of a large language model (LLM) using two prompt strategies to extract structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDF reports. Methods: Twenty deidentified reports across four types (Visual Field, OCT Glaucoma Overview, OCT retinal nerve fiber layer Single Exam, and OCT Thickness Map; n = 5 each) were processed using two GPT-4o-assisted pipelines and compared with a reconciled manual ground truth. Schema-Constrained used Structured Output mode with a predefined JSON Schema; Prompt-Only used a detailed instruction prompt followed by Python conversion to JSON. Outcomes were value accuracy, formatting accuracy, and extraction time. Results: Schema-Constrained value accuracy was 100.00% for Visual Field and RNFL Single Exam, 97.45% for Glaucoma Overview, and 98.00% for Thickness Map; Prompt-Only achieved 100.00% across all four report types. Formatting accuracy was 100.00% for Schema-Constrained across all report types and 100.00% for Prompt-Only except RNFL Single Exam (90.14%). Mean extraction time was 56.51 s per report for manual review versus 5.04 s for Schema-Constrained and 4.70 s for Prompt-Only, an approximately 92% reduction. Conclusions: In this small proof-of-concept dataset, general-purpose LLM-assisted pipelines extracted structured data from ophthalmic diagnostic PDFs with high accuracy and substantially reduced processing time. Prompt-Only achieved the highest value accuracy, while Schema-Constrained produced schema-compliant output with 100% formatting accuracy. These complementary strengths support further evaluation of hybrid, validation-aware workflows for research and clinical data abstraction.

</details>


### [218] [Verbalized and Internal Probabilities Are Coupled in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00827)
*Sinead Williamson,Jiaxuan Li,Nick Foti,Russ Webb,Masha Fedzechkina*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究通过干预训练数据中的不确定性来源，系统探索了大语言模型（LLM）内部概率与口头化置信度之间的对齐关系。研究发现两者均受分布性和断言性不确定性影响，且存在超越独立追踪预期源的对齐现象，表明口头化概率可作为探测模型内部分布的有效代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已知内部概率反映训练数据的相对频率，口头化概率反映显式概率断言，但二者是否对齐尚不明确，这限制了对何时能使用口头化不确定性作为训练数据频率或模型内部分布代理的理解。

Method: 通过干预数据中潜在的不确定性来源，系统探索LLM的概率读数如何受到训练数据和上下文数据的影响。

Result: 内部和口头化的概率读数均受到训练数据中分布性不确定性和断言性不确定性的影响；此外，口头化概率与内部概率的对齐程度高于仅独立追踪相同不确定性源的预期水平。

Conclusion: 口头化概率可用于探测模型的内部分布，弥补了此前对两种不确定性读数之间关系的认知空白。

Abstract: Large language models carry an internal notion of uncertainty in their sampling distribution, i.e., the probabilities they place on generating one answer rather than another. They can also be asked to state a confidence, in words or as a number: a verbalized uncertainty. Prior work suggests that internal probabilities track relative frequencies in the training data, and that verbalized probabilities track explicit probabilistic assertions in the training data. However, we do not know whether these two readouts are aligned, except when frequencies and probabilistic assertions in the training data happen to align. This limits our understanding of when we can use verbalized uncertainties as a proxy for either training data frequencies, or a model's internal distribution. We resolve this gap by systematically exploring how LLMs probability readouts are impacted by training and in-context data, via intervening on the underlying uncertainty sources in the data. We find that both internal and verbalized probability readouts are impacted by both distributional and asserted uncertainty in the training data. Further, we find that verbalized and internal probabilities are aligned beyond what would be expected by independently tracking the same uncertainty sources, suggesting that verbalized probabilities can be used to probe a model's internal distribution.

</details>


### [219] [VERITYGATE: A Four-Gate Schema-Level Faithfulness Framework and Paired Benchmark for Grounded LLM Narrations over Structured Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00833)
*Sachin Gupta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出VERITYGATE，一个基于固定模式（证据ID、实体、数字、声明类型）的四门检查器，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）解释的结构一致性而非逐字事实核查。实验显示不同模型在验证下的通过率差异显著，且修复后生存率提升有限，强调需同时报告生存率和输出量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决流畅的LLM解释可能不遵循结构化系统证据的问题，提供一种机制来验证声明是否符合预设的证据和结构规范。

Method: 构建VERITYGATE四门检查器，针对GPT-4o-mini、Llama-3.3-70B和Claude Sonnet 4.6进行测试。采用固定模式合同进行验证，包含一次或多次修复迭代，并辅以小规模人类研究和特定领域GPT-4o法官测试。

Result: 在未修复前，80.3%的mini声明和47.9%的Sonnet声明因不符合模式而被拒绝。经过一次修复，mini的声明生存率从19.7%提升至28.0%，Sonnet从52.1%提升至54.3%。Gate 4在r=1时覆盖了绝大多数失败声明。人类研究支持规则但揭示模式检查与正确文本间的差距。

Conclusion: 仅靠模式级检查不足以保证文本质量，验证拒收率不等于幻觉率。必须结合声明生存率和输出量共同评估模型性能。现有自动法官测试存在顺序效应，需谨慎使用。

Abstract: Fluent LLM explanations may not follow the evidence from a structured system. We present VERITYGATE, a four-gate checker for declared evidence IDs, entities, numbers, and claim types. It checks a fixed schema; it does not verify every fact in the prose. At r=0 and r=1, we test 900 instances per setting (450 grounded-ungrounded pairs) with GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Under this schema-level contract and before repair, 80.3% of mini claims and 47.9% of Sonnet claims fail. These are verifier rejection rates, not prose-hallucination rates. One repair pass raises claim survival from 19.7% to 28.0% for mini and from 52.1% to 54.3% for Sonnet. Verified claims per example change by +0.14 for mini, -0.71 for Llama, and -0.47 for Sonnet, so survival and output volume must be reported together. A second Sonnet pass gives no clear gain. At r=1, Gate 4 covers 97.0%, 98.7%, and 100% of failing claims for mini, Llama, and Sonnet. Small human studies support the rules but show gaps between schema checks and correct prose. A domain-specific GPT-4o judge test shows an order effect, so it is only a usefulness check. We release the code and data.

</details>


### [220] [Contextual trajectory and incremental contextual displacement: Towards using LLMs to understand dynamic, utterance-specific meaning construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00840)
*Grayson Wycliffe Storer,Julia Witte Zimmerman*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于Transformer的LLM中词级增量轨迹（Token-wise Incremental Trajectories）框架，通过追踪上下文嵌入随句子展开的演变过程，成功复现并量化了花园路径句等语言歧义现象的处理特征，证明了该框架在研究意义构建方面的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于Transformer的大语言模型（如RoBERTa）使用上下文词嵌入（CWEs），但缺乏对嵌入如何随语境逐步演变的系统性分析。旨在开发一种方法来捕捉这种动态变化，以更好地理解和量化语言处理中的歧义与误导现象。

Method: 1. 构建词级增量轨迹：通过逐步向句子添加单词并重复计算每个token的CWE，生成表示嵌入随话语展开而演变的轨迹。
2. 评估案例：使用具有典型特征的花园路径句（garden-path sentences）作为测试用例。
3. 引入指标：提出多种量化跨上下文增量的表征位移的指标。
4. 预测分析：利用轨迹信息预测句子类型，并探索其他歧义和误导相关的语言现象。

Result: 1. 词级轨迹成功复现了花园路径处理的关键特征，如在关键区域的干扰，并能可靠地区分花园路径句与其匹配的消歧控制句。
2. 轨迹信息对句子类型具有高预测性。
3. 发现与歧义相关的信息不仅存在于句子级别的CLS表示中，也分布在普通词汇token中，表明话语级别的信息分布在多个表征尺度上。
4. 在其他歧义和误导相关的语言现象中也发现了定性相似的轨迹结构。

Conclusion: 词级增量轨迹是一个有前景的框架，可用于使用大语言模型研究特定话语的意义构建过程，揭示了LLM内部表征的动态特性及其对语言歧义处理的模拟能力。

Abstract: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) such as RoBERTa represent text using contextual word embeddings (CWEs), which alter the embeddings associated with each token based on surrounding context. We construct token-wise incremental trajectories by repeatedly recomputing a token's CWE as successive words are added to a sentence, yielding a representation of how contextualized embeddings evolve as the utterance unfolds. We evaluate this approach using garden-path sentences as a test case with characteristic features. Token-wise trajectories reproduce known features of garden-path processing, including disruption around the critical region, and reliably distinguish garden-path sentences from matched disambiguated controls. We introduce several metrics for quantifying representational displacement across contextual increments and show that trajectory information can be highly predictive of sentence type. We find that ambiguity-related information is recoverable not only from the sentence-level CLS representation but also from ordinary vocabulary tokens, suggesting that utterance-level information is distributed across multiple representational scales. In exploratory analyses, we find qualitatively similar trajectory structures in other ambiguity- and misdirection-related linguistic phenomena. Together, these results establish token-wise incremental trajectories as a promising framework for studying utterance-specific meaning construction using LLMs.

</details>


### [221] [Child-Adapted Structured Phonological Representations for Interpretable Speech Sound Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00852)
*Abner Hernandez,Tomás Arias Vergara,Andreas Maier,Paula Andrea Pérez-Toro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究将PhonoQ-2.0模型适配于儿童语音，发现适应后声门识别率显著提升，发音方式对对齐监督条件敏感，而发音部位表现稳定，且保留了软腭前移对比特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的结构化语音表示模型主要基于成人语音训练，缺乏对儿童语音的有效处理能力，亟需开发适用于儿童语音的适配模型以提高解释性和准确性。

Method: 使用CHILDES-Aligned数据，采用两种初始化策略（成人PhonoQ迁移学习和从头训练）和三种对齐监督条件（仅成人、成人与儿童混合、仅儿童），在1352个来自58名正常发育儿童的辅音目标上进行实验，并与手动标注进行对比评估。

Result: 1. 声门识别：儿童语音适应显著提升了所有监督条件下的识别率，从成人模型的0.922 macro-F1提升至0.972-0.987。
2. 发音方式：对对齐监督条件敏感，成人+儿童MFA达到0.804/0.796，优于仅成人监督的约0.70。
3. 发音部位：整体表现较强（0.871-0.902），但类间性能差异大。
4. 纵向分析：UltraPhonix显示特定的软腭和齿龈后变化在各模型中保持一致，符合临床进展。

Conclusion: 针对儿童语音的PhonoQ-2.0适配有效提高了语音结构的识别精度，特别是声门和发音方式的识别，证明了多源数据和特定监督策略在儿童语音处理中的重要性，并验证了模型在捕捉临床相关语音变化方面的可靠性。

Abstract: Structured phonological representations provide an interpretable alternative to generic speech embeddings, but existing models are largely trained on adult speech. We adapt PhonoQ-2.0 to child speech using CHILDES-Aligned data and compare three alignment-supervision conditions (Adult, Adult+Child, and Child-only) across two initialization strategies (Adult PhonoQ and scratch). Generalization is evaluated against manual child-speech annotations. On 1,352 consonant targets from 58 typically developing children, child-speech adaptation improves voicing recognition across all supervision conditions, from 0.922 macro-F1 for Adult PhonoQ to 0.972--0.987 after adaptation. Manner is more sensitive to alignment supervision: Adult+Child MFA reaches 0.804 and 0.796, compared to approximately 0.70 under Adult MFA supervision. Place remains comparatively strong across systems (0.871--0.902), although per-class performance varies substantially. The velar-fronting contrast is preserved across all seven model variants. Longitudinal UltraPhonix analysis further reveals speaker-specific velar and post-alveolar changes that are largely preserved across models and broadly consistent with reported clinical progress.

</details>


### [222] [DeBERTa-ConPara: Attack-Aware and Deployment-Realistic Detection of AI-Generated Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00883)
*Mohamed Mady,Yupei Li,Johannes Reschke,Björn W. Schuller*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出DeBERTa-ConPara检测器，发现训练时去重与推理时归一化相反的效果，最佳配置为“原始训练+归一化推理”，在RAID测试集上AUROC达99.61%，显著提升同形字符和零宽空格攻击的检测率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决AI生成文本在部署条件下因分布偏移、对抗性扰动及缺乏目标域标签而导致的检测性能下降问题。

Method: 构建结合攻击感知Unicode预处理与上下文Transformer编码器的检测模型（DeBERTa-ConPara），在HC3 Plus、M4、MAGE和RAID数据集上训练，并通过因子实验对比不同预处理位置的影响。
