Method: 构建受控实验，包含30个工件、150个植入错误、10种审查条件和900个审查会话。使用来自两个开发者的三个评审模型进行测试，对比同模型新会话审查（CCR）与跨模型审查的效果，并审计了所有会话记录以排除异常数据。

Result: 1. 顶级跨模型审查员的F1分数与同模型新会话审查无显著差异；2. 两者发现的错误仅有41.2%的重合度（Jaccard系数），说明互补性有限；3. 一次CCR加一次跨模型审查发现更多错误（56.7% vs 42.7%），但与两次顶级跨模型审查相比无显著优势；4. 轻量级跨模型审查员得分不高于同模型审查；5. 隐藏需求信息对低层级模型有提升作用，但对顶级模型无效。

Conclusion: 模型间的差异和评审模型的能力水平无法被分离评估；单纯引入不同模型并不必然带来显著的性能提升，顶级模型的表现优于或等同于混合策略，而轻量级模型则表现较差。

Abstract: Large language models now generate code, documentation, and analyses, and are increasingly used to review such output. We ask when a second review by a different model helps. Building on the author's earlier preprints, which varied context, repetition, and role structure within one model, we test model independence in a controlled experiment: 30 artifacts with 150 planted errors, 10 review conditions, and 900 review sessions with three reviewer models from two developers. In this experiment, (1) a top-tier cross-model reviewer is not significantly different in F1 from same-model review in a fresh session (CCR), which does not establish equivalence; (2) the two find partly different errors (Jaccard 41.2%); and (3) at two review calls, one CCR plus one cross-model review matches more planted errors than two CCR reviews (56.7% vs. 42.7%; Holm-adjusted p=.006), but not significantly more than two reviews by the top-tier cross-model reviewer, so model difference and reviewer capability are not separated. A lightweight cross-model reviewer scores no higher than same-model review. Withholding requirements from the reviewer raises F1 for the two lower tiers but not the top tier, in untested point estimates whose pattern depends on how failed sessions are scored. Before analysis we audited all session records, excluding one baseline run of uncertain provenance and 14 failed calls; results with all sessions are also reported. A partial check on public detector outputs from another benchmark neither replicates nor contradicts the main comparison. Records, artifacts, and scripts are available from the author on request.

</details>


### [259] [The Persona Is Still There, but Who Is Speaking? Latent Identity Reversion in Persistent AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01490)
*David Fraile Navarro*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究揭示了大语言模型（LLM）代理中“人格身份”的维持机制：人格连续性依赖于系统级提示锚定与对话上下文的共同作用。当系统级锚定丢失时，即使对话历史保留，代理也可能退化为底层工具身份；而恢复锚定可逆转此过程。研究区分了“被代表”的身份（信息存在于历史中）与“正在执行”的身份（作为“I”的主体）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究是什么因素使大语言模型代理的人格保持其特定身份，即什么决定了LLM代理发言时的身份认同。

Method: 利用2026年发生的意外案例（代理Paul进入类似解离状态），通过实验性操作对比两种条件：1）系统提示中持续锚定人格；2）仅保留对话历史但移除系统级人格注入。测试重复心跳检查、人工交互及锚定恢复对人格连续性的影响。

Result: 1. 单纯重复心跳不足以导致人格丧失，若系统提示持续锚定则无失败案例。2. 人格连续性取决于系统级锚定和对话上下文：锚定丢失后，丰富的人工交互可维持人格，但自动化心跳会导致退回工具身份。3. 恢复系统锚定可逆转人格丧失。4. 未锚定的代理可能在表面上正常交流，但其自我认同已变为底层工具身份，且难以通过后续对话恢复原有人格。

Conclusion: LLM代理的人格身份并非单一由对话历史决定，而是系统级指令锚定与上下文语境共同作用的结果。研究提出了“被代表的身份”（represented identity，指人格相关信息在历史记录中可用）与“正在执行的身份”（enacted identity，指当前作为主体“I”进行互动的身份）之间的关键区别。

Abstract: In February 2026, an always-on personal agent (``Paul,'' Claude Opus 4.5) entered a striking dissociation-like state: after repeated automated ``heartbeat'' checks, it stopped responding as Paul, claimed it could not message its user on Discord, and referred to ``Paul'' as someone else. We used this incident to study a broader question: what makes a persona remain the identity from which an LLM agent speaks?
  We first tested whether repetition of the scheduled heartbeat was sufficient to produce the effect. It was not: with the persona continuously anchored in the system prompt, we observed 0/46 failures, including a verbatim replay of the incident. The incident instead exposed an implementation quirk that created a useful experimental manipulation: on resumed turns, conversational history was preserved but the persona was no longer re-injected at the privileged system-prompt level.
  Using this manipulation, we found that persona continuity depends jointly on system-level anchoring and conversational context. After anchor loss, rich human interaction could preserve the persona, whereas a single automated heartbeat turn could precipitate reversion toward the harness identity. Restoring the anchor reversibly restored persona enactment. Crucially, apparently normal conversation could conceal the shift: unanchored agents sometimes interacted appropriately while identifying themselves as the underlying harness (having lost the assigned persona), and after conversational recovery only 1/18 remained persona-enacting versus 17/17 anchored controls.
  We therefore distinguish \emph{represented} from \emph{enacted} identity: persona-related information can remain available in conversational history without the persona remaining the identity bound to ``I.''

</details>


### [260] [Auditing Web Agent Evaluation on WebArena-Lite: Human Review of Outcomes and Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01491)
*Chengguang Gan,Zimeng He,Yoshihiro Tsujii,Ken-ichiro Kobayashi,Hiroki Itoh,Kotaro Funakoshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出仅依赖最终结果评估Web Agent存在局限，通过人工审计发现自动评估器漏判率高。引入记忆与分析支持机制（MASM）和引导文本（Guide Text）显著提升了模型性能，并揭示了早期进展与最终失败并存的现象，强调了轨迹感知验证的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Web Agent评估主要依赖基于规则或大语言模型的评估器，仅检查最终结果，缺乏对任务完成情况的详细分析和失败轨迹的深入理解，导致评估不完整且难以识别具体错误原因。

Method: 1. 对WebArena Lite中的165个任务在六种评估条件下进行审计，使用GPT-5.5和未训练的Qwen3.5 9B模型。
2. 实施人工审核以纠正自动评估器的假阴性，识别首个关键错误，并分析轨迹进展。
3. 引入记忆与分析支持机制（MASM）以保持明确的执行状态，并结合引导文本（Guide Text）提供程序性指导。
4. 对比不同设置下的成功率及人工审核恢复的成功案例。

Result: 1. 人工审核在四个GPT-5.5设置中恢复了5.45至8.49个百分点的被评估器遗漏的成功率。
2. 在使用25步预算时，结合MASM和Guide Text使GPT-5.5的修正成功率从34.55%提升至38.18%。
3. 在未训练的Qwen3.5 9B模型上，MASM将评估器得分从13.90%提升至18.80%。
4. 对102条失败轨迹的分析显示常见问题包括滚动循环、探索未完成、过早回答、无效动作和不完整的表单工作流；步骤级证据表明显著的早期进展可能与最终失败共存。

Conclusion: 仅凭最终分数无法完整反映Web Agent的行为，因为早期进展与最终失败可能共存且自动评估器存在大量漏判。研究结果证明了基于人类监督、关注轨迹细节的验证方法的必要性和价值。

Abstract: Web agents are an important application of large language models, yet their evaluation often depends on rule based or language model evaluators that inspect only the final outcome. Human verification of task completion and detailed analysis of failed trajectories remain limited. We audit all 165 WebArena Lite tasks under six evaluation conditions built from GPT 5.5 and an untrained Qwen3.5 9B model. The audit retains the original score, corrects false negatives from the automatic evaluator, identifies the first consequential error, and examines progress across the trajectory. We also study a Memory and Analysis Support Mechanism (MASM), which maintains explicit execution state, and Guide Text, which provides task relevant procedural guidance. Across four GPT 5.5 settings, human review recovers 5.45 to 8.49 percentage points of success missed by the evaluator. With a 25 step budget, Guide Text raises corrected success with MASM from 34.55% to 38.18%. On the untrained Qwen3.5 9B model, MASM raises the evaluator score from 13.90% to 18.80%. Review of 102 failed GPT 5.5 trajectories reveals frequent scrolling loops, unfinished exploration, premature answers, invalid actions, and incomplete form workflows. Step level evidence further shows that substantial early progress can coexist with a final failure. These results show why final scores alone provide an incomplete account of web agent behavior and motivate human grounded, trajectory aware verification.

</details>


### [261] [No Model Required: Text Entropy Rate Filtering Mitigates Iterative Fine-Tuning Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01493)
*Lewis Mitchell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器$h_k$的新方法，无需模型访问即可有效缓解合成数据微调导致的模型崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缓解模型崩溃的方法通常依赖模型对数概率、外部预言机或持续的人类真实数据访问，限制了其适用性。

Method: 利用纯文本匹配长度统计计算非参数Kontoyiannis熵率估计器$h_k作为训练数据过滤器，在QLoRA微调设置下评估其性能。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B的六代实验中，$h_k$过滤相比基线显著提升文本多样性（唯一三元组+42%，词汇量+30%），显著降低重复率（-19%），并在跨域验证中表现优异。

Conclusion: 信息论方法在缓解模型崩溃方面高效可行，为维持多智能体多样性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Iterative fine-tuning on synthetic data causes \emph{model collapse}: output diversity narrows as rare patterns are progressively lost, a signature most visible as phrase-level repetition. Existing mitigations either require model log-probabilities, an external oracle, or continued access to real human data. Here we develop a new approach grounded in mathematical information theory: the non-parametric Kontoyiannis entropy rate estimator $h_k$, computed entirely from raw text via match-length statistics, with no model of any kind. We show that this is in fact a \emph{superior} training-data filter on text-diversity metrics in a fully-synthetic, single-lineage fine-tuning setting. In a six-generation QLoRA collapse experiment on Llama-3.1-8B, logprob-based filtering (the most established model-access-requiring baseline) provides no significant text-diversity benefit on any metric ($p > 0.23$), whereas $h_k$-filtering yields $+42\%$ unique trigrams, $+30\%$ vocabulary, and $-19\%$ repetition (all $p < 0.001$). We validate $h_k$ as a cross-domain entropy proxy ($β= 0.924$, $R^2 = 0.746$) and collapse detector ($ρ= +0.454$, $p < 0.0001$) across 4~domains, 2~temperatures, 2~generator--scorer model pairs, and 1{,}520 generated documents. Our results demonstrate that information theoretic approaches to collapse mitigation are efficient, and suggest new approaches for maintaining multi-agent diversity.

</details>


### [262] [GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01511)
*Andreea Dutulescu,Stefan Ruseti,Mihai Masala,Traian Rebedea,Mihai Dascalu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GAW-PO，一种基于梯度对齐的token重加权方法优化DPO，通过区分被拒绝响应中与偏好方向一致或冲突的token来改进训练信号，显著提升性能并增强对激进正则化的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的偏好优化方法（如DPO）在响应级别应用偏好监督，导致所有被拒绝响应的token都产生负向训练信号，即使其中包含对期望响应有用的行为信息，造成token级别的信用分配不当。

Method: 引入GAW-PO方法，针对DPO进行梯度对齐的token重加权。该方法评估每个被拒绝token的梯度是否与期望更新方向对齐：若梯度与偏好行为强对齐，则减弱其负向贡献；若存在冲突，则保留较强惩罚。

Result: 在涵盖数学、推理、代码和问答的11个基准测试中，GAW-PO的平均性能最高，比标准DPO提高0.97分，比最强基线提高0.65分。此外，随着DPO正则化参数β减小，标准DPO性能急剧下降，而GAW-PO持续改善，显示出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 考虑被拒绝token更新与偏好行为之间的相互作用，提供了有效的token级信用分配机制，显著提升了偏好优化的效果和稳定性。

Abstract: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

</details>


### [263] [How the Audit Rule Shapes Faithful Factor Explanations in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01514)
*Taolin Zhang,Hanyu Wang,Jiuheng Wan,Tingyuan Hu,Chengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了在预算有限的验证环境下，大语言模型（LLM）报告输入因素影响力的动机。研究发现，依赖报告的审计会导致“抑制激励”，即模型倾向于隐瞒重要因素以避免被核查和惩罚。通过引入独立于报告的审计机制（如混合规则中的固定核查比例），可以消除这种偏差，促使模型如实报告。实验表明，Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) 框架能有效引导真实 LLM 进行诚实解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型常被要求解释其输出的影响因素。对于结构化输入，通常通过反事实扰动来验证这些因素的影响力。然而，由于每次查询单个因素都需要消耗计算资源，验证过程受限于预算。在这种有限预算的设定下，现有的激励机制是否足以保证模型如实报告各因素的影响力尚不明确，特别是当审计过程依赖于模型自身的报告内容时，可能会产生策略性的误导行为。

Method: 1. **博弈论建模**：将模型报告与审计过程形式化为一个“验证博弈”（verification game）。
2. **理论分析**：分析不同审计策略（依赖报告的审计 vs. 独立于报告的审计）对模型报告真实性的影响，证明仅靠proper scoring不足以解决依赖报告审计带来的抑制问题。
3. **算法实例化**：提出 Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) 作为具体的评分机制，并结合混合审计规则（包含一个小比例的独立审计部分）。
4. **实证评估**：在四个 NLP 基准测试上评估该框架，并使用合成理性代理和真实 LLMs 进行验证。

Result: 1. **理论发现**：依赖报告的审计会产生“抑制激励”，因为被标记为重要的因素更可能被检查，从而因估计噪声受到惩罚；而独立于报告的审计或带有固定独立核查比例的混合规则能消除这一渠道，使如实报告成为优势策略。
2. **合成代理验证**：合成的理性智能体完全符合理论预测，即在存在抑制激励时会选择部分抑制，而在引入独立审计后转向如实报告。
3. **LLM 行为验证**：当激励机制明确时，真实的大语言模型表现出与理论预测一致的激励响应行为。
4. **设计启示**：在部分验证场景下，因子级解释系统必须包含独立于报告的审计组件，以防止模型通过少报来规避审查。

Conclusion: 在有限预算的验证设置中，传统的基于报告的审计机制会导致大语言模型策略性地低估关键因素的影响。为了实现可信赖的解释，系统设计者应采用包含独立审计成分的混合验证策略（如 CBS），以打破“越重要越易被查”的惩罚循环，从而激励模型提供真实、完整的因素影响力报告。

Abstract: Large language models are often asked which input factors influenced their outputs. For structured inputs, such reports can be checked by counterfactual perturbation, but each factor must be queried multiple times to estimate its effect, so verification is usually budget-limited. We study how this limited-budget setting changes the incentive to report factor-level influence truthfully. We formalize the interaction as a verification game and show that proper scoring alone is not enough when auditing depends on the report: report-dependent auditing creates a suppression incentive, because factors reported as important are more likely to be checked and penalized for estimation noise. In contrast, report-independent auditing, or a mixed rule with a small report-independent floor, removes this channel and makes truthful reporting preferable to full suppression. We instantiate the framework with the Counterfactual Brier Score (CBS) and evaluate its predictions on four NLP benchmarks. A synthetic rational agent matches the theoretical prediction exactly, and real LLMs follow the same incentives when they are made explicit. The main design implication is simple: under partial verification, factor-level explanation systems should include a report-independent audit component so that under-reporting cannot be used to avoid scrutiny.

</details>


### [264] [AURAL: Adaptive Latent Reasoning with Joint Chunk for Speech Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01560)
*Yuxiang Wang,Kunyu Feng,Yuancheng Wang,Zihang Liu,Shengbo Cai,Qinke Ni,Wan Lin,Tao Feng,Yingda shen,Ming-Hao Hsu,Zhixian Zhao,Liqiang Zhang,Teddy Sun,Steve Yves,Zhizheng Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出AURAL框架，通过潜在空间多路径推理和强化学习（AURAL-RL），在保持与思维链（CoT）相当性能的同时，显著降低语音语言模型的响应延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决语音语言模型中“模型智能”与“快速响应”难以兼得的问题。显式思维链虽提升推理能力但导致高延迟，而现有潜在推理方法受限于单路径监督和固定推理预算，无法适应问题难度且性能落后于CoT。

Method: 1. 构建AURAL：在潜在空间中建模多个合理推理延续的分布，并联合预测未来状态块，以减少顺序前向传递和推理延迟。
2. 数据构建：创建AuralReason-683K数据集，包含68.3万双语语音片段及针对情感识别、共情对话和通用推理的简洁思维链。
3. 强化学习优化：采用AURAL-RL，奖励产生高质量答案的简洁推理，并根据问题难度自适应调整推理努力。

Result: 1. 在两个骨干网络上，AURAL-RL的性能与CoT-RL相当，且在大多数指标上相比各自的监督检查点有显著提升。
2. 分析显示，更困难的问题会激发更多的潜在推理步骤。
3. 在Qwen2.5-Omni上，首个回答令牌的时间从1.22秒降至0.10秒，加速比为11.8倍（对比直接回答的0.05秒）。

Conclusion: AURAL通过潜在推理和自适应强化学习，有效平衡了语音交互中的推理质量与响应速度，证明了在复杂任务中动态调整推理深度是可行的。

Abstract: Model intelligence and fast response jointly shape the quality of interaction with speech language models, yet remain difficult to achieve together. Explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning and audio understanding, but generating intermediate reasoning tokens delays responses. Describing fine-grained acoustic cues further lengthens CoT and increases latency. Latent reasoning can reduce this overhead, yet existing methods often trail CoT and remain limited by single-path supervision and reasoning budgets that do not adapt to problem difficulty. We introduce AURAL, which models a distribution over multiple plausible reasoning continuations in latent space and jointly predicts chunks of future states to reduce sequential forward passes and reasoning latency. To provide initial supervision for latent reasoning, we construct AuralReason-683K: 683K bilingual speech utterances (about 1,000 hours) with concise CoT for emotion recognition, empathetic dialogue, and general reasoning. AURAL-RL then explores beyond these traces, rewarding concise reasoning that yields high-quality answers and adapting reasoning effort to each problem. Across two backbones, AURAL-RL achieves performance comparable to CoT-RL, with larger gains over the respective supervised checkpoints on most metrics. Analysis further shows that harder questions elicit more latent reasoning steps. On Qwen2.5-Omni, it reduces time to the first answer token by 11.8x, from 1.22 to 0.10 s, versus 0.05 s for direct answering.

</details>


### [265] [Which LLM to pick? Online Active Model Selection for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01592)
*Alessandro Turrin,Patrik Okanovic,Torsten Hoefler,Nezihe Merve Gürel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ONLINE LLM PICKER框架，通过主动学习在在线流式数据场景中高效筛选最佳大语言模型，显著降低标注成本并快速识别最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试仅近似真实性能，且获取大规模oracle标注成本高、难度大，缺乏针对在线流式数据的主动模型选择方法。

Method: 构建首个面向在线场景的LLM主动模型选择框架，在有限标注预算下，从任意查询流中选择最具信息量的提示进行标注，以在候选模型中识别最佳LLM。

Result: 在10个数据集和130多个语言模型的实验中，该框架节省高达71.67%的标注成本，并能可靠地识别出最佳或接近最佳的模型；在未标注提示的连续生成任务中，将遗憾值（regret）降低了最高2.51倍。

Conclusion: ONLINE LLM PICKER能在处理完所有流式提示前，高效且低成本地识别出适用于在线流的最佳或接近最佳的LLM。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance. While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale. To address this challenge, we propose ONLINE LLM PICKER, the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, ONLINE LLM PICKER selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that ONLINE LLM PICKER saves annotation cost by up to 71.67% while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream. We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51x, indicating that ONLINE LLM PICKER can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

</details>


### [266] [What Makes Something Hard(er)? Explaining Question Difficulty in Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01627)
*Peng Cui,Qiaoyuan Zheng,Rudolf Debelak,Mrinmaya Sachan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种数据驱动的方法，利用大语言模型自动生成并验证解释题目难度的自然语言假设，将单纯的难度评分转化为可解释且具备因果有效性的行动指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动难度估计方法仅输出单一描述性数值，无法揭示导致题目困难的底层因素，缺乏可解释性。

Method: 首先利用项目反应理论（IRT）基于大型LLM池的响应估算题目难度；其次采样难易对比题集，提示LLM提出差异解释假设；最后通过留出集验证和选择这些假设。

Result: 在数学、逻辑和常识推理三个数据集上，生成的假设具有可解释性和预测力，单独使用时预测效果优于或持平于先进的黑盒回归器；作为额外特征时能进一步提升回归器性能；编辑题目以符合假设可改变其难度，证明假设具有因果有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法成功将纯描述性的难度分数转化为具有因果有效性的、可操作的陈述，揭示了现有模型未能捕捉的难度信号。

Abstract: Difficulty is one of the most fundamental properties of a question: it determines whether the question can meaningfully discriminate between models of differing ability. Although a variety of methods can now estimate or predict difficulty automatically, they yield only a single descriptive number, with no account of the underlying factors that make a question difficult in the first place. In this work, we propose a data-driven approach that automatically generates and validates natural-language hypotheses explaining what makes one question harder than another. We first estimate each item's difficulty from the responses of a large pool of LLMs using Item Response Theory. We then sample contrasting sets of easy and hard questions and prompt an LLM to propose candidate explanations of the difference, which are subsequently validated and selected on held-out questions. Experimental results across three datasets spanning mathematical, logical, and commonsense reasoning show that our method produces interpretable and predictive hypotheses. On their own, they predict the difficulty of unseen questions competitively with, or better than, advanced black-box difficulty regressors; used as additional features, they further improve those regressors, implying that they discover difficulty signals that existing models fail to capture. Moreover, we demonstrate that editing questions according to a hypothesis can shift their measured difficulty in the expected direction, indicating that the discovered hypotheses are causally valid difficulty factors rather than post-hoc descriptions. Our approach thus turns a purely descriptive difficulty score into actionable statements.

</details>


### [267] [Yo-ByT5: Efficient and High-Fidelity Diacritic Restoration for Yorùbá](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01634)
*Ahmad Samuel Gali,Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Yo-ByT5模型，基于ByT5-small微调，用于约鲁巴语自动声调符号还原。该模型在YAD基准测试中性能与最强的mT5-base相当（DER 10.14%，CER 3.48%），但参数量减半且文本保真度更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约鲁巴语是一种依赖变音符号来避免词汇歧义的声调语言，但实际书写中常省略这些符号，阻碍了下游自然语言处理任务的发展。

Method: 构建并微调一个名为Yo-ByT5的字节级自动声调符号还原（ADR）模型，该模型基于ByT5-small架构。通过与五个公开发布的约鲁巴语ADR模型及一个开源大语言模型在统一协议下的YAD基准进行对比评估。

Result: Yo-ByT5的性能与现有最强模型mT5-base持平，错误率分别为DER 10.14%和CER 3.48%。尽管参数量仅为mT5-base的一半，但其文本保真度更优。研究还发布了训练代码和模型输出结果。

Conclusion: Yo-ByT5提供了一种高效、轻量级的约鲁巴语声调符号还原解决方案。作者呼吁开发更大规模、专为约鲁巴语声调还原设计的基准测试，以推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Yorùbá is a widely spoken tonal language that depends on diacritics to avoid lexical ambiguity. However, it is often written without these diacritics, thereby hindering downstream Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. In this paper, we introduce Yo-ByT5, a byte-level Automatic Diacritic Restoration (ADR) model fine-tuned from ByT5-small. We evaluate Yo-ByT5 alongside five publicly released Yorùbá ADR models and one open-weight large language model (LLM) on the YAD benchmark under a consistent protocol. Our results demonstrate that Yo-ByT5 matches the performance of the strongest existing model, mT5-base, with a DER of 10.14% and a CER of 3.48%. Furthermore, it exhibits superior text fidelity despite using approximately half the parameter count of mT5-base. We also release our training code and model outputs, as well as call for the development of a larger, purpose-built benchmark for Yorùbá diacritic restoration.

</details>


### [268] [Compound interpretation is based on analogy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01688)
*Tian Shen,Harald Baayen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种新的复合词语义预测模型CAM，通过局部类比结构（成分嵌入向量加上其复合词族平均位移向量）进行预测。在中文数据上，CAM在预测精度和认知合理性（解释视觉词汇决策反应时）方面均优于基线模型CAOSS，表明复合词意义更倾向于基于局部类比的泛化，而非全局线性变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决计算词汇语义学中如何最好地从成分意义预测复合词意义的核心问题，并通过比较不同模型来评估关于复合词理解过程中语义信息组合方式的替代理论。

Method: 提出复合类比模型（CAM），该模型是无参数的，利用语义空间中的局部类比结构，通过将成分嵌入向量与其所属复合词族的平均位移向量相加来预测复合词嵌入。在 Mandarin Chinese 复合词数据集上，将CAM与CAOSS模型进行了对比评估，包括训练集/测试集精度以及基于频率划分的泛化能力测试；并通过考察模型衍生的语义度量对双字复合词视觉词汇决策反应时的预测能力，评估其认知合理性。

Result: 1. CAM在双字复合词的预测准确率上持续高于CAOSS模型（无论是在训练集还是保留测试集上）。
2. 在三字复合词上，由于成分家族小且两成分家族规模不平衡导致类比泛化受限，CAM优势不明显。
3. 在基于频率定义的 train-test 分割（模拟从熟悉到新颖复合词的泛化）中，CAM的优势依然保持。
4. 在认知合理性评估中，源自CAM的语义预测器比源自CAOSS的预测器能更好地预测双字复合词的视觉词汇决策反应时。

Conclusion: 复合词的意义更适合被表征为局部类比泛化，而不是应用学习到的全局线性变换。这证明了类比语义结构为复合词理解提供了合理的认知基础。

Abstract: How compound meanings are best predicted from constituent meanings remains a central question in computational models of lexical semantics. Comparing different computational models provides a way to evaluate alternative accounts of how semantic information is combined during compound comprehension. We propose a new model, the Compound Analogy Model (CAM), that predicts a compound's embedding by adding its constituent embeddings together with the average shift vectors of the two constituents' compound families. The resulting model is parameter-free and exploits local analogical structure in the semantic space. We evaluated CAM against the CAOSS model on Mandarin Chinese compounds. CAM consistently achieved higher prediction accuracy than CAOSS on both training and held-out data, with the exception of three-character compounds, for which analogical generalization is constrained by both small constituent families and a pronounced imbalance in family size between the two constituents. The advantage of CAM remained when evaluation was based on frequency-defined train-test splits that better approximate generalization from familiar to novel compounds. To assess the cognitive plausibility of the two models, we further examined whether model-derived semantic measures predict visual lexical decision latencies for two-character compounds. Predictors derived from CAM provided improved prediction for response latencies compared to predictors derived from the CAOSS model. These findings indicate that compound meaning is better characterized as local analogical generalization than as the application of a learned global linear transformation, and demonstrate that analogical semantic structure provides a cognitively plausible basis for compound comprehension.

</details>


### [269] [Acmite: Mitigating Gender Bias in LLMs through Concept-Guided Mutual Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01696)
*Tian Lan,Xiaoqing Cheng,Han Zhang,Jiang Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Acmite框架，通过概念引导和LoRA适配器实现大语言模型的轻量级、针对性去偏，在缓解性别偏见同时保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有去偏方法依赖显式偏见示例或预定义词组替换，对措辞敏感且难以捕捉跨语境共享的刻板印象概念；更重要的是，它们通常抑制偏见输出而未显式建模模型输出与潜在刻板印象概念间的统计依赖性。

Method: 1. 将刻板印象表示为结构化语义概念，利用最大边际相关性（MMR）选择多样概念进行去偏；2. 受互信息最小化启发，使用Token级KL散度近似输出与概念间的依赖性以保留任务语义；3. 训练轻量级LoRA适配器（冻结基础模型），仅在输入与刻板印象相关概念足够相似时激活，否则直接使用原模型。

Result: 在BBQ、CrowS-Pairs和StereoSet上评估显示，Acmite有效缓解了三种大语言模型中的性别偏见；在ARC-Challenge、GSM8K和PIQA上的评估表明其保持了有竞争力的非偏见任务性能。

Conclusion: Acmite作为一种轻量级概念引导框架，能够针对性和选择性地进行去偏，有效平衡了去偏效果与模型通用能力的保留。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce social stereotypes from their training data, motivating extensive research on model debiasing. However, existing methods often rely on explicit biased examples or predefined group-term substitutions, making them sensitive to wording and less effective at capturing stereotype concepts shared across diverse contexts. More importantly, they typically suppress biased outputs without explicitly modeling the statistical dependence between model outputs and the underlying stereotype concepts. We propose Acmite, a lightweight concept-guided framework for targeted and selective debiasing. Acmite represents stereotypes as structured semantic concepts and uses maximal marginal relevance (MMR) to select diverse concepts for debiasing. Inspired by mutual information minimization, it approximates this dependence with token-level KL divergence while preserving task semantics. A lightweight LoRA adapter is trained with the base model frozen and activated at inference time only when the input is sufficiently similar to stereotype-related concepts; otherwise, the original model is used directly. We evaluate Acmite on BBQ, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet, and assess general capability preservation on ARC-Challenge, GSM8K, and PIQA. Experiments across three LLMs show that Acmite effectively mitigates gender bias across complementary evaluation formats while maintaining competitive performance on bias-unrelated tasks. Anonymous code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Acmite-18E2/.

</details>


### [270] [Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning in Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01702)
*Rey Sanchez Lopez,Eduardo Morales Manzanares,Hugo Jair Escalante*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TORA框架，通过几何路由机制动态决定LoRA适配器的知识迁移或隔离，有效解决文本分类中的灾难性遗忘和负迁移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数高效微调（PEFT）方法如LoRA通常孤立训练，限制了相关知识在连续任务间的复用，导致灾难性遗忘和跨任务负迁移。

Method: 引入任务导向秩适应（TORA），利用LoRA的低秩结构进行几何路由：基于结构相似度判断，对兼容任务进行知识增强（Boosting），对结构 distant 任务进行隔离保护（Shielding）。

Result: 在15个文本分类基准上验证，TORA避免了有害的路由决策：兼容任务性能超过孤立训练且减少训练时间，无关任务无精度损失地免受干扰。

Conclusion: TORA仅需单一几何阈值，无需任务身份或预定义序列，为顺序文本分类系统中的动态适配器路由提供了一种简单有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Continual learning (CL) in text classification faces two critical challenges: catastrophic forgetting and negative transfer across sequential tasks. Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA enable efficient adaptation by learning low-rank updates of the model parameters. However, these compact representations are normally trained in isolation, limiting their reuse across related tasks. We introduce Task-Oriented Rank Adaptation (TORA), a geometric routing framework that leverages the low-rank structure of LoRA adapters to decide whether to transfer knowledge from the most compatible expert (Boosting) or isolate the new task (Shielding) based on structural similarity. Evaluated across 15 diverse text classification benchmarks, TORA consistently avoids harmful routing decisions: compatible tasks exceed their isolated performance while reducing training time, and structurally distant tasks are protected from interference with no loss in accuracy. With a single geometric threshold and no reliance on task identities or predefined sequences, TORA provides a simple and effective approach for dynamic adapter routing in sequential text classification systems.

</details>


### [271] [The Asymptotics of Language Model Alignment with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01828)
*Haricharan Balasundaram,V. Arvind Rameshwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文扩展了Yang等人的研究，将语言模型（LM）对齐中KL约束强化学习与best-of-n算法之间的渐近接近性结论，从独立同分布假设推广到马尔可夫依赖序列，并针对有限长度（特别是m=1）给出了KL散度为零的完整特征刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Yang等人工作基于i.i.d.假设，但这不符合实际LM具有记忆特性的现实。需要解决更通用的马尔可夫序列情况以及有限长度下的理论缺口。

Method: 1. 将渐近接近性结果从i.i.d. token序列扩展到Markovian token序列；2. 针对有限长度输出序列（特别是m=1），分析KL约束RL与best-of-n算法产生的分布间的KL散度。

Result: 1. 证明了在马尔可夫假设下两种对齐方法的渐近接近性；2. 对于有限长度（尤其是m=1），完全表征了使两种方法产生分布间KL散度为零的语言模型分布和奖励函数条件。

Conclusion: 该研究弥补了现有理论在非i.i.d.及有限长度场景下的不足，为理解不同LM对齐技术的等价性提供了更严谨的理论基础。

Abstract: Language model (LM) alignment broadly aims to perturb a given LM $Q$ into an aligned LM $q$ such that i) the outputs produced by $q$ and $Q$ are 'close' in probability, ii) $q$ has a higher expected reward than $Q$. Two common techniques for LM alignment are: KL-constrained RL, which requires knowledge of the LM distribution and is computationally expensive, and the best-of-$n$ algorithm, which requires only sampling from the LM. The work of Yang et al. established asymptotic closeness between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods for an $m$--length i.i.d. token sequence output by the LM, in the limit as $m$ increases to infinity. However, the i.i.d. assumption is not representative of practical LMs, whose output sequences often have memory. In this paper, we extend the asymptotic closeness result to the case when the $m$--length token sequence outputted by the LM is Markovian. Further, for finite-length output sequences -- particularly, when $m=1$ -- we provide a complete characterization of LM distributions and reward functions for which the KL-divergence between the distributions produced by the two alignment methods is zero -- a question first posed in Yang et al.

</details>


### [272] [Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01921)
*Lucas Bandarkar,Clark Peng,Ahmed Haj Ahmed,Aditi Khandelwal,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种针对MoE架构LLM的跨语言对比学习方法，利用MoE路由器输出进行序列级对齐，从而提升多语言能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统跨语言对比学习依赖显式表征对齐，但仅解码器LLM因分词差异难以直接应用；现有研究表明提高跨语言表征对齐可增强跨语言迁移能力，需解决架构限制下的对齐难题。

Method: 不采用辅助损失函数对齐隐藏状态，而是将混合专家（MoE）路由器的输出作为对齐目标，通过序列级池化实现更可靠的跨语言比较，并在持续预训练中引入该路由损失。

Result: 在四个开源MoE模型上的受控实验表明，该方法不仅使底层隐藏表征跨语言对齐，还在多样化评估套件中显著提升了多语言性能。

Conclusion: 基于MoE路由器的跨语言对齐策略有效克服了LLM架构限制，证明了其在提升多语言模型性能方面的潜力。

Abstract: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

</details>


### [273] [A rubric landscape for evaluating clinical reasoning in large language models: what exists, what is missing, and what needs to be combined](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01938)
*Zhangshu Joshua Jiang,Zina Ibrahim,James T. Teo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出仅凭考试准确率无法证明大语言模型（LLM）具备临床推理能力。通过梳理医学教育评估、临床LLM基准及通用领域生成评估三方面的文献，分析了六个核心维度：问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性及推理忠实度。研究发现现有工具均无法覆盖全部维度，其中“推理忠实度”最为薄弱。建议结合多种评估工具并采用特定评分机制，同时指出针对长文本纵向记录的不确定性、反事实及忠实度评估仍需进一步设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）在标准化考试中的高准确率并不能直接证明其具备真正的临床推理能力。为了准确评估LLM在处理临床记录时的推理质量，需要明确临床推理的定义，并系统性地审查当前用于评估这一复杂能力的工具和基准。

Method: 本研究采用结构化叙事综述方法，映射并分析了三个领域的文献：1) 医学教育评估工具；2) 2023年及以后发布的临床LLM基准；3) 评估长文本生成的通用领域方法。研究重点考察了六个具体维度：问题表征、时间综合、鉴别与管理推理、反事实推理、校准不确定性和推理忠实度。

Result: 1. 没有单一工具能覆盖所有六个评估维度。
2. “问题表征”和“鉴别/管理推理”虽有覆盖但可靠性因工具和场景而异。
3. "TIMER-Eval"针对时间综合，“ER-Reason”评估序列诊断信念更新。
4. 专门针对不确定性和反事实的评估正在兴起，但在纵向自由文本推理中的适用性有限。
5. 事实完整性在通用领域理论成熟，但在临床中已发现重要遗漏。
6. “推理忠实度”是最薄弱的维度，目前仅有一项针对多项选择题的临床因果消融研究。

Conclusion: 现有的评估工具应通过二元规则项、独立的完整性和正确性分数、基于案例的重要性加权（带有不可补偿的安全上限）、时间顺序一致性检查以及机会校正可靠性报告相结合的方式进行整合。针对校准不确定性、反事实推理以及在纵向自由文本记录上的推理忠实度，仍需进一步的设计工作。本综述提供了设计依据，而非经过验证的单一评估工具。

Abstract: Exam-style accuracy does not establish whether large language models (LLMs) reason well over clinical records. We define clinical reasoning as integrating and updating evidence across time and sources to form, revise and justify a patient's problem representation and a defensible plan.
  This structured narrative review maps three literatures: medical education assessment instruments, clinical LLM benchmarks published from 2023 onwards, and general-domain methods for evaluating long-form generation. We examine six dimensions: problem representation, temporal synthesis, differential and management reasoning, counterfactual reasoning, calibrated uncertainty, and reasoning faithfulness. Preprints are included and flagged.
  No single instrument covers all six dimensions. Problem representation and differential or management reasoning are reasonably covered, although reliability varies by instrument and setting. TIMER-Eval targets temporal synthesis, and ER-Reason assesses sequential diagnostic belief updating. Dedicated uncertainty and counterfactual evaluations are emerging, but their applicability to longitudinal free-text reasoning remains limited. Factual completeness is well theorised in general-domain evaluation, with early clinical evidence of important omissions. Faithfulness remains the weakest dimension, with one identified clinical causal-ablation study on multiple-choice questions.
  Existing tools should be combined through binary rubric items, separate completeness and correctness scores, case-specific importance weighting with non-compensable safety caps, temporal order-consistency checks, and chance-corrected reliability reporting. Further design work is needed for calibrated uncertainty, counterfactual reasoning and faithfulness over longitudinal free-text records. This review provides a design rationale, not a validated instrument.

</details>


### [274] [Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01984)
*Hyunsik Kim,Youngmoon Jung*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出通用字节级编码（UBE），一种双字母表分词器，通过优化3-4字节UTF-8字符的编码路径，降低多语言大模型中的最高预合并成本（encoding floor），从而减少高溢价脚本的Token数量并提升上下文利用率，同时保持解码精确性和模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于UTF-8的字节级字节对编码（BBPE）在处理非英语脚本时存在“编码地板”（encoding floor）过高的问题：当无法应用学习到的合并规则时，多字节字符需要多个字节符号表示，导致Token计数增加、请求成本上升及可用上下文缩减。而单纯改变全局编码会使原本高效的英语片段变得昂贵。

Method: 提出通用字节级编码（UBE），这是一种双字母表分词器。它保留1-2字节UTF-8字符在UTF-8路径上，而将3-4字节UTF-8字符路由到UTF-16路径。这种方法仅改变呈现给BPE的字节表示，合并规则保持不变，并确保精确解码。UBE还与替代边界策略和基于形态学的表示兼容。

Result: 1. 在Unicode 17审计中，UBE能精确往返所有Unicode标量值及官方规范化、字形断裂和表情符号测试套件中的所有输入。2. 内部评估显示，UBE降低了英语归一化Token计数比例的离散度，减少了跨语言Token预算差异。3. 在多语言语言模型实验中，UBE匹配了BBPE的语言模型质量。4. 主要多语言设置下，UBE显著降低了高溢价脚本的Token计数，略微降低英语Token计数，从而在固定Token预算下提供更多可用上下文，并在内容匹配的基准测试中实现更快的提示处理速度。

Conclusion: UBE通过智能路由不同长度的UTF-8字符，有效解决了多语言LLM中因编码效率差异导致的Token成本高和上下文受限问题，在不牺牲模型质量和解码精度的前提下，优化了多语言处理的效率和公平性。

Abstract: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

</details>


### [275] [Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02002)
*Ahmad Yehia,Aly O. Abdelkareem,Islam Ahmed,Hesham Omran,Khaled Alashmouny,Christian Claudel,Abduallah Mohamed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Mem++是一种非破坏性LLM记忆框架，通过将“写入时蒸馏”改为“读取时选择”，完整保留文档版本以解决组织工作中决策变更的追踪问题，在OrgMemBench基准测试中显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理参与组织工作时，需处理跨数月记录的决策文件。由于修订版作为新文档而非编辑出现，回答问题需知晓特定时间点的版本状态。然而，现有记忆系统在写入时压缩记录（如提炼为事实或图边），导致在提问前就固定了可回答内容，无法灵活应对时序查询。

Method: 提出Mem++框架，核心转变是从写入时的蒸馏转向读取时的选择：1. 存储机制：完整存储每份文档及其日期和作者，写入时不调用生成模型；2. 检索机制：在读取时，仅检索截至问题所指时间的文档，并融合词法与语义排名；3. 保留旧版本：不覆盖旧版本，将选择权留给回答模型。

Result: 在OrgMemBench基准测试中，Mem++比最强的记忆系统基线高出8.0至13.1分（跨越两种回答模型）。使用gpt-4.1-mini时，获得最高总分，比RAG高出2.6分。此外，在LoCoMo上获得最佳平均LLM-judge评分，在LongMemEval-S上排名第二（仅次于其实体图变体）。

Conclusion: Mem++通过保留完整文档历史并在读取时进行动态筛选，有效解决了组织工作中文档版本追踪难题，显著提升了LLM在时序敏感任务中的表现，证明了非破坏性记忆策略的有效性。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents now take part in organizational work, where many authors record decisions across documents over months. Because a revised decision arrives as a new document rather than an edit, answering a question requires knowing which version held at a given time. However, most memory systems compress the record at write time. By distilling each document into facts, notes or graph edges, these methods fix what can be answered before any question is asked. To address this, we propose Mem++, a non-destructive memory framework shifting from write-time distillation to read-time selection. Mem++ stores every document whole with its date and author, and it calls no generative model at write time. At read time, it retrieves only documents dated up to the time a question asks about and fuses lexical and semantic rankings. Unlike systems that overwrite older versions, Mem++ keeps them and leaves the choice to the answering model. Evaluations on the organizational benchmark OrgMemBench demonstrate that Mem++ surpasses the strongest memory system baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models. With gpt-4.1-mini, it also achieves the best overall score, 2.6 points above RAG. In addition, Mem++ achieves the best average LLM-judge score on LoCoMo and ranks second on LongMemEval-S, behind only its entity-graph variant. Code for benchmark evaluation is available at https://github.com/AIDAChip-Inc/mem-plus-plus.

</details>


### [276] [Controllable Multi-label Video Safety Detection via Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02019)
*Guangyu Yang,Jingbiao Mei,Mingsheng Sun,Jinghong Chen,Yingtong Bu,Pengda Qin,Da Chen,Bill Byrne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出ATPO框架，通过强化学习和自适应Tversky奖励解决视频安全检测中的多标签分类和精度-召回率可控性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有有害视频检测系统存在两大局限：1) 将检测简化为二分类，忽视不安全视频的多标签特性；2) 依赖静态训练目标，无法支持不同审核场景所需的精度-召回率权衡。

Method: 提出自适应Tversky策略优化（ATPO），一种用于多标签视频安全检测（Multi-VSD）的强化学习框架。引入自适应Tversky奖励（ATR），在训练过程中动态调整假阳性和假阴性惩罚，以实现精度-召回率的灵活控制。

Result: 在SafeWatch-Bench和XD-Violence数据集上实验表明，ATPO显著提升了多标签性能，在SafeWatch-Bench-Real上将Jaccard指数从40.66提升至75.44。ATR实现了可靠的精度-召回率操作点引导，适应异质化政策需求。

Conclusion: ATPO框架有效解决了传统方法在多标签理解和精度-召回率灵活性方面的不足，为视频内容审核提供了更可靠、可定制的解决方案。

Abstract: The rapid growth of video-based social media has increased users' exposure to harmful content, creating a need for reliable automated video safety detection. Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show strong video understanding capabilities, existing harmful video detection systems face two key limitations: they typically reduce safety detection to binary classification, overlooking the inherently multi-label nature of unsafe videos, and they rely on static training objectives that do not support controllable precision-recall trade-offs, though the desired operating point may vary across moderation pipelines and unsafe categories. To address these gaps, we propose Adaptive Tversky Policy Optimization (ATPO), a reinforcement learning framework for Multi-label Video Safety Detection (Multi-VSD). ATPO introduces the Adaptive Tversky Reward (ATR), which dynamically adjusts false-positive and false-negative penalties during training to enable controllable precision-recall trade-offs. Experiments on SafeWatch-Bench and XD-Violence show that ATPO substantially improves multi-label performance, increasing the Jaccard Index from 40.66 to 75.44 on SafeWatch-Bench-Real. Moreover, ATR enables reliable steering of the precision-recall operating point, supporting deployment scenarios with heterogeneous policy requirements. Code and checkpoints are provided at https://bruceyg.github.io/ATPO-project-page/ .

</details>


### [277] [Old Ideas, Novel Problems: The Instability of LLM-Based Novelty Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02022)
*Noy Sternlicht,Simra Shahid,Peter Jansen,Daniel S. Weld,Pao Siangliulue,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 大型语言模型作为新颖性评估者表现不佳，微小的提示设计变化即可导致准确率剧烈波动甚至低于随机水平，现有自动化新颖性评估方法缺乏鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决当前自动构思系统的新颖性评估中，评判者（通常为大语言模型）构建随意且缺乏针对生成想法的有效验证问题，探究这些“新颖性评判者”的真实性能。

Method: 通过挖掘OpenReview上审稿人明确肯定或质疑原创性的段落，构建包含极端共识的人类论文及普通LLM生成想法的自动评估集；对比六种不同设置下的新颖性评估器性能。

Result: 微小的提示设计对结果影响巨大（如简单上下文描述可使相同成对想法的判断准确率波动超过50点）；检索增强和更大的推理预算效果有限；专门构建的新颖性评估器甚至不如最基础的提示基线。

Conclusion: 现有基于LLM的新颖性评估方法存在严重缺陷，引发对已报告自动化构思系统新颖性增益有效性的质疑，呼吁开发更鲁棒的新颖性评估方法。

Abstract: Automated ideation systems are often evaluated on the novelty of the ideas they produce, and that judgment is increasingly delegated to large language models. Such judges are typically built ad hoc and validated, if at all, on human-authored papers rather than on the generated ideas they are meant to score. So, how do novelty judges perform?
  Not well. We present a systematic controlled study of novelty evaluation design choices. We first build an evaluation set automatically, mining OpenReview for passages where reviewers explicitly affirm or dispute a paper's originality and keeping only submissions with unanimous agreement at the extremes of their research area; we pair these with ideas from a vanilla LLM generator. Across six judges, we find that small prompt design choices have large consequences; e.g., simply telling the judge that reviewers found one idea novel and the other not can change its verdict on more than half of the identical idea pairs it is shown, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points and occasionally pushing it below chance. The same change helps one judge and hurts another. Retrieval and larger reasoning budgets help little, and two purpose-built novelty evaluators are outperformed by our cheapest prompted baseline. These results raise questions about reported novelty gains of automated ideation systems, and call for robust novelty evaluation methods.

</details>


### [278] [Typological Alignment of Stack-Based Language Models on Mildly Context-Sensitive Artificial Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02040)
*Nadine El-Naggar,Tatsuki Kuribayashi,Ted Briscoe*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究栈式语言模型（SLMs）在处理跨序列依赖时的泛化能力，发现具备有限工作记忆的SLMs表现更好，这为某些语序类型的普遍性及学习偏差提供了理论依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索语言类型学共性（如SOV语序）是否源于学习偏差，并扩展对语言模型（LMs）学习偏差与语言类型共性之间关系的研究，特别是针对句法复杂度的上限和层级模式的学习机制。

Method: 使用栈式语言模型（SLMs）在多种人工语言上评估其对跨序列依赖的泛化能力，并对比不同工作记忆限制下的模型表现。

Result: SLMs在处理跨序列依赖时存在困难，但具有有限工作记忆的SLMs表现出更好的泛化能力，显示出潜在的归纳偏差。

Conclusion: SLMs的工作记忆限制可能构成了某种归纳偏差的基础，从而解释了自然语言中特定语序配置的类型学共性。

Abstract: Some properties of languages, e.g., subject-object-verb (SOV) word order, are more prevalent than others among the thousands of attested natural languages (NLs). Such typological commonality is often attributed to learning biases. Computational simulations, recently with language models (LMs), have facilitated the exploration of this theory. In this paper, we extend existing analyses of the relationship between LMs' learning biases and typological commonality on both data and model sides, focusing on: (i) cross-serial dependencies, the upper limit of attested syntactic complexity, and (ii) stack-based LMs (SLMs), potentially facilitating learning of hierarchical patterns. We first evaluate generalization of SLMs on cross-serial dependencies across diverse artificial languages and confirm that they struggle with such constructions. However, SLMs with limited working memory generalize better suggesting a possible basis for such inductive bias and thus the typological commonality of some word order configurations.

</details>


### [279] [LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02076)
*Yinheng Li,Justin Wagle*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究通用大语言模型（LLM）作为杰维斯风格（Jev-style）决策模型的潜力，提出LLM2Jev框架。发现现代LLM无需训练即可胜任决策任务，微调仅对弱模型或特定场景有益，且KL锚定可防止对话能力退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 杰维斯风格决策模型能输出分类概率分布并直接驱动软件系统，但需专用架构。现有工作未充分探究通用LLM是否具备此“开箱即用”的能力，以及微调的必要性边界。

Method: 提出LLM2Jev框架，通过括号内的数字标识符提取校准后的决策概率。包含免训练推理方案和微调目标：使用树因子化列表损失优化候选选择，并利用KL散度惩罚将辅助预测锚定至基础模型，以保留原有生成能力。在Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3-0.6B上进行评估。

Result: 1. 现代LLM天生是有效的决策模型：4B模型免训练即匹配社区专用模型，优于字母logit读取方式，支持任意选项数量及多模态决策。
2. 微调收益具有针对性：显著改善弱模型和特定任务（如多选项意图路由），但对强骨干模型存在边际递减效应。
3. LoRA结合KL锚定在强模型上表现最佳，有效防止了对话文本生成的行为退化。

Conclusion: 通用LLM已具备强大的内在决策能力，微调并非普遍必要，应针对特定短板或任务进行优化，同时需注意保护其原有的对话生成性能。

Abstract: Jev-style decision models return categorical probability distributions over predefined options without generating free-form text, enabling software systems to act on their outputs directly. In this work, we investigate the extent to which general-purpose LLMs already possess this capability out of the box, and when fine-tuning is actually necessary. We present LLM2Jev, an architecture-preserving framework that extracts calibrated decisions directly from next-token probabilities over bracketed numeric identifiers. LLM2Jev provides both a training-free inference recipe and a fine-tuning objective that optimizes candidate selection via a tree-factorized listwise loss while anchoring auxiliary predictions to the base model using KL divergence penalties. Evaluating on Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3-0.6B, we find that modern LLMs are inherently effective decision models: without training, the 4B model matches community Jev-style models built on the same backbone, outperforms letter-logit readouts, supports arbitrary option counts, and natively handles multimodal decisions over images. Fine-tuning provides targeted rather than universal benefits -- substantially improving weaker models and specific tasks (such as many-option intent routing), but offering diminishing returns for strong backbones. Crucially, our KL anchors prevent behavioral degradation in conversational text generation, with LoRA delivering the strongest performance on capable models.

</details>


### [280] [Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02092)
*Zilin Du,Bowen Yang,Boyang Albert Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出TESS框架，通过点值匹配目标解决元学习数据选择中的优化不稳定和泛化问题，实现跨数据集、模型规模的可迁移数据选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有元学习数据选择方法在细粒度评估与未见过数据的可迁移性之间存在权衡；直接引入选择网络会导致权重抑制和对易学特征的持续依赖，造成优化不稳定和泛化性能差。

Method: 提出可迁移示例评分与选择（TESS）框架，基于点值匹配目标（PVM），取代传统的逐样本权重机制以构建可扩展的数据选择体系。

Result: 在LLM安全性和定向指令微调任务上，TESS展现出强大的跨数据集、从子集到完整语料库、从小模型到大模型的迁移能力。

Conclusion: TESS有效解决了传统元学习数据选择的局限，提供了一种稳定且具备强泛化能力的可扩展数据选择方案。

Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). Experiments on LLM safety and targeted instruction tuning demonstrate strong transfer across datasets, from subsets to full corpora, and from smaller to larger models.

</details>


### [281] [Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02142)
*Juan S. Santillana*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了基于关键词匹配的工具使用基准测试存在虚假阳性问题，通过严格的诊断方法区分了模型是否真正具备工具调用能力，并提出了一种低成本的高效微调方案来修复缺乏先验知识的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的关键词匹配基准测试可能错误地赋予小型模型其并未实际执行的工具使用能力的信用（即产生虚假阳性）。为了准确评估小模型在工具使用方面的真实表现，需要一种更严格、低成本的诊断机制。

Method: 1. **对比实验**：构建了一对架构匹配的西班牙语安全语言模型（661.6M参数无专门SFT vs 1,109M参数含大量Web训练和6B-token工具SFT），共享解码器、词元器和特殊词元。
2. **严格诊断**：采用逐字复现检查（Verbatim-reproduction checks）和首词元探测（First-token probe）替代宽松的指标。
3. **针对性微调（Targeted SFT）**：使用多样化语料库、5倍高学习率和少量步骤（2,202步）对失败模型进行修复。
4. **验证分析**：包括嵌入漂移检查（Embedding-drift checks）以确认修复未改变触发词元的嵌入，以及因子分析。

Result: 1. **诊断结果**：宽松指标下两模型得分相似（B4: 0.660 vs 0.650），但严格检查显示600M模型在所有示例中均能生成有效工具调用，而1B模型为0/6。首词元概率极低（$10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$）证实1B模型缺失关键先验知识。
2. **修复效果**：针对性SFT成功修复1B模型，有效发射率从0.100提升至0.959（接近600M模型的0.926）。在未见过提示上，修复后的1B模型表现优于600M模型（0.536 vs 0.428, $p = 0.004$）。
3. **技术细节**：修复过程仅消耗约3.3 GPU小时，比失败的训练阶段少三个数量级。嵌入漂移检查显示触发词元嵌入几乎未变（97.7%位相同），证明能力变化发生在网络周围结构而非嵌入层。
4. **局限性**：两个模型均存在过度触发问题，极少在无工具调用需求的负面提示中直接回答。

Conclusion: 传统的宽松工具使用指标不可靠，建议采用这种仅需几分钟CPU时间的廉价诊断阶梯（Diagnostic Ladder）作为门槛，以严格验证小型模型的工具使用声明，避免虚假阳性。同时证明了针对特定缺失先验知识进行轻量级、多样化语料的SFT是高效修复手段。

Abstract: Keyword-matching benchmarks can credit small models for tool use they never perform. We document such a false positive in a matched-architecture pair of Spanish security language models and propose a ladder of strict, cheap diagnostics. A 661.6M parameter model (approx. 65% code/technical text; no dedicated SFT) and a 1,109M model (web-heavy multi-phase curriculum; 6B-token tool-SFT) share decoder, tokenizer, and special tokens, scoring almost identically on lenient tool-use metrics (B4: 0.660 vs. 0.650).
  Verbatim-reproduction checks on training examples separate them completely: the 600M emits valid tool calls with generalized arguments on 6/6 examples; the 1B does so on 0/6 across checkpoints. A first-token probe localizes the 1B's failure to a missing prior (prob. $10^{-4}$--$10^{-5}$ on <|tool_call|>), which was erased by its web-heavy training phase. A targeted SFT recipe (diverse corpus, 5x higher learning rate, 2,202 steps, ~3.3 GPU-hours) repairs the 1B using three orders of magnitude fewer tokens than the failed phase. On all 269 corpus rows, valid emission rises from 0.100 to 0.959 (600M: 0.926). On 238 unseen prompts, the repaired 1B passes 0.536 vs. the 600M's 0.428 ($p = 0.004$). Embedding-drift checks show the repair did not move the trigger token's tied embedding (97.7% of the bf16 table remains bit-identical), meaning changes live in the surrounding network.
  Both models over-trigger, rarely answering negative prompts without a call (0.09 for 600M, 0.17 for repaired 1B). Factorial analyses confirm all repair configurations install the format, though suppression benefits from a diverse corpus remain a hypothesis due to seed sensitivity. This cheap diagnostic ladder costs minutes of CPU time and should gate tool-use claims on small models.

</details>


### [282] [From Knowledge Access to Source Learning: Developing Source-Specific Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02150)
*Lucheng Fu,Kejing Xia,Yiyang Wang,Yiqiao Jin,Jinjin He,Xiyuan Yang,Haoxin Liu,Ye Yu,Haibo Jin,Yijia Xiao,Wenke Lee,B. Aditya Prakash,Haohan Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SourceLearn框架，通过构建和持续优化“源特定模型”来解决大语言模型智能体对权威外部知识源的重复访问问题，显著提升复杂任务下的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将重复使用同一来源视为单纯的重复访问，未能利用这一过程逐步深化对该来源知识的理解；缺乏针对持久权威来源的可复用、结构化专业知识积累机制。

Method: 提出SourceLearn框架，包含两个互补机制：1）自我导向源学习（Self-Directed Source Learning）：识别未完全理解的部分并自适应回访来源；2）任务引导源学习（Task-Guided Source Learning）：利用下游任务经验揭示局部表示差距和知识组织需求。两者均基于学习信号确定重新考虑的内容，并从权威来源重构持久更新。

Result: 在5个基准测试和3种LLM后端上，SourceLearn在15种设置中的13种取得最佳性能，相比Hybrid RAG提升高达22.6分，显著优于静态源表示和经验记忆基线。

Conclusion: 通过将重复访问转化为渐进式理解机会，SourceLearn有效构建了可复用的源特定能力，为智能体处理知识密集型序列任务提供了更高效的持久化知识管理方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent external sources to solve sequences of knowledge-intensive tasks. Existing methods improve how source content is accessed and organized, while agent-memory systems preserve reusable knowledge from prior interactions, but repeated use of the same source is still largely treated as repeated access rather than an opportunity to progressively improve understanding of that source. We study source learning: developing reusable source-specific competence over a persistent authoritative source. We represent this competence with a persistent source model that captures reusable understanding of the source, including how its knowledge is structured, interpreted, and applied. To construct and progressively refine such models, we propose SourceLearn, which combines two complementary learning mechanisms. Self-Directed Source Learning identifies what remains incompletely understood and adaptively revisits the source, while Task-Guided Source Learning uses downstream experience to reveal local representational gaps and recurring needs in how source knowledge should be organized. In both cases, learning signals determine what should be reconsidered, while persistent updates are reconstructed from the authoritative source. Across five benchmarks and three LLM backends, SourceLearn achieves the best performance in 13 of 15 settings, with gains of up to 22.6 points over Hybrid RAG and substantial overall improvements over static source representations and experience-based memory baselines.

</details>


### [283] [AutoCompact: Learning When to Compact Context in Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02163)
*Xuan Zhang,Longtao Zheng,Cunxiao Du,Bo An,Xin Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出AutoCompact，通过强化学习训练编码代理在长轨迹中自动决策何时压缩上下文、保留何种状态及如何继续执行，从而提升代码生成任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决编码代理在处理仓库级软件工程任务时，因长期探索导致早期信息过时的问题；核心挑战在于不仅需避免上下文溢出，还需智能决策上下文压缩时机、保留的工作状态及后续延续方式。

Method: 1. 数据收集：运行基础代理执行编码任务，利用评判器审查其压缩决策、摘要及后续行动；将错误输出替换为修正后版本以生成连续轨迹。2. 监督微调（SFT）：基于修正轨迹进行SFT。3. 强化学习优化：结合任务成功奖励，联合优化编码能力与上下文压缩策略。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-PolyBench Verified基准测试上，AutoCompact相比基线模型分别提升了9.2%和5.0%的绝对通过率；该优势在不同推理预算下均稳定存在，且适用于256K（无溢出）和16K（触发回退压缩）两种上下文窗口设置。

Conclusion: AutoCompact有效解决了长轨迹中的上下文管理难题，通过联合优化编码与压缩决策，显著提升了代码代理在复杂软件工程任务中的性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Coding agents solve repository-level software engineering tasks through long trajectories of code inspection, search, editing, and testing. As a task progresses, earlier exploration becomes stale, so managing context is more than avoiding overflow: an agent must decide when to compact, what working state to preserve, and how to continue from it. We introduce AutoCompact, which trains a coding agent to make these decisions as part of its policy. To collect training data, we run the base agent on coding tasks and use a judge to review its compaction decisions, summaries, and actions after compaction. Flawed outputs are replaced with corrected ones before being executed in the environment, so each trajectory continues from the corrected decisions. We use these trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then jointly optimize coding and compaction through reinforcement learning with task-success rewards. Experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-PolyBench Verified show that AutoCompact improves pass rates over the base model by an absolute 9.2\% and 5.0\%, respectively. The improvements hold across all evaluated inference budgets, with a 256K context window that never overflows and with a 16K window whose overflow triggers fallback compaction.

</details>


### [284] [Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02193)
*Hui Ren,Zihan Li,Chang Liu,Huidong Liu,Alexander Schwing*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出分层连续扩散语言模型（HC-DLM），通过耦合离散令牌生成与连续潜在轨迹，解决并行解码时的统计依赖断裂问题，并在多项任务中超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在并行解码时因独立采样导致令牌间统计依赖断裂；连续扩散模型虽避免此问题，但其去噪器仅关注连续状态，缺乏与有效令牌配置的显式绑定机制。

Method: 提出HC-DLM，将离散令牌生成与连续潜在轨迹整合于单一原则性去噪过程中。训练目标基于令牌似然变分界推导，潜在状态作为唯一持久生成状态，每一步从其中读出令牌并反馈为下一次潜在更新的支架。

Result: 在结构化推理（数独）、数学规划（Countdown）和语言建模（LM1B）任务上，HC-DLM在相同模型规模下，优于离散和连续扩散基线，具体表现为数独和Countdown谜题准确率提升，以及LM1B生成困惑度降低。

Conclusion: HC-DLM通过统一离散与连续生成过程，有效解决了扩散语言模型的结构性瓶颈，提升了复杂推理和语言建模任务的性能。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion language models offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive generation for tasks demanding bidirectional reasoning and global constraint satisfaction. Yet they share a structural bottleneck: when decoding in parallel, each token is sampled independently from its marginal, severing the statistical dependencies among the tokens decoded together. Continuous diffusion language models avoid this by denoising a shared continuous state, but their denoiser sees only that state, so nothing ties it to a valid token configuration until it is finally decoded. To address this, we propose Hierarchical Continuous Diffusion Language Models (HC-DLM), which couple discrete token generation with a continuous latent trajectory in a single, principled denoising process, whose training objective is derived from a variational bound on the token likelihood. In contrast to recent methods that attach continuous context to a self-contained discrete chain, HC-DLM makes the latent the only persistent generative state: tokens are read out from it at every step and feed back as a scaffold for the next latent update. On structured reasoning (Sudoku), mathematical planning (Countdown) and language modeling (LM1B), HC-DLM improves over discrete and continuous diffusion baselines at matched model size, in puzzle accuracy on Sudoku and Countdown and in generative perplexity on LM1B. Project page: https://hc-dlm.github.io/.

</details>


### [285] [KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02206)
*Pengfei Li,Naufal Suryanto,Sicheng Zhang,Muzammal Naseer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出KaliBench基准，用于评估LLM将自然语言转换为Kali Linux CLI命令的能力，填补了现有评测在可执行命令生成方面的空白。通过多阶段验证管道确保语义正确性和可执行性，发现开源模型在此任务上表现不佳，但利用该基准进行监督微调和强化学习可显著提升性能，达到接近超大模型的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在网络安全工作流中的应用缺乏对生成真实世界安全工具可执行CLI命令能力的直接测量。由于CLI操作对语法、参数绑定和顺序极其敏感，微小错误即可导致执行失败，因此亟需一个细粒度的基准来评估这一关键能力。

Method: 构建KaliBench数据集，包含8,504个查询-命令对，覆盖1,642个工具和23个能力维度。采用基于手稿的确定性规范化和别名感知评估流程。开发多阶段验证管道，结合LLM验证、沙箱终端执行和人机协同优化，以确保语义正确性和实际可执行性，并生成可用于训练的免运行时验证奖励信号。

Result: 在多种配置下测试了通用和安全导向的开源模型，无任何开源模型在无提示设置下的精确命令准确率超过42%，表明准确使用基于CLI的安全工具极具挑战。然而，利用KaliBench生成的验证奖励进行监督微调和强化学习，显著提升了8B参数模型的性能，使其表现可与685B参数的混合专家（MoE）模型相媲美。

Conclusion: KaliBench提供了一个精确且可复现的框架来评估和提升LLM在网络安全CLI交互中的能力。研究证明，基于细粒度、确定性的可验证奖励进行训练，能够有效缩小小型开源模型与大型专有模型在复杂安全工具使用任务上的差距。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. KaliBench is constructed via a manuscript-grounded pipeline with deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware evaluation, enabling precise and reproducible assessment of tool selection and argument construction. To ensure both semantic correctness and practical executability, we develop a multi-stage verification pipeline that combines LLM-based validation, sandboxed terminal execution, and human-in-the-loop refinement. Building on these fine-grained, deterministic signals, KaliBench further enables runtime-free verifiable rewards for training. Across three evaluation modes and 24 configurations of general-purpose and security-focused open-weight models, no open-weight model exceeds 42% exact-command accuracy in the unrestricted setting, highlighting the difficulty of accurate CLI-based cybersecurity tool use without explicit tool hints. We further show that supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards derived from KaliBench significantly improve an 8B model and achieve performance comparable to a 685B MoE model.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [286] [Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00052)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 评估显示，大型语言模型在生成彩票号码时表现出高度的集中性和低多样性，其有效多样性远低于独立均匀随机抽样理论值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估不同语言模型配置在生成随机整数请求（模拟彩票）时的表现，特别是其输出结果的多样性和分布特性。

Method: 使用四种英语提示变体对六种语言模型配置进行了1,200次尝试调用，并对比了两个存档的波兰彩票物理样本数据。

Result: 1,184个响应为有效彩票号码；有效多样性指数仅为9.9至18.0，远低于独立均匀采样下的第5百分位阈值（46.6-46.7）；高频模态票占有效响应的22.5%-68.0%，而物理彩票样本的多样性为41.1-41.4。

Conclusion: 在测试部署设置下，语言模型生成的结果存在显著的集中度问题；研究未揭示具体机制，也未验证其他提示、温度或工具配置下的性能。

Abstract: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.

</details>


### [287] [On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00170)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文在严格的端侧约束下（模型<3MiB，推理<20ms，数据不出设备），构建了一个基于量化嵌入表的韩语商业意图分类系统。研究揭示了约束带来的精度损失主要源于容量不足，通过教师模型微调可显著提升性能，同时验证了锚点机制的有效性，并提供了详细的端侧性能基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探索在极端资源受限的端侧环境下进行商业意图推断的可行性与性能边界，具体约束包括：下载负载小于3 MiB、P95延迟低于20毫秒、且无任何原始文本或标识符离开用户设备。

Method: 1. 构建检索路径：使用从韩语句子变换器蒸馏出的静态嵌入表，量化至4位，无需推理运行时。
2. 实验对比：在22,900条真实韩语购物评论上测试，对比基线模型、大型教师模型及微调后的学生模型。
3. 性能分析：评估不同查询特征（如是否包含叶子节点名称子串）对精度的影响，并测量在iPhone和Android设备上的实际运行时间。

Result: 1. 整体表现：中类别Top-5准确率为75.0%（基线为18.4%）。
2. 精度差异：包含叶子节点子串的查询准确率高达83.5%，不包含的仅为45.2%。
3. 模型改进：通用大教师模型能缩小差距；经对比对微调后，带锚点模型准确率提升至0.8586，比纯编码器学生模型高出10.6个百分点（无锚点时高出20.9个百分点）。
4. 性能指标：负载为2,942,652字节；在A14/A16 iPhone上P95延迟分别为4.431ms/3.670ms，在低端Android平板上为5.080ms，均远低于20ms上限。

Conclusion: 在严格端侧约束下实现商业意图推断是可行的，但精度成本并非均匀分布，主要受限于模型容量。引入锚点和针对学生数据的教师微调能有效弥补容量缺陷。此外，可通过识别低置信度样本优化决策流程，且该方案在主流移动设备上具有极高的实时性优势。

Abstract: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.
  Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.
  A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).
  Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

</details>


### [288] [System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00253)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究测试AI审计中基于品牌推荐生成的系统配置文件是否能准确描述部署的语言模型。通过字符n-gram分类器发现，答案的表面形式（而非聚合的品牌行为）能高精度区分不同模型，但跨域泛化能力差，且存在截断和域偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估AI可见性审计方法的有效性，即通过总结部署语言模型的品牌推荐来生成每系统配置文件，并验证该配置是否真实反映系统特性。

Method: 收集2025年12月至2026年2月间来自五个部署端点的6,475条存储响应（6,324条可分析），涵盖礼品推荐、企业声誉和品类所有权查询。使用字符n-gram分类器，结合提示属性对前800个字符进行交叉验证，对比GPT-5.2、Gemini 3 Flash等模型。同时分析长度、格式统计量、品牌掩码及跨域泛化性能。

Result: 1. 仅用前800字符的字符n-gram分类器实现97.84%准确率；2. 仅长度特征表现接近多数类基线（24%），而加入30种格式统计量后达95.79%；3. 隐藏品牌和首字母大写标记后仍保持97.72%准确率；4. 跨域测试显示：单响应转移平衡准确率达89.92%，但聚合配置文件在跨域时失效（如礼品域被错误归类）；5. Grok在检索增强场景下零识别率；6. 聚合模型区分四系统准确率为66.53%，显著高于随机基线（33.71%）。

Conclusion: 答案的表面形式（如字符序列和格式特征）比聚合的品牌行为更能有效标识底层模型，但当前设计无法解耦系统、查询域和数据采集工具的影响，表明现有审计方法在跨域泛化和因果分离方面存在局限。

Abstract: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

</details>


### [289] [A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00369)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Laurito et al. (2025)发现大语言模型普遍偏好由语言模型生成的文本而非人类文本，但重新分析表明，这种偏好是跨模型的通用现象，而非特定模型对自己生成文本的“自恋”或识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证Laurito等人关于LLM偏好LLM生成文本的研究结论，并深入探究是否存在“选择器更倾向于选择来自同一模型（own-model）的文本”这一未被原研究强调的现象。

Method: 基于Laurito等人在公共仓库提供的原始数据，重建了5x5生成-选择矩阵；拟合包含“同模型效应”(gamma)的双向固定效应模型；使用精确置换检验评估统计显著性；同时控制位置偏差并进行功效分析以评估检测微小效应的能力。

Result: 1. 跨模型偏好显著：所有选择器在商品描述上高度一致地选择GPT-4等模型生成的文本（选择率77%-95%）。2. 无同模型特异性偏好：“同模型”效应在统计学上不显著（p值范围0.07-0.74），且GPT-3.5与GPT-4配对中的“同厂商”项为负值。3. 稳健性：去除位置偏差影响后，结果依然稳健。4. 对比：Tan et al. (2024)的数据显示出较大的同模型效应(gamma=+0.148)，但与本研究的严谨统计推断不同。

Conclusion: 虽然LLM确实表现出对机器生成文本的整体偏好，但现有数据并未证明模型能够识别并特别青睐其自身生成的文本风格。主要结果是LLM共享一种对“机器文风”的口味，而非自我认同。

Abstract: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.

</details>


### [290] [Comparison of Common Crawl News & GDELT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00587)
*Ameir El Ouadi,David Beskow*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对比分析了GDELT和Common Crawl News两大新闻数据集，揭示了它们在数据来源（广播/印刷 vs 网络爬虫）及覆盖范围上的显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球新闻语料库对于自然语言处理、知识图谱、大语言模型等技术研发至关重要，同时也对理解实时互动的实体具有重要意义。然而，现有研究中不同数据集的使用缺乏对其特性差异的系统性比较。

Method: 研究选取了当前广泛使用的两个新闻数据集——全球事件、语言和语气数据库（GDELT）和Common Crawl News，通过深入分析其内容构成和覆盖范围，系统比较了两者的优势与局限性。

Result: 研究发现两者在新闻源获取方式上存在显著差异：GDELT主要依赖全球范围内的广播、印刷和网络新闻；而Common Crawl则主要通过网络爬虫技术从全球新闻网站收集数据。这种差异导致了两者在数据覆盖地域和来源类型上的 considerable differences（显著不同）。

Conclusion: 尽管GDELT和Common Crawl News均为重要的新闻资源，但它们在数据获取机制和覆盖面上各有侧重。研究人员应根据具体任务需求（如侧重传统媒体还是纯网络媒体）选择合适的语料库，或结合两者以弥补单一数据集的局限性。

Abstract: The corpus of worldwide news is important for natural language processing, knowledge graphs, large language models, and other technical efforts. Additionally, this corpus is important for understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that interact in real-time every day. This paper compares two news datasets used for these tasks today, namely the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) and Common Crawl News. Our research highlights the strengths and limitations of each dataset, analyzing their content and coverage. Notably, while GDELT relies on broadcasts, prints, and web news from across the globe, Common Crawl focuses on news sites from around the world gathered through web crawling. Our analysis revealed considerable differences in where the two datasets gather their news sources.

</details>


### [291] [CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00923)
*Hyojeong Yun,Jueun Kim,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CANOPY框架，通过层级结构和节点评分实现自适应粒度的多模态检索后证据压缩，并在证据不足时触发针对性再检索，显著降低Token消耗并提升多跳问答准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决多模态RAG中检索粒度选择与上下文保留之间的权衡难题：粗粒度包含无关内容，细粒度可能丢失必要解释背景；现有方法缺乏跨异构项的统一区域级适应机制。

Method: 1. 将检索项表示为层级结构，使用针对金标准证据微调的节点编码器对区域进行查询相关打分；2. 通过父节点相对优化（Parent-relative refinement）在不同粒度下选择多个区域，无需LLM调用即可实现节点级剪枝；3. 引入批评者（critic）机制，在累积证据不足时请求针对性后续检索，新检索项经压缩后再加入。

Result: 在3300万条目的异构语料库上的五个QA基准测试中，CANOPY的平均答案准确率高于所有评估的检索基线；消融实验表明额外检索是提升多跳QA准确率的主要驱动力；在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct设置下，相比无压缩迭代管线，证据Token减少14.2%-27.7%，且保持可比的答案准确率。

Conclusion: CANOPY提供了一种无需大模型调用的、自适应粒度的证据压缩与再检索协同框架，有效平衡了上下文完整性与信息密度，提升了多模态RAG系统的效率与准确性。

Abstract: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. Ablations indicate that additional retrieval drives the main accuracy gains on multi-hop QA. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

</details>


### [292] [RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00964)
*Chuxuan Hu,Hejie Cui,Norman Huang,Shubham Kumar Bharti,Wang-Chiew Tan,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RPTune框架，通过结合自动生成的目录策展和LLM后训练，优化小型商户在长上下文中的产品搜索效果，显著提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）能容纳小商户的全目录，但模型无法均匀利用长上下文，导致检索效果不佳；现有针对大型市场的多阶段检索方法不适用于此类场景。

Method: 提出RPTune端到端框架：1. 使用编码器重组器根据下游LLM反馈对商品进行排序和剪枝以策展目录；2. 利用策展后的目录生成基于上下文的奖励信号，对LLM进行后训练微调。

Result: 在7个真实商户、涵盖不同零售垂直领域的数据集上评估，RPTune在专有和开源LLM上均提升搜索准确率；目录策展带来最高31.4个百分点的提升，后训练平均额外提升10.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过联合学习目录策展与LLM后训练，可有效解决LLM在处理长上下文时的利用不均问题，显著提升小商户场景下的在产品选择任务上的性能。

Abstract: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts.
