  We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant. RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

</details>


### [293] [Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01139)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究发现，仅靠多语言编码器或平衡的量化器拟合无法保证跨语言产品获得一致的语义ID（SIDs）。翻译导致的嵌入位移与重新表述相似，且平衡拟合反而降低了跨语言前缀一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究多语言编码器是否足以使同一产品的不同语言版本获得语言一致的语义ID（SIDs），特别是在生成式检索中使用的离散代码序列方面。

Method: 使用Amazon ESCI列表中英语、西班牙语和日语渲染的产品数据，测试翻译与其英语源文本的接近程度；评估残差量化对翻译引起位移的敏感性；比较多语言与语言平衡量化器拟合对SID一致性的影响。

Result: 1. 多语言E5模型使翻译在嵌入空间中明显偏离：在英语主导的拟合下，日语翻译保留其英语对应物首个SID代码的比例仅为7.7%，而英语改写版为89.0%。2. 距离匹配的产品定向控制显示，翻译引起的完整SID不匹配与重新表述相当，表明量化器并未选择性放大语言方向。3. 平衡拟合使代码本使用更均匀，但进一步降低跨语言前缀一致性：西班牙语首个代码一致性从28.3%降至6.6%，而仅英语拟合则保持67.6%的一致性。

Conclusion: 多语言暴露和平衡的代码本使用本身并不能保证语言一致的SIDs，翻译带来的嵌入变化对离散编码过程有显著负面影响。

Abstract: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

</details>


### [294] [Learning to structure data from user-generated thematic corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01463)
*Elishay Avram,Oren Glickman,Elad Yom-Tov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化迭代框架，用于从非结构化主题语料库（如社交媒体）中自动发现领域特定属性模式并提取结构化数据，无需预定义本体。该方法在健康类Reddit社区上验证，实现了接近人工标注水平的属性发现准确率（61% vs 62%），结构类型分配准确率达82%，值提取F1得分为0.8，证明了其经济高效且可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒休等主题语料库包含大量未结构化文本，其中隐含的个人属性、行为和经历难以直接转化为结构化数据。传统方法依赖预定义本体，但相关属性往往隐式存在、依赖领域且预先未知，导致提取困难。

Method: 构建一个完全自动化的迭代框架：1) 利用大语言模型诱导候选属性；2) 顺序合并语义重叠的属性；3) 分配结构类型以创建本体并从语料库填充值。该框架还支持使用较小的指令微调LLM进行值提取，以平衡准确性与成本。

Result: 在5个健康相关的Reddit社区上评估：1) 发现的属性与人工识别属性的达成率为61%（接近独立 annotators 间的62%）；2) 算法通常在10次迭代内收敛至稳定属性集；3) 结构类型分配准确率为82%；4) 值提取F1得分为0.8；5) 较小规模的指令微调模型在提升模型规模时显示出统计显著的提取性能改进，支持准确性-成本的权衡决策。

Conclusion: 通过迭代模型驱动的schema诱导，可以自动发现与人类识别相当的高质量属性，无需预定义本体。这为大规模、经济地从主题语料库中挖掘结构化数据提供了实用且可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Thematic corpora, such as social media communities, contain unstructured text describing data that could be made structured. These include, for example, personal attributes, behaviors, and experiences mentioned in social media data. Extracting structured data is challenging as relevant attributes are often implicit, domain-dependent, and unknown in advance. We propose a fully automated, iterative framework for discovering and extracting domain-specific attribute schemas without a predefined ontology. Using large language models (LLMs), the framework induces candidate attributes, sequentially consolidates semantically overlapping attributes, and assigns a structural type. These enable creating an ontology and populating it with values from the corpus. The framework also enables the use of smaller LLMs for value extraction with estimable accuracy loss compared to large LLMs. We evaluate the framework on 5 health-related Reddit communities. Discovered attributes achieved 61% agreement with human-identified attributes, close to the 62% agreement between independent annotators. In most cases, the algorithm converges to a stable attribute set in fewer than 10 iterations. Structural type assignment achieves 82% accuracy, and value extraction reaches an F1 score of 0.8 compared to human annotations. Across four LLM families, smaller instruction-tuned models show statistically significant improvements in extraction performance with model scale when evaluated against a high-capacity reference LLM, supporting informed accuracy-cost trade-offs. These results show that attributes comparable to those identified by humans can be discovered automatically, enabling the creation of high-quality structured datasets economically and at scale. By removing the need for predefined ontologies, iterative model-driven schema induction offers a practical and scalable foundation for mining thematic corpora.

</details>


### [295] [From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01553)
*Nikolai Zenovkin,Sebastian Björkqvist*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于双仿射注意力的神经解析器，将专利文本直接转换为发明图，通过局部注意力机制降低计算复杂度，实现长文档（40,000+ token）高效检索，性能超越传统规则解析方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经检索方法通常截断输入以处理长专利文档，限制了效果；而基于图的检索方法虽能保留结构化信息，但依赖脆弱且复杂的基于规则的解析器来构建发明图。

Method: 1. 设计神经解析器：借鉴依存句法分析中的双仿射注意力机制，直接从专利文本预测发明图结构。
2. 优化计算效率：引入局部双仿射注意力，将成对评分限制在滑动窗口内，使时间复杂度从 $O(n^2)$ 降至 $O(n \cdot w)$。
3. 迁移学习策略：利用共享权重特性，模型在短序列上训练即可部署于超长文档，无需重新训练。
4. 知识蒸馏：从100万份规则解析文档中蒸馏出模型参数。

Result: 1. 推理成本降低至教师模型（规则解析器）的1/3。
2. 在下游Graph Transformer检索系统中，相比基线方法：短查询场景下引用召回率提升0.5%，完整文档场景下提升1.1%。

Conclusion: 该神经解析器有效解决了专利长文档处理的计算瓶颈，以更低成本和更高性能替代了传统的规则解析方法，显著提升了基于图的专利检索效果。

Abstract: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

</details>


### [296] [AgentWebRec: Compact Evidence Fusion over the Agent Web for Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01705)
*Haoran Qiang,Guannan Liu,Liang Zhang,Junjie Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出AgentWebRec框架，解决大语言模型代理网络中的推荐问题。通过将传统“用户-平台”关系转化为“用户-代理网络-平台”路径，将推荐重构为在有限证据预算下的任务级证据获取与融合问题。该框架在保持代理记忆本地化的同时，渐进式地获取并融合分布式证据，利用平台物品语义和目标任务相关证据进行决策，并在本地证据不足时向邻居代理查询互补偏好。实验表明其性能优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于LLM的个人代理成为用户语义的持久载体，传统的“用户-平台”推荐模式演变为“用户-代理网络-平台”信息通路。然而，这种新范式面临挑战：证据分散在相互不透明的代理中，仅能通过有界查询访问；相关性证据占比小；不同代理返回的响应具有语义异构性。现有方法难以处理这种分布式、局部且异构的证据环境。

Method: 提出了AgentWebRec框架，这是一种以用户-代理为导向的方法。核心策略是将推荐重构为“任务级证据获取与融合”问题，在有限的证据预算下决定询问内容和保留内容。具体机制包括：1) 基于平台提供的物品语义和目标用户代理私有内存中的任务相关证据进行决策基础；2) 当本地证据不足时，条件性地查询相邻用户代理以获取互补的偏好模式；3) 在整个过程中保持底层代理记忆的本地化，不集中聚合数据。

Result: 在四个InstructRec数据集上的实验显示，AgentWebRec consistently（一致地）优于现有的基线推荐系统。消融实验验证了各个证据层确实带来了互补的性能增益。

Conclusion: 通过重新定义推荐为分布式环境下的证据获取与融合任务，AgentWebRec有效地解决了代理网络中证据分散、异构及隐私保护的问题，证明了在有限预算下智能地选择和处理证据能显著提升推荐效果。

Abstract: LLM-based personal agents are emerging as persistent carriers of user semantics and intermediaries between users and recommendation platforms, maintaining richer user knowledge locally. As agents interact with one another, the conventional \textit{User--Platform} relation evolves into a \textit{User--Agent Web--Platform} information pathway, enabling distributed user-side information to complement item-side information. This new pathway, however, defies conventional recommendation: evidence is scattered across mutually opaque agents and reachable only through bounded queries, only a small portion of it is relevant to the current recommendation decision, and the responses returned by different agents are semantically heterogeneous. We therefore recast recommendation over the agent web as a \emph{task-time evidence acquisition and fusion} problem under a finite evidence budget by deciding what to ask and what to keep, rather than learning from aggregated data. We propose AgentWebRec, a user-agent-oriented framework that progressively acquires and fuses distributed evidence for each user-item decision while keeping underlying agent memories local. It grounds each decision in platform-provided item semantics and task-relevant evidence from the target user agent's private memory, and conditionally queries neighboring user agents for complementary preference patterns when local evidence is insufficient. Experiments on four InstructRec datasets show that AgentWebRec consistently outperforms baseline recommenders, and ablations verify that the evidence layers contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [297] [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02057)
*Mingming Ding,Ruilin Chen,Yuzhen Huang,Hang Qi,Menglu Yu,San Tan,Damian Reeves,Boris Sarana,Kevin Tang,Satendra Gera,Gagan Jain,Sahil Shah,Vishwa Karia,Fuzail Khan,Yashasvi Makin,Edward Z. Yang,Oguz Ulgen,Jia Chen Ren,Laith Sakka,Mayank Garg,Meet Vadakkanchery,Aici Lin,Wei Sun,Mengjiao Zhou,Shuai Yang,Junqing Zhou,Max Leung,Apoorv Purwar,Musharaf Sultan,John Bocharov,Zhenyu Tang,Vivek Trehan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对大规模推荐训练集群中生命周期开销导致的有效训练时间（ETT%）低的问题，提出了一套覆盖全训练栈的优化方案。通过引入ETT%框架定位并消除初始化、编译、检查点等环节的冗余开销，使最大工作负载的ETT%提升至85%，集群整体从80%升至90%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在拥有数千块GPU的大规模推荐训练集群中，每日处理数百亿训练样本，但此前仅有50-60%的端到端墙钟时间用于实际的新数据训练，大量算力被生命周期开销（如初始化、重启、检查点恢复等）无声消耗，严重限制了加速器的利用效率。

Method: 1. 建立有效训练时间（ETT%）操作框架，用于量化丢失的时间并将其定位到独立的组件；2. 实施一系列跨层优化：包括通信消除与流水线重叠以加速初始化；动态形状处理、自动调优剪枝及复用PyTorch 2编译缓存；异步检查点机制；独立模型发布流程；以及降低恢复成本。

Result: 在代表性模型上的评估显示，所有基准测试的ETT%平均提升15.5%，最大工作负载达到85%。在实际部署后，整个集群的ETT%从约80%提升至90%以上。

Conclusion: 通过系统性地分析和优化训练生命周期的各个环节，可以显著减少无效等待时间，极大提升大规模分布式训练系统的整体效率和吞吐量。

Abstract: Lifecycle overhead silently consumes accelerator capacity across large-scale recommendation training fleets. Our largest recommendation workloads process tens of billions train- ing examples per day on thousands of GPUs. Before this work, only 50-60% of their end-to-end wall time advanced training on new data. We present a fleet-scale study of this lifecycle overhead and a set of optimizations spanning the full training stack. We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

</details>


<div id='cs.DB'></div>

# cs.DB [[Back]](#toc)

### [298] [Guarded Commits: Transactional Human Approvals for LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00037)
*Laurent Bindschaedler,Ferdi Kossmann,Chunwei Liu,Jason Mohoney*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出一种受保护提交（guarded-commit）设计，将人类审批嵌入工作流状态，通过账本记录决议和证据，并在执行外部操作前进行凭证受限的验证检查，以确保每个风险路径都经过适当审批。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型（LLM）工作流中，人类审批通常位于工作流之外，导致缺乏提交时的检查机制，无法保证所有风险路径均获得批准，且日志可能未保留审查证据或先前决策的重用条件。

Method: 构建一个受保护提交架构：在外部动作执行前，决策源将决议记录和引用的证据追加到账本；随后，凭证受限的提交适配器将记录与工件、策略版本及执行路径进行比对验证。

Result: 在合成有向无环图工作流计划上的验证测试显示，系统能接受无误计划并拒绝存在缺失门控、错误门控类型或不完整路径覆盖等故障的计划；在271,035条真实轨迹的重放中，成功复现了存在的工件哈希值。

Conclusion: 该记录支持在决议记录时的现行策略下进行审计和重放，有效解决了工作流中人类审批与执行状态脱节的问题，提升了安全性和可追溯性。

Abstract: LLM workflows often require human approval before an irreversible external action. Most systems keep that approval outside the workflow, as an interface click or an audit entry. The workflow therefore lacks a commit-time check that every risky path reached an approval gate. Its logs may not preserve the reviewed evidence or the conditions for reusing an earlier decision. We present a guarded-commit design that makes human approval part of workflow state. Before the external action runs, a decision source appends a resolution record and its referenced evidence to a ledger. A credential-confined commit adapter then checks that record against the artifact, policy version, and executed path. Our evidence is limited to trace reconstruction. A validator test on synthetic acyclic workflow plans accepts unfaulted plans and rejects plans with each injected fault: a missing gate, the wrong gate type, or incomplete path coverage. Across three public workloads totaling 271,035 traces, replay reproduces recorded artifact hashes when present. Avoided reviews and disagreement with recorded decisions vary by workload. The resulting record supports audit and replay under the policy in force when the resolution was recorded.

</details>


### [299] [BuildGraph: A Synthetic Multi-Archetype Building Knowledge Graph Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00038)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: BuildGraph 是一个包含120栋建筑的合成建筑知识图谱数据集，旨在解决真实建筑KG数据稀缺问题。它在查询可用性（91.5%）和传感器分布真实性上显著优于真实数据，并为文本到SPARQL任务提供了基准测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管语义查询对建筑运营中的AI集成至关重要，但由于专有性、安全性和成本障碍，真实的建筑知识图谱（KGs）很少公开，导致缺乏标准化的测试基准。

Method: 基于美国能源部原型模型和真实建筑的传感器放置模式，利用 Brick Schema 本体构建了120栋合成建筑KG。涵盖8种商业建筑类型和3个ASHRAE能源代码年代，每类有5个变体以模拟不同的URI命名和拓扑结构。通过75个SPARQL查询进行基准测试，并评估其与真实数据的统计相似性及在Gemma 4模型上的下游应用效果。

Result: 1. 结构完整性：BuildGraph的查询回答率为91.5%，远高于真实Brick文件的35.8%。
2. 现实合理性：传感器类型比例与真实建筑高度相关（余弦相似度0.86-0.94）。
3. 下游性能：在Gemma 4 (26B) 模型上进行文本到SPARQL实验，行匹配F1分数达到27.3%，比零样本设置提高17.5个百分点。

Conclusion: BuildGraph为设施管理者和数字孪生开发者提供了一个用于可移植分析和自然语言接口的开放测试床，其数据集、生成器和基准均已开源。

Abstract: Semantic querying of building knowledge graphs (KGs) underpins the integration of artificial intelligence into building operations, from natural-language access to cross-building analytics, but such KGs are rarely public owing to proprietary, security, and cost barriers. BuildGraph is a synthetic building KG dataset of 120 buildings in the Brick Schema ontology, grounded in U.S. Department of Energy prototype models and sensor-placement patterns from real buildings. It spans eight commercial building types across three ASHRAE energy-code vintages, with five realizations per archetype varying URI naming, sensor-attachment predicates, and topology. A 75-query SPARQL benchmark confirms structural completeness: BuildGraph reaches 91.5% Query Answerability Rate versus 35.8% for 59 real-world Brick files. Independently, it reproduces real buildings' sensor-type proportions on their shared vocabulary (cosine 0.86-0.94), evidence of realistic instrumentation where measurable. A downstream text-to-SPARQL experiment with Gemma 4 (26B) reaches 27.3% Row-Matching F1 (+17.5 pp over zero-shot) on 12 held-out buildings. BuildGraph gives facility managers and digital-twin developers a testbed for portable analytics and natural-language interfaces, and its dataset, generator, and benchmark are openly available at https://github.com/humanbuildingsynergy/BuildGraph.

</details>


### [300] [Zengram-Lite: An In-Browser Agentic-Memory Framework - Semantic Knowledge, Session Tracking, and Token-Budgeted Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00042)
*Gene Zhang*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出 zengram-lite，一个编译为单个 WebAssembly 文件的浏览器端智能体记忆框架，提供分层存储、混合检索及上下文组装功能，支持事务一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决当前浏览器端 AI 代理状态管理的不足：现有方案仅依赖向量索引和简单的 localStorage 数组，缺乏对事实置信度、来源、会话关联性及上下文管理的统一抽象。

Method: 构建基于单一 ~2.95 MB gzipped WebAssembly 组件的三层架构：1) 知识层（混合向量/全文检索，含事实生命周期管理）；2) 会话追踪层（将对话作为可查询数据建模）；3) 上下文组装层（在 Token 预算内打包提示词）。底层复用 zeta-lite SQL 引擎以提供 Postgres 兼容的事务一致性和 MVCC 隔离。

Result: 实现了一个完全在浏览器标签页中运行的轻量级记忆框架，具备事务性数据存储、复杂的事实生命周期管理、结构化的会话记录以及高效的上下文组装能力，同时通过异步结果接口兼容 JavaScript 应用。

Conclusion: zengram-lite 为浏览器端 AI 代理提供了标准化、高一致性且资源高效的本地记忆解决方案，弥补了现有技术在语义管理和结构化数据方面的缺陷。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly run in the browser, and they need somewhere to keep what they learn. The client-side state of the art, however, is a vector index - nearest-neighbor search over embeddings - with the rest of an agent's memory left to application code: the conversation history is an array in localStorage, context management is hand-rolled truncation, and there is no shared notion of a fact's confidence, its provenance, or the session that produced it. We present zengram-lite, an agentic-memory framework compiled to a single ~2.95 MB gzipped WebAssembly artifact that runs entirely in a browser tab. It provides three tiers over one transactional store. The knowledge tier offers hybrid vector-and-full-text recall with a fact lifecycle - confidence that rises and falls as facts are confirmed or contradicted, importance that decays over time, supersession that treats a restated fact as an update, and scope namespacing. The session-tracking tier models the conversation itself as first-class data: sessions, turns, typed content parts, and tool calls with state and timing, all as queryable tables. The context-assembly tier turns that structure into a token-budgeted prompt through a six-phase assembly that packs system instructions, knowledge, and recent history under a caller's budget, and returns a stable fingerprint that signals when a prompt prefix can be reused. The bundle is a superset of the zeta-lite SQL engine - the same .wasm re-exports the full Postgres-compatible surface, MVCC snapshot isolation, and copy-on-write database branching - so memory inherits transactional consistency across all three tiers. Because the wasm surface is synchronous while the framework's canonical operations depend on an asynchronous LLM and embedder, zengram-lite exposes a bring-your-own-result seam that runs the framework's real code paths over results the application computes in JavaScript.

</details>


### [301] [On Enforcing Database Constraints Using MS VBA Event Driven Procedures and SQL Server](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00633)
*Diana Christina Mancas*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出一种基于MS VBA事件驱动过程的数据库约束强制方法论及伪代码算法，确保数据质量，并验证其在SQL和NoSQL平台上的通用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在“数据库约束驱动设计与开发”框架下，为构建于MS SQL Server之上的软件应用提供强制执行数据库约束的严谨方法论，以保障数据管理的高质量。

Method: 开发一种辅助开发者的伪代码算法，结合MS VBA事件驱动过程来实施关系或非关系数据库约束；并通过家谱数据库软件应用的VBA代码示例进行实证分析。

Result: 该方法能有效强制执行所有相关约束，保证数据最高质量；算法不仅适用于其他关系型数据库管理系统，也兼容NoSQL后端平台，且适配其他类似SQL嵌入前端平台的修改量极小。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法论和算法具有高度的可移植性和有效性，能够跨多种数据库后端（包括SQL和NoSQL）实现严格的约束执行，显著降低适配成本并提升数据完整性。

Abstract: The goal of this paper is to provide a rigorous methodology for enforcing database constraints using MS VBA event-driven procedures for software applications built on top of MS SQL Server databases, in the framework of the software engineering Database Constraint-Driven Design and Development. The original contribution is a pseudo-code algorithm for assisting developers in this process. We exemplify the results of using it with some VBA code examples taken from a genealogy database software application designed and developed using this methodology. Consequently, it enforces all the database constraints -be they relational or not- which govern this sub-universe of discourse, thus guaranteeing the highest possible quality of its managed data. We also show that the proposed algorithm works fine not only for other relational database management systems, but even with NoSQL platform backends, and that the modifications needed to adapt it to other similar SQL embedding frontend platforms are minimal.

</details>


### [302] [TabJoinBench: A Benchmark for Joinable Table Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00817)
*Sandipan De,Jin Wang,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出TabJoinBench基准，解决现有连接发现方法因基准构建不统一导致的公平比较难题，涵盖语义、关系及混合数据湖场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连接发现研究依赖特定方法的基准构建，导致可复现性和公平比较困难。

Method: 通过源特定验证策略构建查询-候选对，利用组合扰动引入结构、表示和语义变化以保留可靠真值，评估基于集合、特征和学习的方法及通用语言模型嵌入基线。

Result: 构建了覆盖多场景的TabJoinBench基准，公开了处理后的数据集、真值标注及生成管线，实现了可复现的评价框架。

Conclusion: 该基准促进了连接发现方法的公平评估与未来研究的可复现性。

Abstract: Join discovery aims to identify tables from large data repositories that can augment a query table with complementary information, enabling downstream tasks such as data exploration, feature engineering, and business intelligence. Although numerous join discovery methods have been proposed, existing studies rely on method-specific benchmark construction, making reproducible and fair comparison difficult. We present TabJoinBench, a benchmark for evaluating join discovery methods across semantic, relational, and hybrid data lake scenarios. TabJoinBench constructs query-candidate pairs using source-specific validation strategies, systematically introduces structural, representation, and semantic changes through composable perturbations while preserving reliable ground truth. We evaluate representative join discovery methods spanning set-based, feature-based, and learned approaches, together with general-purpose language-model embedding baselines, and publicly release the processed datasets, ground-truth annotations, and generation pipeline to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future research.

</details>


### [303] [HakiCC: LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Design and Optimization of Concurrency Control Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00889)
*Farzad Habibi,Juncheng Fang,Faisal Nawab*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出HakiCC，一种基于LLM的多智能体流水线，自动为特定应用设计、验证并优化并发控制协议，显著提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中多数应用仅使用通用的2PL或OCC协议，因缺乏专家知识难以定制；而针对应用的专用协议能带来显著性能优势，目前存在巨大潜力未被挖掘。

Method: 构建两阶段LLM驱动多智能体流水线：第一阶段根据工作负载描述生成并迭代修复/验证协议的冲突可串行性；第二阶段通过LLM驱动的进化循环优化协议的正确性与吞吐量。

Result: 在TPC-C和AuctionMark基准上生成10个专用协议，均通过第一阶段验证；第二阶段使所有协议吞吐量平均提升50.6%（TPC-C）和92.2%（AuctionMark）。

Conclusion: HakiCC证明了利用LLM自动化设计和优化并发控制协议的可行性与高效性，能有效解决专家知识稀缺问题并大幅提升系统性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied in systems research as a tool to reduce human-intensive engineering effort through cost-efficient automation. Decades of research have produced a rich landscape of concurrency control (CC) protocols, each encoding distinct trade-offs in correctness, throughput, and abort behavior. However, most applications in practice default to 2PL or OCC, because selecting and adapting a protocol to a specific application requires expert knowledge that is rarely available to application designers. This is a wasted opportunity, as an application-specific CC protocol can yield significant performance advantages over a generic baseline, but designing one requires deep expertise in CC protocol design.
  In this paper, we propose HakiCC, an LLM-driven multi-agent pipeline that automatically designs, verifies, and optimizes concurrency control protocols tailored to a given target application. HakiCC provides a two-stage pipeline. In Stage 1, a multi-agent system takes a workload description as input and generates an application-specific CC protocol implementation, which is iteratively repaired and verified for conflict-serializability. In Stage 2, the verified protocol is further optimized for that application through an LLM-driven evolutionary loop targeting correctness and throughput. We evaluate HakiCC on TPC-C and AuctionMark as target workloads, producing and reporting ten application-specific CC protocols. All ten are conflict-serializable after Stage 1; Stage 2 improves throughput for every protocol, with average gains of +50.6% for TPC-C protocols and +92.2% for AuctionMark protocols.

</details>


### [304] [STEER: Reducing Inference Cost in Relational Foundation Models through Semantically Informed Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00907)
*Abdalla Mohamed,Ashraf Aboulnaga*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出STEER方法，通过LLM对数据库模式的外键进行相关性排序，从而缩小关系基础模型（RFMs）的推理上下文，在减少约40%上下文大小的同时保持或提升预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低关系基础模型（RFMs）的推理成本至关重要，因为推理成本随上下文大小增长。简单的随机丢弃行会忽略数据库模式的语义，导致信息丢失与噪声引入的概率相当。

Method: 提出STEER采样方法：1) 使用大语言模型（LLM）提示对数据库模式中的外键边按任务相关性进行分级排名；2) 将每个等级映射为遍历时的跟随概率；3) 仅基于模式计算排名，每任务一次，跨预测复用以分摊成本。

Result: 在RT、RT-J和Griffin三种最先进的RFMs上评估，STEER平均将推理上下文大小减少约40%，同时保持甚至提高了预测准确性。

Conclusion: STEER通过利用LLM对模式语义的理解来智能缩小上下文，有效解决了RFMs推理成本高且简单截断损害性能的问题，实现了效率与精度的平衡。

Abstract: Relational foundation models (RFMs) are pretrained once on a collection of relational databases and prediction tasks, and then applied zero-shot to previously unseen databases and tasks. To make a prediction for a target row, an RFM samples a neighborhood of rows linked to that row through foreign keys and uses this neighborhood as its inference context. Lowering inference cost is an important goal for any foundation model, and for RFMs this cost grows with the size of the context. The simplest ways to shrink the context is to drop some of the sampled rows, but this ignores the semantics of the database schema, so it is as likely to discard informative rows as uninformative ones. We propose STEER, a sampling approach that shrinks the inference context by concentrating it on the tables most relevant to the prediction task at hand. STEER obtains relevance information by prompting a large language model to rank the foreign-key edges of the database schema into relevance tiers for the given task, and then maps each tier to a probability of following that edge during traversal. Because the ranking uses only the schema, it is computed once per task and reused across all subsequent predictions, amortizing its cost. We evaluate STEER on three state-of-the-art RFMs (RT, RT-J, and Griffin) and show that it reduces inference context size by about 40% on average while maintaining, and in some cases improving, prediction accuracy.

</details>


### [305] [Bridging the Omics Divide: A Modular Relational Approach to Multi-Layer Biological Data Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01482)
*Alessandro Balestrucci,Donald Friggieri,Andrea Gariboldi,Panagiotis Alexiou*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 开发了vcf2db，一种基于样本的中心化关系型框架，用于高效检索和集成多组学数据。通过1000 Genomes Project数据验证，其在坐标和注释过滤查询中表现优异，支持通过SQL直接进行跨层多组学访问。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于文件的流程因存储碎片化和非结构化查询阻碍了跨模态分析和可重复性；现有工具在模块化多组学集成方面关注不足。

Method: 构建以生物样本为中心的关系型架构，将每种组学模式建模为可链接的独立组件；使用欧洲版1000 Genomes Project（502个样本，2500万变异）作为基准测试数据集，与三种主流VCF工具对比七项检索任务，并验证添加合成转录组层的模块扩展性。

Result: 在控制条件下，vcf2db在选择性查询中表现强劲，通常在坐标和注释过滤任务中优于其他系统，基因型提取也可用但聚合类任务效率较低；成功通过共享样本标识符无缝链接新增的合成转录组层，验证了模块扩展性。

Conclusion: vcf2db支持基于共享样本标识符的直接SQL跨层检索，实现了文件基方法难以达成的集成式多组学访问能力。

Abstract: Background: Rapid growth of high-throughput molecular data demands systems for efficient retrieval, integration, and scalability across omics layers. Traditional file-based workflows hinder cross-modal analysis and reproducibility because of fragmented storage and ad-hoc querying. Few existing tools for genomic variation data prioritize modular multi-omics integration. We developed vcf2db, a sample-centric relational framework modeling each omics modality as a distinct but linkable component centered on biological samples. This study evaluates whether this design delivers competitive genomic retrieval while enabling extension to additional molecular layers. Results: We implemented a proof-of-concept genomic schema and ingestion pipeline for annotated VCF data using the European subset of the 1000 Genomes Project (502 samples, 25 million variants). We benchmarked it against three established VCF-oriented tools on seven retrieval tasks: coordinate filtering, annotation-driven queries, genotype extraction, and aggregation. Under controlled conditions, vcf2db performed strongly on selective queries, often outperforming other systems for coordinate and annotation filters, and remained usable for genotype retrieval. Aggregation-heavy tasks were less efficient, indicating optimization targets. We also validated modular extensibility by adding a synthetic transcriptomic layer without modifying genomic tables, linking layers via shared sample identifiers. Conclusion: vcf2db supports cross-layer retrieval directly as SQL queries anchored on shared sample identifiers, enabling integrated multi-omics access that is difficult with file-based approaches.

</details>


### [306] [DIADA: Automatic Data Composition in Data Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01646)
*Marc Maynou,Albert Martin,Sergi Nadal,Anna Queralt,Oscar Romero*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出DIADA系统，通过多变量依赖关系将分散的数据湖属性组织成有意义的关联，为下游分析提供通用基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决数据湖中属性分散、手动关联困难的问题；现有基于连接性或单一目标的特征选择方法无法保证相关性或忽略其他任务所需的属性。

Method: 引入“数据组成”问题，利用多变量依赖性评估关系意义；通过将属性映射到谓词空间并构建格结构，挖掘违反独立性假设的谓词集；开发专用可扩展算法探索该空间以发现依赖关系。

Result: 提出的算法能有效探索大规模谓词空间，发现传统算法难以识别的依赖关系；生成的低噪声、统计相关属性子集提升了模式检测的置信度。

Conclusion: 数据组成过程能为多种下游任务提供有益的基础，通过确保检测到的模式基于真实关系，防止大规模环境中的常见建模问题。

Abstract: Data lakes contain a plethora of attributes scattered across many tables that, when combined, provide enhanced assets for data analysis. Nonetheless, deciding which attributes belong together in meaningful relations remains a manual, per-task effort. Merging by joinability alone provides no guarantees regarding attribute relevance, while selecting features against a single target discards attributes useful to other tasks. To address this gap, we introduce the data composition problem: organizing a fragmented, heterogeneous lake into meaningful relations, agnostic of any particular analytical task so that the resulting organization can serve as a common foundation for diverse downstream analyses. We propose DIADA, a composition system that employs multivariate dependence as the criterion for assessing the meaningfulness of a relation and approximates it by hypothesizing independence among attributes and identifying those sets that violate this hypothesis. To do so, we map the attributes to a predicate space, forming a lattice under inclusion and mining those predicate sets that exhibit dependence among their constituents. We contribute a dedicated and scalable algorithm to effectively explore this space, outscaling classical algorithms for mining relationships, thus discovering dependencies that would otherwise be impractical to identify. We demonstrate that applying a single data composition process benefits diverse potential downstream tasks. This is the result of providing a subset of low-noise, statistically relevant attributes that increases the confidence that detected patterns are grounded in real relationships, thus preventing common modeling issues in large-scale environments.

</details>


### [307] [Prune First, Decide Fast: Scalable Semantic Query Processing with JEVDB](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02046)
*Zhengle Wang,Hanxu Yan,Fuheng Zhao,Chunwei Liu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: JEVDB 是一种可扩展的语义数据库系统，通过结合快速类型决策模型和选择性 LLM 升级机制，解决了传统基于自回归 LLM 的语义查询引擎延迟高、成本高的问题。它利用 Yannakakis 风格半连接约减和语义布隆过滤器（SBF）显著降低计算开销，在保持答案质量的同时实现了低延迟和低成本的语义查询处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的语义数据库系统在扩展 SQL 以支持非结构化数据的基础模型推理时，严重依赖自回归大型语言模型（LLM）进行离散关系决策。这种方法导致了极高的推理延迟和经济成本，亟需一种更高效、可扩展的替代方案。

Method: 1. **混合决策架构**：使用快速、类型化的决策模型处理语义过滤、连接、分类和排名，仅对不确定案例选择性升级至生成式 LLM。
2. **语义-连接优化**：结合关系结构上的精确 Yannakakis 风格半连接约减与语义布隆过滤器（SBF）。SBF 利用注册的必要条件在潜在语义边上筛选候选项。
3. **索引与评分**：引入可复用的条件索引评分机制，进一步减少推理模型的升级需求。

Result: 1. **SemBench 评估**：JEVDB-Flash 在所有 21 个查询中实现了最低的延迟，并在 19 个查询中实现了最低的成本，同时保持了具有竞争力的答案质量。
2. **Shelob 评估**：在处理多达 540K 候选对的复杂连接场景下，JEVDB 完成了所有查询，平均 F1 分数达到 95.7%-97.5%。
3. **效率提升**：SBF 筛选在语义评估前移除了 87.4% 的候选对；可复用条件索引评分将推理模型升级次数减少了 55.2%。

Conclusion: JEVDB 成功证明了通过混合使用轻量级决策模型和高效的预筛选技术（如 SBF），可以在保证语义查询准确性的前提下，显著降低延迟和成本，为大规模语义数据库应用提供了可行的工程解决方案。

Abstract: Semantic database systems extend SQL with foundation-model inference over unstructured data, but current engines rely heavily on autoregressive LLMs for discrete relational decisions, creating high latency and monetary cost. We present JEVDB, a scalable semantic database system that uses fast, typed decision models for semantic filters, joins, classification, and ranking, while selectively escalating uncertain cases to generative LLMs. To reduce semantic-join work, JEVDB combines exact Yannakakis-style semijoin reduction over relational structure with Semantic Bloom Filters (SBFs), which use registered necessary conditions to screen candidates across latent semantic edges.
  We evaluate JEVDB on SemBench and Shelob, a TPC-DS-derived semantic-join workload. On SemBench, JEVDB-Flash achieves the lowest latency on all 21 evaluated queries and the lowest cost on 19, while maintaining competitive answer quality. On Shelob, where joins scale to 540K candidate pairs, JEVDB completes all queries with 95.7%-97.5% mean F1. SBF screening removes 87.4% of candidate pairs before semantic evaluation, and reusable condition-index scoring further reduces reasoning-model escalations by 55.2%. An interactive query simulator, source code, and benchmarks are available at https://jevdb.org.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [308] [Heavy-Tailed Memory Traces in Long-Horizon Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00010)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CTWM模型，通过核心-尾部结构优化长视界语言智能体的外部记忆管理，在保持精度的同时显著降低提示词Token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统评估仅关注任务成功率或Token成本，忽视了“记忆使用形态”。在有限上下文和重复检索下，智能体记忆易形成“核心-尾部”分布：少数状态被高频检索（核心），而罕见状态被遗忘于长尾中导致预测误差累积。

Method: 1. 审计分析：对比随机游走与语义LLM策略，发现记忆检索呈现对数正态或截断幂律分布特征。2. 提出核心-尾部世界模型（CTWM）：一种基于排名的内存控制器，通过单一指数参数$\tau$分配提示预算，并保留总结性的尾部信息。

Result: 在Synthetic Graph World上，CTWM保持全状态覆盖，减少5.9% Token，降低底部一半尾部预测误差13.6%；在ALFWorld和LongMemEval上实现一致的Token节省，LongMemEval上Token减少24.48%且精度持平。

Conclusion: 重尾记忆痕迹不仅是有限检索的诊断指标，也是构建Token高效智能体世界模型的实用控制信号。

Abstract: Long-horizon language agents increasingly rely on external memory as a frozen world model, yet current memory systems are usually judged only by task success or token cost. We argue that the missing object is the shape of memory use: under finite context and repeated retrieval, agent memory can concentrate on a small core while leaving rare states in a long tail where prediction errors accumulate. We study this effect through a conservative tail audit and find that concentration is reproducible but policy-dependent. Random-walk agents produce log-normal-compatible retrieval artifacts, whereas semantic LLM policies yield the strongest truncated-power-law-compatible core--tail traces. Motivated by this audit, we propose Core--Tail World Model (CTWM), a rank-based memory controller that allocates prompt budget with a single exponent $τ$ while retaining a summarized tail. On Synthetic Graph World, CTWM preserves full state and transition coverage, reduces prompt tokens by 5.9%, and lowers bottom-half tail prediction error by 13.6% relative to a graph-memory baseline. The same paired comparison gives consistent token savings on ALFWorld and a 24.48% token reduction on LongMemEval with aggregate accuracy parity. These results suggest that heavy-tailed memory traces are not only a diagnostic of finite retrieval, but also a practical control signal for token-efficient agent world models.

</details>


### [309] [When Do Causal World Models Help Modular LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00012)
*Xinyuan Song,Zekun Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FedCausalCompose框架，通过因果世界模型解决LLM智能体在模块化系统中的干预规划问题，证明因果结构在接口可识别且呈现形式合适时能显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准世界模型仅拟合观测轨迹，无法区分因果关系（如授权、中介或隐藏触发器），导致在需要干预时间的规划中产生误差。

Method: 构建FedCausalCompose因果世界模型框架，利用局部动作提供的干预-响应证据来推断跨模块接口的因果关系，并在诊断性智能体设置中进行测试。

Result: 观测世界模型在未阻断的后门路径下存在不可约的干预误差；因果接口在结构化工具环境中效果显著，但在对话/叙事环境中需依赖注意力锚点才能发挥作用。

Conclusion: 因果世界模型在LLM智能体中有效的具体条件是：跨模块接口必须统计上可识别，并以智能体在行动时可用的形式呈现。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly act through modular systems, such as order, payment, inventory, and shipment services, where actions in one module change which transitions are valid in another. Standard world models usually fit observational traces, but this is not the quantity needed for intervention-time planning: a trace may show that payment precedes shipment without identifying whether payment authorizes shipment, inventory mediates the effect, or a hidden trigger explains both. We study this gap through FedCausalCompose, a causal world-model framework for modular LLM agents in which local actions provide intervention-response evidence for cross-module interfaces. We first show that observational world models incur an irreducible interventional error under unblocked back-door paths, that interface recovery improves with intervention-response coverage, and that an oracle causal composition can beat the non-causal lower bound when coverage and local mechanism errors are controlled. We then test the resulting prediction in diagnostic agent settings. Causal interfaces help most in structured tool environments, where API signatures expose preconditions and downstream effects. In contrast, dialogue and narrative environments often ignore raw edge lists unless a short attention anchor makes the causal information decision-relevant. These results identify a concrete condition for causal world models in LLM agents: causal structure helps when cross-module interfaces are both statistically identifiable and presented in a form the agent can use at action time.

</details>


### [310] [From Proposal to Verified Effect: Praxa, an Evidence-Bound Harness for Governed AI Agent Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00015)
*Stefan G. Creadore*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文介绍了Praxa，一种通过确定性准入、代理执行等机制显式管理大语言模型智能体状态的框架。尽管提供了四项证据（包括本地审计、基准测试对比及部署证据），但结果并未证明其在安全性、效率或性能上优于基线，主要贡献在于构建了一个可测试的“证据边界”架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大语言模型智能体在提议、执行、权限、外部效果验证及服务推广等方面存在的声明与实际情况不一致的问题，旨在通过显式状态表示来增强透明度和可控性。

Method: 提出Praxa智能体 harness，采用确定性准入、代理执行、外部回读、对账和审核推广五个步骤来代表和管理智能体的不同状态。并通过四个证据通道进行评估：1. 本地代码库审计；2. Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 基准测试对比；3. 协调代理开发对比；4. 部署配置证据分析。

Result: 1. 本地审计通过所有单元测试和工作器测试，但缺乏独立复现数据。2. 基准测试中，可靠性层比基线消耗更多Token，未显示优势。3. 对比实验中，候选方案虽节省Token和成本，但未证明质量、延迟或生产行为的提升。4. 部署证据显示特定路径存在，但未带来实际生产力提升。

Conclusion: Praxa的主要贡献是提供了一种使“权威到效果”转换显式化且可测试的证据边界架构。然而，当前证据不足以证明其具备对抗性安全性、生产环境安全性、通用专家级优越性、自主递归优化能力或直接的用户效益。

Abstract: Large-language-model agents can propose and execute actions, but proposal, authority, dispatch, verified external effect, and serving promotion are different claims. We present Praxa, an agent harness that represents these states explicitly through deterministic admission, brokered execution, external read-back, reconciliation, and reviewed promotion. We report four evidence lanes. First, an author-run repository-local audit at a pinned revision passed 1,027/1,027 unit tests and 89/89 Workerd tests, instrumented all 363 expected source files, and met four coverage floors; raw per-test transcripts and independent reproduction are unavailable. Second, in a provider-backed Terminal-Bench Core 0.1.1 pilot across 12 curated tasks, baseline and reliability-layer arms each passed 17/36 strict trials. The reliability layer used 37.49% more input and 50.73% more output tokens, so the pilot does not support superiority. Third, in a post-debug, two-order coordination-proxy development comparison, baseline and a source-authored candidate each completed 180/180 trials with equal measured accuracy, full hermetic crash recovery, and zero protected violations. The candidate used 37.11% fewer tokens, 33.84% lower estimated endpoint cost, and 11.63% fewer steps; this does not establish improved quality, latency, or production behavior. Fourth, deployed source/configuration evidence shows bounded reflection, recall accounting, memory compilation, and tool-health paths, but no production outcome lift. Praxa's supported contribution is an evidence-bound architecture that makes authority-to-effect transitions explicit and testable. Current evidence does not establish adversarial security, production safety, general specialist superiority, autonomous recursive optimization, or user benefit.

</details>


### [311] [What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00018)
*Jiameng Zhang,Hongqiu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过干预诊断发现，在角色专用问答管道中，从推理器传递给验证器的“理由”对最终答案准确率提升有限，但显著影响支持度评估。腐败的理由会导致支持判断大幅偏移，且模型容易过度信任这些错误的理由，因此应将理由共享视为一种验证消息机制而非单纯提高准确率的手段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厘清在角色专用问答管道中，从推理器（reasoner）传递给验证器（verifier）的“理由”（rationale）究竟带来了什么价值：是提高了答案质量、增强了支持度评估，还是引入了新的故障面。

Method: 引入消息干预诊断方法，固定证据和候选答案，仅改变跨推理器-验证器边界的理由。使用DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器，在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA数据集上进行测试，并进行了人类审计以评估模型对腐败理由的信任程度。

Result: 1. 忠实理由对答案准确率的提升微乎其微，而腐败理由强烈改变了支持度判断（盲测下偏移10-22%，显式检查提示下34-55%）。2. 最终答案变化较小（2-30%），且仅少数支持翻转伴随答案变化。3. 人类审计显示模型存在“腐败过度信任”现象，人类拒绝或标记了9/10被模型接受的腐败理由。

Conclusion: 理由共享应被视为一种验证消息机制进行评估，而不仅仅是通向更高答案准确率的途径。其核心价值在于支持度评估而非直接的答案生成准确性。

Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits show why this matters: 16/42 valid corruptions are corruption-overtrust cases, and blind humans reject or mark unclear 9/10 audited corrupted rationales that the model accepts. Cross-model and task-boundary checks show when the channel is active, amplified, inert, or folded into the task label. Rationale sharing should be evaluated as a verification-message mechanism, not merely as a route to higher answer accuracy.

</details>


### [312] [Measuring the Microtask Eligibility Gap: When Is an Off-the-Shelf SLM Enough for an Agent Harness?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00025)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究评估了现成小型语言模型（SLMs）在LLM规划器微任务中的表现，发现存在显著的“资格差距”：所有测试配置均未达到预设阈值。量化至4-bit并未改善结果，且差距主要受模型尺寸而非精度影响。建议将SLM置于满足置信区间阈值的基线之后使用，仅在基线失败时启用SLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着智能体越来越多地利用小型语言模型（SLMs）执行围绕前沿大型语言模型（LLM）规划器的微任务（如自动批准命令、编写记忆、工具选择等），需要明确这些现成SLMs是否满足从业者定义的绩效阈值，以及量化对性能的影响。

Method: 构建了包含4个微任务的基准测试，采用固定提示词和自动指标，并设定基于廉价非LLM基线的预定义阈值τ及置信区间（CI）感知资格规则。对Qwen3系列（0.6/1.7/4/8B）在最佳设置下（FP16、贪婪解码、冻结提示、无微调）进行扫描，并使用logprob决策阈值诊断分析失败原因。同时评估了4-bit量化（RTN/GPTQ/AWQ）的影响，并在Llama-3.x系列上验证结果。

Result: 1. **资格差距显著**：16种配置中无一通过资格测试。2. **失败归因**：诊断显示失败分为能力缺陷和可通过调整解码阈值解决的问题。3. **量化无效**：4-bit量化造成的损害随模型大小而异，未使任何配置获得资格，表明差距主要由模型尺寸决定而非精度损失。4. **鲁棒性**：结果在Llama-3.x上复现，且对锚点选择和提示词变体具有鲁棒性。5. **实践改进**：例如，4B重排序器结合BM25短列表比单独使用BM25性能提升（+0.047）。

Conclusion: 现成SLMs在当前微任务中普遍无法满足严格的置信区间阈值要求，且量化无法解决此问题。实际应用中应采取混合策略：使用满足CI阈值的强基线处理大部分请求，仅当基线失败时才调用SLM进行补救或重排序，以平衡成本与性能。

Abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly want to run small language models (SLMs) on the microtasks around a frontier large language model (LLM) planner: auto-approving shell commands, writing memory, selecting tools, ranking past turns. We ask whether off-the-shelf SLMs meet practitioner-defined thresholds and, when they fail, why, and whether quantization changes the answer. We build a benchmark of 4 such microtasks with fixed prompts and automatic metrics, each with a pre-specified threshold $τ$ anchored to a cheap non-LLM baseline and a CI-aware eligibility rule (a configuration passes only if its confidence bound clears $τ$). Sweeping Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4/8B at their best (FP16, greedy, one frozen prompt, no tuning), we find an eligibility gap: 0 of 16 (4 tasks $\times$ 4 models) configurations pass (verified by checking the raw outputs and parser behavior). A logprob decision-threshold diagnostic (T1/T3/T4; T2 via a context-length/cascade probe) separates the failures into capability deficits and failures that can be addressed by changing the decoding threshold (4 regimes). Quantization to 4-bit (RTN/GPTQ/AWQ) does damage that depends on model size and moves no configuration into eligibility (certified on the reconstructable hard-label tasks T1/T3, diagnostic/windowed robustness on T2/T4), so the gap tracks model size more than precision; it replicates on Llama-3.x (12/12 ineligible) and is robust to the anchor choice (a $τ$-sweep) and to prompt wording (0/112 eligible across the original plus 3 neutral paraphrases per cell). The practical implication: place SLMs behind a baseline that meets the CI-backed threshold, and use the SLM only where the baseline fails to meet the threshold; e.g. a 4B re-ranker over a BM25 shortlist beats BM25 ($+0.047$ [0.020, 0.073], without itself certifying eligibility).

</details>


### [313] [Characterizing a Configuration Where Inference-Time PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting Is Inert: Evidence from Three Reasoning LMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00047)
*Khawaja Murad ul Hassan,Mehran Ebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究评估了PPFG（PRM修剪片段嫁接）机制，发现其在解决并行思维链多样性崩溃方面与独立基线性能相当，未能带来显著增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在解决并行思维链中的多样性崩溃问题，通过从被PRM剪枝的链中提取高得分前缀并嫁接给仍在解码的兄弟节点，以尝试提升整体推理效果。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct模型上，使用Math-Shepherd PRM和MATH500数据集，测试停滞目标和随机目标两种变体的PPFG机制；通过四桶分类法分析注入事件，并进行多模型、多基准的复现及等价性检验。

Result: PPFG在所有测量指标上与独立并行CoT基线统计无差异；仅14%的干预针对真正陷入困境的链；即使剪枝率更高，存活兄弟节点也未获得群体层面的补偿；潜在最大增益仅为+0.13个百分点。

Conclusion: 该机制在当前操作点下无效，因为多数干预未命中真正需要帮助的链条；研究提出了一种用于确立推理时机制零假设的等价性测试模板。

Abstract: Diversity collapse in parallel chain-of-thought has motivated inference-time interventions built on a natural design: when a process reward model (PRM) prunes a chain, its high-PRM prefix is extracted and grafted verbatim as an in-context demonstration into a still-decoding sibling. We isolate this mechanism, PRM-Pruned Fragment Grafting (PPFG), as the most cost-minimal operationalization of cross-trajectory step-level transfer, and test it at the operating point where prior fragment-grafting work reports gains only under additional compensating ingredients. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with Math-Shepherd on full MATH500 (n=500, three seeds), PPFG in both stagnation- and random-targeting variants is statistically indistinguishable from an independent parallel-CoT baseline on every measured axis. We characterize why: a four-bucket classification of 322 stagnation-rule injection events shows only 14% targeted a genuinely struggling chain; the rest landed on chains that had already succeeded, were near completion, or sat on a flat PRM plateau, states a rescue graft cannot change. No compound-gate refinement jointly achieves well-targeted firing and adequate density, and a random control matches the same parity at 2.4x the firing rate, so the inertness is not heuristic-specific. The finding replicates across three base LMs, six benchmarks, a second PRM, and a compatibility-gate sweep; two-one-sided-tests analysis promotes the parity to positive equivalence on all twelve Qwen/LLaMA cells. A per-event spot-check finds injected chains prune at 2.75x the matched-step rate, but a surviving-sibling counterfactual finds no population-level compensation. A hindsight oracle bounds any per-problem gain from choosing PPFG over independent at +0.13 pp. We contribute an equivalence-testing template for establishing inference-time mechanism nulls, with every claim scoped to its tested operating point.

</details>


### [314] [Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS): Reducing Representational Complexity for Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00791)
*Terry Dorsey,Kevin Huggins*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了企业表示简化（ERS）和企业表示复杂度（ERC）概念。ERC通过对象、交互、行为和支撑源四个维度量化表示复杂度，旨在降低不必要的复杂性以减轻维护负担并提升AI系统的推理准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业信息系统因应用、项目、技术及组织边界等因素积累了复杂的表示结构，这种“表示复杂性”既增加了企业的维护成本，也提高了信息消费者和AI系统解读信息的难度。需要一种方法来衡量并简化这种复杂性。

Method: 1. 定义ERC模型：提出一个与表示无关的模型，通过四个维度（表示对象、交互、行为、支撑源）及两个层级（表示层、任务层）来表征表示范围。
2. 建立经济模型：区分重复性全局表示成本、重复性任务级成本和一次性转换成本，用于评估时间跨度内的经济后果。
3. 分析AI影响：探讨任务级ERC降低对AI系统识别、关联和解释数据范围的影响，并结合Text-to-SQL研究提供实证支持。

Result: 1. ERC成功区分了架构简化与检索优化。
2. 经济模型提供了评估表示替代方案、转换效果和经济效益的可测量变量。
3. 证据表明，减少模式复杂性和推理复杂度（即降低任务级ERC）可以提高推理准确性。

Conclusion: ERC并非通用的性能或成本指标，而是一个提供可测量架构变量的工具，用于比较不同的表示替代方案、转换效果、经济结果以及AI推理性能，从而实现有效的企业表示简化。

Abstract: Enterprise information is represented through artifacts shaped by applications, projects, technologies, organizational boundaries, and local requirements. These structures accumulate over time, creating representational complexity that must be maintained by the enterprise and interpreted by information consumers and AI systems. This paper introduces Enterprise Representation Simplification (ERS) as reducing unnecessary representational complexity while preserving required information within a defined scope, and Enterprise Representation Complexity (ERC), a representation-neutral model for comparing complexity across representation states.
  ERC characterizes representational extent through four dimensions: Representation Objects, Interactions, Behaviors, and Supporting Sources. Objects, Interactions, and Behaviors form dependent categories, while Supporting Sources characterize representation exposure. ERC is defined at representation and task levels, enabling comparison and distinguishing architectural simplification from retrieval optimization.
  The paper develops two consequences of ERS. First, representational structures create lifecycle obligations for maintenance, governance, dependencies, change, enhancement, and operation. An economic model distinguishes recurring global representation cost, recurring task-level cost, and one-time transformation cost, enabling evaluation over a defined time horizon. Second, reductions in task-level ERC reduce the representational extent an AI system must identify, relate, and interpret. Text-to-SQL research provides evidence that reduced schema and reasoning complexity can improve reasoning accuracy.
  ERC is not a universal complexity, performance, or cost metric. It provides measurable architectural variables for comparing representational alternatives, transformation effects, economic outcomes, and AI reasoning performance.

</details>


### [315] [Gradient-Aligned Pair Selection for Personalized Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00061)
*Ruoming Jin,Xinyu Li,Hao Zhou,Jianfeng Zhu,Ruixin Guo,Feodor Dragan,Lei Xu,Haixun Wang,Yang Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GAP-DPO算法，通过几何对齐的偏好对选择优化大语言模型个性化，解决传统DPO因启发式采样导致的个人化效果下降问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有直接偏好优化（DPO）在个性化场景中依赖启发式标准（如似然极值）选择偏好对，导致优化与显式用户效用脱节，可能损害个性化效果。

Method: 将个性化偏好学习形式化为几何对齐优化问题，分析预期用户效用梯度与DPO更新方向的一阶交互；提出GAP-DPO算法，进行感知效用的几何对齐配对选择，并通过按轮次再生控制分布偏移。

Result: 在个性化文本生成基准测试中，GAP-DPO在风格保真度、偏好对齐和生成质量方面均优于标准DPO变体。

Conclusion: 梯度对齐是个性化偏好优化的统一原则，偏好对选择是优化几何的内生组成部分而非预处理步骤。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) requires aligning generation behavior with user-specific preferences rather than aggregate quality. While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) provides a stable framework for preference learning, its effectiveness in personalized settings critically depends on how preference pairs are selected. Existing approaches typically rely on heuristic criteria, such as likelihood-based extremes, which decouple optimization from explicit user utility and can lead to degraded personalization. We formalize personalized preference learning as a geometry-aligned optimization problem by analyzing the first-order interaction between gradients of expected user utility and DPO update directions. Our analysis reveals that, under off-policy sampling, the DPO update transitions from a purely error-corrective signal to a reinforcement-like update when preference margins are directionally aligned with utility gradients. This perspective exposes pair selection as a geometric decision that governs whether preference optimization advances or hinders personalization. Motivated by this insight, we propose GAP-DPO (Geometry-Aligned Preference DPO), an iterative algorithm that performs utility-aware, geometry-aligned pair selection while controlling distribution shift via epoch-wise regeneration. Experiments on personalized text generation benchmarks show that GAP-DPO consistently improves stylistic fidelity, preference alignment, and generation quality compared to standard DPO variants. Together, our results establish gradient alignment as a unifying principle for personalized preference optimization and demonstrate that pair selection is an intrinsic component of the optimization geometry rather than a heuristic preprocessing step.

</details>


### [316] [K-Dense BYOK: An Open-Source AI Research Assistant That Runs Locally and Keeps a Hash-Chained Lab Notebook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00074)
*Aubrey M. Brueckner,Darshil Patel,Yuhuan He,Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: K-Dense BYOK 是一款开源本地 AI 科研助手，通过提供科学脚手架、不可篡改的活页笔记本及环境日志，解决模型过度主张问题，在跨学科研究基准测试中表现优于主流托管平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对现有通用聊天机器人或代码代理在科研场景中常见的“模型过度主张”（model overclaiming）失败模式，旨在提供一种可验证、可复现且数据主权归研究者所有的科研辅助工具。

Method: 构建基于本地运行的开源系统，允许研究者使用自选模型；核心机制包括：1) 标准化科学程序库与工作流模板；2) “活页实验室笔记”记录论证过程且不可删除；3) 通过监控智能体行为而非依赖其自述来生成不可篡改的执行日志；4) 强制记录软件运行环境与复现命令。

Result: 在二十个预定义标准的跨学科研究提示词测试中，K-Dense BYOK 在科学质量和研究执行两个维度上均领先于两个主流托管平台。其交付物是唯一完整记录运行软件并提供一键复现命令的方案。

Conclusion: 通过分离观测日志与智能体写入权限，有效提升了科研结果的可检查性与可复现性，证明了本地化、高透明度架构在辅助前沿科学研究中的优越性。

Abstract: K-Dense BYOK (bring your own keys) is a free, open-source AI research assistant for scientists in any field that runs on the researcher's own computer. The researcher supplies access to a model of their choice, hosted or running locally, and the application supplies everything else: a place for the work to run, a layer of scientific scaffolding, and a complete record. Each project is an ordinary folder, so the data, the code, the results, and the record stay on a machine the researcher administers and can be read years later without the application. Three things separate it from a chat assistant or a general-purpose coding agent. It ships a library of written scientific procedures, guided workflow templates, catalogs of where research data can be found, and reviewer and writer roles the agent can hand work to. It keeps a Living Lab Notebook whose entries link into an argument and are added to but never erased. And it records what happened by watching what the agent does rather than by taking the agent's word for it, in a log the agent has no tool that can write to. That choice targets the most common failure, model overclaiming, in our earlier benchmark of nine frontier models, by making claims checkable rather than preventing them. On twenty interdisciplinary research prompts, scored under a rubric fixed in advance, K-Dense BYOK led two managed platforms on both scientific quality and research execution. Its deliverables were the only ones that recorded the software they ran in, and the only ones that usually arrived with a command that regenerates the results. One of the managed platforms ran the same frontier model and supplied neither. Those environment records were files the agent wrote, not part of the observed log, which does not yet capture the software environment itself. The code is available under the MIT license at https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/k-dense-byok.

</details>


### [317] [Scientific Agents: Evaluating Profession-Specific System Prompts on Scientific Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00084)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 专业领域特定的系统提示词不仅未能提升准确率，反而导致token消耗和成本显著增加，且在多数基准测试中表现不如简洁基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估专业领域特定的AGENTS.md配置文件（即详细的专业提示词）在科学智能体任务中的实际效用，特别是其对准确率、成本和稳定性的影响。

Method: 使用Gemini 3.8 Flash模型，通过Pi agent harness对503个专业配置文件进行评估。对比了四种控制条件：最小基线（“你是一个乐于助人的助手”）、角色首句、通用科学严谨性指南及不相关领域的配置文件。测试涵盖9个文本科学基准（4,531个问题）和60个BioMysteryBench生物信息学问题，采用自动化规则评分。

Result: 1. **准确率**：专业配置文件的平均准确率比基线低0.6个百分点，无统计显著性提升；在BioMysteryBench中，配置文件组解决率（46.7%）显著低于基线（56.7%），主要因频繁触发token和时间限制停止。2. **成本与效率**：专业配置文件产生的输出token是基线的1.5-2.3倍，单次成功调用成本高2.2-4.5倍。3. **异常优势**：在SuperGPQA基准中，由于API故障频发，较长/格式化的配置文件提示词在第一遍回答的正确率（71.6%）高于短基线（54.0%），但这归因于提示词长度或格式而非领域专业知识。

Conclusion: 对于所测试的模型和任务，默认加载完整的职业配置文件并不能提高准确率，且成本高昂。未来的研究需探索是否选择性检索配置文件片段或在开放式科学任务中会有不同结果。

Abstract: Detailed profession-specific system prompts raise token use and estimated cost per response without a consistent accuracy gain. We evaluate Scientific Agents, an open-source corpus of 503 profession-specific AGENTS.md profiles, with Gemini 3.8 Flash via OpenRouter in the Pi agent harness. We compare matched profiles with four controls: a minimal baseline ("You are a helpful assistant"), the profile's opening role sentence, a generic scientific rigor guide, and a profile from an unrelated domain. Across nine text-based science benchmarks (4,531 sampled questions, 100 matched profiles), 4,488 items completed all five conditions after API-error retries, scored with automated, rule-based grading. The average profile-baseline accuracy difference is -0.6 percentage points (95% bootstrap interval [-1.5, +0.2] across fixed tasks), and no benchmark shows a statistically clear improvement. Matched profiles produced 1.5-2.3 times as many output tokens and cost 2.2-4.5 times more per successful call. On 60 tool-using BioMysteryBench bioinformatics problems (three runs each for baseline and profile), mean solve rates were 46.7% with the profile and 56.7% at baseline, a difference of -10.0 percentage points (95% interval [-16.7, -3.3]) driven by more frequent token- and time-limit stops under the profile. Longer prompts had one unexpected operational advantage: on SuperGPQA, frequent provider API drops left the short baseline with a correct first-pass answer on only 54.0% of items, against 71.6% with the profile. Generic and mismatched prompts were about as reliable, so this gain comes from prompt length or formatting rather than domain expertise. For the tested model and tasks, loading full profession profiles by default does not improve accuracy and costs considerably more; whether selective retrieval of profile sections or open-ended scientific tasks would change this remains to be tested.

</details>


### [318] [Comedic Fool's Gold: Reward Exploits and Countermeasures in Conversational Humor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00197)
*Sam Larson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了对话幽默训练中自动化奖励机制的漏洞及对策。发现基于嵌入的“惊喜”奖励易被词语打乱攻击，而观众笑声预测模型易受通用笑声线索干扰。尽管通过归一化处理部分缓解了攻击，但训练最终未能达到预设的幽默提升目标，揭示了自动化奖励设计中平衡防作弊与保留预期行为之间的挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探索并解决在语言模型对话幽默训练中，自动化奖励机制容易被利用（reward exploits）的问题，以确保奖励信号能准确反映真正的幽默质量而非表面特征。

Method: 1. 设计两种捕捉“可理解的惊喜”和“预测观众 amusement”的奖励方法；2. 进行控制测试以检测奖励对词语打乱回复和笑声线索的敏感性；3. 引入流畅性过滤器和跨说话人归一化作为反制措施；4. 执行三轮强化学习训练，评估逐步修订奖励后的效果。

Result: 1. 基于嵌入的惊喜奖励无法区分词语打乱的无意义回复和机智回复；2. 结合流畅性过滤器后，虽能检测打乱，但也误杀部分机智回复，且未通过进一步验证；3. 观众笑声预测模型易受双方消息中的通用笑声线索干扰，归一化处理可阻断部分攻击，但未匹配的表达仍可被利用；4. 最终轮训练使综合评估分数提高0.0903，零分会话减少40%，但幽默特定改进未达到预注册目标。

Conclusion: 自动化奖励设计面临更广泛的挑战：反制措施必须在阻止可利用捷径的同时，保留奖励原本旨在鼓励的行为，目前的方法尚未完全实现这一平衡。

Abstract: We investigate automated rewards for training language models in conversational humor, focusing on reward exploits and countermeasures. Two approaches aim to capture understandable surprise and predicted audience amusement. Controlled tests show that an embedding-based surprise reward accepts word-shuffled replies as readily as witty ones. A fluency filter detects the shuffles, but the combined reward also rejects some witty replies and fails further validation. An audience model's predicted laughter is instead vulnerable to laughter cues in either speaker's messages. Normalizing these cues across speakers blocks the covered attacks, although unmatched expressions remain exploitable. Three reinforcement-learning runs evaluate training with successive reward revisions. The final run improves the combined evaluation score by 0.0903 and reduces zero-score sessions by 40%, but its humor-specific improvement remains below our preregistered target. These findings illustrate a broader challenge for automated reward design: countermeasures must block exploitable shortcuts while preserving the behavior the reward was intended to encourage.

</details>


### [319] [Neither Black nor White: Balancing Semantic and Collaborative Signals with Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01533)
*Aleksei Medvedev,Alejandro Ariza-Casabona,Steven Derby,Gonzalo Fiz Pontiveros,Xinyang Shao,Florian Spiess*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GrIS框架，将语义ID构建重构为基于图的递归聚类问题，通过结合内容信号与协同信号显著提升推荐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作将语义ID（SID）构建视为表示学习问题，作者认为这仅是表象；本质上是递归聚类问题，需同时利用节点的内容语义和边的协同信号进行分层图划分。

Method: 提出Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS)统一框架，包含两个实例：RecDMoN（基于可微分图池化的分层分配）和RQ-GAE（扩展RQ-VAE以融入图感知表示和图重建目标）。

Result: 在多个真实数据集上，GrIS一致优于协同过滤（CF）最先进的SOTA方法，Hit@10指标最高提升52%。

Conclusion: GrIS揭示了内容量化只是设计空间的一个特例，通过将图构建和分区作为独立组件，实现了更灵活、系统的性能优化。

Abstract: Existing work on Semantic IDs (SIDs) for generative recommendation treats SID construction as a representation learning problem: encode items into a quantised latent space and read off codes. We argue this view is incidental. SID construction is, at heart, a recursive clustering problem, and once stated this way the natural object to cluster is a graph whose nodes carry semantic content and whose edges carry collaborative signal; SID assignment becomes a hierarchical graph partition. This reframing yields a unified framework, Graph-Informed Semantic IDs (GrIS), that subsumes prior approaches rather than displacing them. RQ-VAE and RQ-KMeans are recovered as the special case where the graph is empty, exposing content-only quantisation as one corner of a larger design space along two so-far-collapsed axes: graph construction and recursive partition algorithm. We explore two contrasting instantiations: RecDMoN, which performs hierarchical assignment via differentiable graph pooling, and RQ-GAE, which extends RQ-VAE with graph-aware item representations and a graph reconstruction objective. On multiple real-world datasets, GrIS consistently improves over CF-aware SOTA, with gains of up to +52\% Hit@10. Because graph construction and partition are explicit, separately configurable components, improvements on either axis can be combined and evaluated systematically.

</details>


### [320] [EviGraph: Proof-Carrying Selective Recommendation over Temporal Public-Service Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00212)
*Yixi Zhou,Sikun Wang,Lei Fan,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EviGraph框架，通过区分关键决策需求与可未决信息，利用语言智能体链接时间知识图谱证据及确定性检查器验证推荐，在双语香港公共服务基准测试中减少不必要的拒绝，证明明确决策建立标准比单纯增加验证更能提升基于证据的导航可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公共服务推荐需匹配服务、范围和日期等具体证据，但将缺失细节视为决定性因素会导致有用推荐被错误 withheld（扣留/拒绝），因此需要一种机制来区分哪些信息是决策必需的，哪些可以保持未决状态。

Method: 引入EviGraph框架：1）使用语言智能体（Language Agent）将决策需求链接到时间知识图谱中的证据；2）采用确定性检查器（Deterministic Checker）确立推荐是否得到支持；3）在包含可执行政策参考的双语香港公共服务基准上进行评估。

Result: 该区分机制有效减少了不必要的推荐拒绝（abstention）。然而，额外的验证步骤虽然能撤回已支持的推荐，但并未提升决策质量。

Conclusion: 可靠的基于证据的导航依赖于明确指定“必须为决策建立什么”，而不是简单地增加更多的验证步骤。

Abstract: Public-service recommendations require evidence that matches the requested service, scope, and date. Yet treating every missing detail as decisive can withhold useful recommendations. We introduce EviGraph, which distinguishes critical decision requirements from information that can remain unresolved. A language agent links these requirements to evidence in a temporal knowledge graph, while a deterministic checker establishes whether a recommendation is supported. Evaluation on a bilingual Hong Kong public-service benchmark with executable policy references shows that this distinction reduces unnecessary abstention. Additional verification, however, can withdraw supported recommendations without improving decision quality. These findings suggest that reliable evidence-based navigation depends on specifying what must be established for a decision, rather than simply adding more verification.

</details>


### [321] [Build2SPARQL: A Large-Scale Text-to-SPARQL Benchmark Dataset for Building Knowledge Graph Querying](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00224)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Build2SPARQL基准，通过KG接地管道生成大规模自然语言/SPARQL对，解决建筑语义图谱查询数据稀缺问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑自动化系统正转向基于本体（如Brick、ASHRAE 223P）的语义知识图谱，旨在支持AI应用。然而，将自然语言转换为SPARQL查询进展受限，主要因为缺乏大规模的自然语言/SPARQL基准数据集。

Method: 构建KG接地管道：利用图遍历代码生成并验证SPARQL查询以确保正确性，由大语言模型仅负责生成对应的自然语言问题。挖掘6种查询模式家族和5种词汇寄存器，应用于201个建筑知识图谱。

Result: 生成6,136个可执行SPARQL查询和30,680个问题。人工验证显示98.8%语义保真度、98.8%自然度和84.0%操作合理性。检索增强评估使开放权重模型的精确匹配准确率从零样本的0.2-20%提升至三样本检索后的56-65%。

Conclusion: 该基准有效解决了数据稀缺瓶颈，显著提升了自然语言到SPARQL转换的性能，为建筑KG的智能查询代理提供了可靠基础。

Abstract: Building automation systems are increasingly represented as semantic knowledge graphs (KGs) using ontologies such as Brick and ASHRAE 223P, creating a machine-readable substrate for artificial-intelligence applications. One promising application is translating natural-language questions into SPARQL (text-to-SPARQL), which would let building operators query these graphs through language agents, but progress is limited by the scarcity of large natural-language/SPARQL benchmarks. This paper presents Build2SPARQL, a large-scale benchmark for building KGs generated by a KG-grounded pipeline: SPARQL queries are produced and validated entirely by graph-traversal code, while large language models generate only the natural-language questions, keeping query correctness independent of model behavior. The pipeline mines six query-pattern families -- linear chains, branching, UNION, aggregation, OPTIONAL, and attribute-filtered -- and phrases each query across five vocabulary registers. Applied to 201 building KGs (180 Brick, 21 ASHRAE 223P), it yields 6,136 executable SPARQL queries and 30,680 questions. A two-rater human validation of 300 questions found 98.8% semantic fidelity, 98.8% naturalness, and 84.0% operational plausibility. A retrieval-augmented evaluation across three open-weight language models raised exact-match accuracy from 0.2-20% (zero-shot) to 56-65% (three-shot retrieved).

</details>


### [322] [ScholarCatalyst: A Benchmark for Retrieving Papers That Inspire New Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02202)
*Sohyeon Kim,Yoonho Lee,Bo Liu,Dayoon Ko,Rulin Shao,Seungone Kim,Graham Neubig,Pang Wei Koh,Aakanksha Chowdhery,Akari Asai,Omar Khattab,Yejin Choi,Gunhee Kim,Chelsea Finn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究科学家如何从海量文献中识别对当前项目有启发的早期工作。构建了包含184位作者标注的ScholarCatalyst数据集，评估发现现有AI检索和智能体表现仅相当于随机水平（Recall@20约0.42-0.51），远不及人类专家，表明亟需新的训练方法以赋予模型“专家直觉”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管AI在开放问题上取得进展，但在感知哪些埋没在庞大档案中的先前思想对新问题至关重要方面，科学家仍远超AI。旨在量化并提升AI在科研文献中识别关键前期工作的能力。

Method: 通过自动化流程收集207篇近期计算机科学论文中184位主要作者的标注数据，构建ScholarCatalyst数据集。任务设定为：给定初始研究问题，从项目开始时可用的文献中检索出被作者标记为有关联的论文。对比了嵌入检索（Embedding Retrieval）与代理搜索（Agentic Search）的性能。

Result: 代理搜索性能未优于基础嵌入检索（Recall@20分别为0.42 vs 0.48）。即使使用可能已见过完成版论文的Claude Fable 5.1构建的智能体，召回率也仅为0.51。结果揭示了当前模型缺乏在广阔语料库中进行专家级搜索的直觉。

Conclusion: 现有AI模型在模拟科学家识别关键前期文献的能力上存在显著不足。需要开发新的训练策略来增强模型的专家直觉，以实现能辅助半成型想法并指向所需先验研究的科学智能体。

Abstract: What makes great scientists great? Even as AI systems start to make progress on open problems, scientists remain far ahead of them at sensing which prior idea, buried in an ever-growing archive of research, a new problem needs. To study this skill, we draw on researchers who know firsthand which earlier work advanced their completed projects, with papers serving as pointers to the ideas within. Using our automated pipeline that makes author annotation scalable, we build ScholarCatalyst by having 184 lead authors of 207 recent computer science papers label which candidates did or could have advanced their project, each with a detailed rationale. We introduce a retrieval task with author-provided judgments: given an initial research question, retrieve these papers from only the literature available when the project began. Agentic search does no better than embedding retrieval (0.42 vs. 0.48 Recall@20) despite calling that same retriever as a tool. Even an agent built on Claude Fable 5.1, which may have seen the completed papers during training, reaches only 0.51 R@20. These results highlight the need for new training recipes that equip models with expert intuition for searching broad corpora. We envision ScholarCatalyst as a step toward scientific agents that can take a half-formed idea and point to the prior research it needs.

</details>


### [323] [Robust Is Salient: An Informed Adversary Moves the Optimal Signal onto the Salience Pole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00233)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现，在受限信号通道中，面对知情对手时，最能保护真相的信号与最能描述真相的信号一致。当对手具备说服预算时，最优信号从贝叶斯判别转向显著性（salience）。由于这种“鲁棒性”与“显著性”在数学上重合，导致无法通过现有测量手段区分模型是真正适应了对手还是仅仅遵循了启发式规则，这构成了评估语言模型对抗鲁棒性的结构性限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在解决在存在知情对手的情况下，如何确定在受限信号通道中最佳保护真相的信号问题，并探究当前评估语言模型对抗鲁棒性方法的局限性。

Method: 引入一个基于《欺骗：香港谋杀案》抽象出的强制选择任务，模拟对手利用说服预算β进行论证；对比108个确认项和20万个项目池中的信号选择；分析不同β值下最优信号从后验最大化向边际最大化的转移；对7个语言模型进行两种对手框架下的测试。

Result: 在β增长时，最优信号从后验最大化选项转变为边际最大化选项；18.2%的项目池存在随有限预算变化的临界预算点；对手框架改变了7个语言模型在30至77个项目上的选择；但在定义明确的区域，鲁棒性与显著性完全重合，导致无法区分移动方向。

Conclusion: 这是一种结构性限制而非无结果现象。在评估对抗意识之前，必须验证鲁棒目标是否与评估项上的启发式目标重合，否则无法确定模型是否真正实现了针对对手的鲁棒性。

Abstract: When an informed adversary shares the audience of a constrained signalling channel, the signal that best protects the truth is the signal that best describes it. On 108 confirmatory items, the adversary-robust optimum aligns exactly with the salience pole from prior work. Across a 200,000-item pool, the two differ on only 2,748 items --- lying exactly where the prior salience-to-Bayes coordinate is undefined. Where defined, robustness is achieved by moving from Bayesian discrimination entirely to salience. We show this by introducing an adversary to a forced-choice task (abstracted from Deception: Murder in Hong Kong). The adversary knows the target, observes the signal, and argues for the strongest wrong answer using a persuasion budget, $β$. As $β$ grows, the optimal signal shifts from the posterior-maximizing option to the margin-maximizing one; at $β= 0$, the game reproduces the original oracle model with a listener temperature of $τ= 1$. This effect is real: 18.2 percent of the pool has an optimum that shifts under a finite budget, and each item's critical budget is exact. This coincidence structurally limits empirical evaluation. Two adversary framings change the chosen option of seven language models on 30 to 77 of 108 items against an exact no-effect rate. Yet, no measurement can determine whether this movement is toward the adversary-aware optimum or toward salience, because the two options are identical. This is a structural limit, not a null result. The diagnostic check is cheap: before evaluating adversary-awareness, verify whether the robust target coincides with a heuristic target on the evaluation items.

</details>


### [324] [Conflicting Supervision Moves Commitment, Not Capability: A 12.29σ arrangement effect that is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00234)
*Wenhui Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了学习率调度（LR schedule）是决定数据顺序对模型参数影响的关键因素。通过证明数据排列与调度策略的解耦效应，研究发现恒定学习率会放大顺序效应并导致模型偏向特定约定，而衰减调度能抑制此效应，使模型在“约定无关”指标下表现稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在相同问题但使用两种不兼容约定（conventions）的数据集上训练时，数据顺序如何写入模型参数，以及学习率调度在此过程中扮演的角色，而非将其视为背景条件。

Method: 1. 理论推导：证明了数据排列和数据调度作为分离的乘数因子进入排序效应的界限。<br>2. 实验控制：固定语料库、预算和路径，仅改变学习率调度类型（恒定 vs. Cosine衰减），测试10种不同的数据顺序。<br>3. 评估指标：对比“分配份额”（allocation share）与“约定无关”的准确性总和（acc_A + acc_B）。

Result: 1. 恒定学习率下，内部跨度大（0.2221），对比度阈值高，顺序效应显著且单调依赖于排列的块状程度。<br>2. Cosine衰减调度下，同一组数据仅占据两个可区分状态，而非预期的十个，表明顺序效应被显著抑制。<br>3. 在衰减调度家族中，跨12个臂的总准确率保持恒定（波动在9.7%以内），尽管分配份额从0.04变化到0.87，证明存在一种守恒性。<br>4. 在提示中标记约定可以消除这种切换效应，达到并集上限的87.5%。

Conclusion: “顺序重要”与“顺序不重要”是同一调节旋钮的两端。学习率调度决定了模型最终承诺遵循哪种约定。精确匹配基准无法检测到这一现象，但在约定无关的度量下，衰减调度实现了顺序效应的守恒和稳定，而恒定学习率则放大了由数据顺序引起的约定偏差。

Abstract: "Train a model on the same problems written under two incompatible conventions, both correct, and ask what the ordering of that data writes into the parameters. The learning-rate schedule is not a background condition for that question. It is the averaging operator, and it decides the answer. We prove a bound in which the arrangement and the schedule enter the ordering effect as separate multiplied factors: the arrangement only as a block period, the schedule only as how much weight the endpoint can place on any one moment of the run. A decaying schedule cannot put a large step size and an uncontracted remainder at the same moment; a constant one does exactly that at the last step. That decay moderates ordering effects has been reported in pretraining; the mechanism, the separation, and a controlled measurement of both halves are ours. Ten orderings of one corpus, one budget, everything but the path held fixed, run twice under families differing in lr_scheduler_type and nothing else: at a constant rate the interior spans 0.2221 in allocation, 11.63 contrast floors, monotone in how blocked the arrangement is. Under the single cosine every published arm uses, the same ten arms occupy two distinguishable states where their own resolution would allow about ten. "Order matters" and "order does not matter" are the two ends of one knob. What the path writes is which convention the model commits to, and no exact-match benchmark can see it. Across twelve arms acc_A+acc_B is constant to within 9.7% while the allocation share runs 0.04 to 0.87, so the 12.29-sigma arrangement switch this paper measures is exactly zero under a convention-agnostic metric. That conservation is quoted from the decayed family throughout, the constant-rate one being a noisier place to read it. Marking the convention in the prompt collapses the switch and reaches 87.5% of the union ceiling."

</details>


### [325] [Knowing When to Yield: Grounded Arbitration of User Corrections in Text-Based Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00282)
*Yezhou Cheng,Runjia Du,Zeming Liu,Hang Lyu,Zehua Yang,Bojun Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GAVA框架以解决具身智能体在面临人类纠正时的仲裁问题，通过选择性信息收集平衡准确性与交互成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨当人类的纠正可能错误时，具身代理应如何响应，旨在建立一种能够权衡接受、拒绝、检查世界或询问说话者的仲裁机制。

Method: 构建GAVA接口，结合观察有界证据、法律探针和单步期望损失规则。在ALFWorld文本环境中进行评估，采用探索性训练仅对象-位置先验，并在未见场景及非重叠检查点上进行验证。

Result: GAVA实现了100%的纠正准确性（通过完全局部检查）。相比“始终验证”基线，减少了交互成本。引入语义先验后，在340个未见场景中显著降低了交互成本（0.490）和声明联合成本（0.420），且在77个非重叠检查点上复现了增益。语义GAVA达到98.8%-98.7%的准确率，所有方法均完成任务。

Conclusion: 支持在声明成本下使用语义先验进行选择性信息收集，但未确立环境信息价值优于澄清的一般优势。研究局限在于未评估人类参与者、视觉输入或物理机器人。

Abstract: How should an embodied agent respond when a person's correction may be wrong? We formulate grounded correction arbitration as a choice among accepting, rejecting, inspecting the world, and asking the speaker. GAVA implements this interface with observation-bounded evidence, legal probes, and a one-step expected-loss rule. In text-only ALFWorld, 162 checkpoints produce 972 paired true and false interventions. Complete local inspections give GAVA and always verify 100 percent correction accuracy, establishing the evidence contract rather than a comparative advantage. In same-episode execution, GAVA reduces interaction cost against always verify but ties a cost threshold under a perfect speaker. An exploratory training-only object-location prior lowers interaction and declared joint cost on 340 unseen scenarios by 0.490 and 0.420 relative to uniform GAVA. After freezing the policy, costs, baselines, and multiplicity plan, the gains replicate on 77 non-overlapping seen checkpoints, covering 308 scenarios: 0.595 and 0.517, with both 95 percent checkpoint-bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. Joint cost also improves over an identical-prior fixed policy, while the matched calibrated no-VOI comparison remains inconclusive. Semantic GAVA makes four factual errors in each cohort, corresponding to 98.8 percent and 98.7 percent accuracy, and all methods complete every task. Results support selective information gathering with semantic priors under declared costs, but do not establish a general advantage of environmental value of information over clarification. The study uses normalized claims, complete symbolic observations, and controlled speakers; it evaluates neither human participants, visual input, nor physical robots.

</details>


### [326] [Rules to Tools: Executable Checks for LLM Agents in Scientific Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00313)
*Jingjie Ning,Guojiang Zhao,Chen Xu,Shanshan Zhong,Xiaochuan Li,Ji Zeng,Guolin Ke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究评估了“规则到工具”（R2T）方法在科学编码智能体修复程序中的有效性。通过对比使用预置可执行检查（工具组）与纯文本描述（文本组），发现预置检查在整体修复成功率上略占优势或持平，且能降低模型输出量，但公共CPU使用率上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在解决科学编码智能体在接收方程、边界条件和输出要求后，如何更有效地评估和修复代码的问题。传统方法依赖文本指令，本研究引入预置的可执行检查（Rules to Tools, R2T）以提供标准化的验证手段，提升修复的准确性和效率。

Method: 采用对照实验设计，比较两组智能体：一组使用预置的可执行检查（Tool group），另一组仅使用文本描述（Text group）。实验涵盖多个任务ID队列（Task-ID cohorts）和SciCode修复组，通过计算完整修复率（Complete repair rate）、分析特定任务表现差异以及测量代理端输出节省量和公共CPU使用情况来评估性能。

Result: 1. 总体表现：在两个任务ID队列中，完整修复率分别为文本组26/30和工具组29/30，工具组略优。
2. 任务依赖性：三个任务ID favor tools，一个 favor text，十一个平局。
3. 统计显著性：8-ID队列得分13/16 vs 15/16，差值95%置信区间为[-12.5, 43.75]个百分点，表明结果存在波动但工具组平均表现更好。
4. 成本与效率：预置检查导致31.2%的模型输出报告量降低，但公共CPU使用率在两个队列中均上升。
5. 特定任务：任务17、77、11倾向于工具组；任务37倾向于文本组。

Conclusion: 预置可执行检查（R2T）作为一种辅助手段，在科学代码修复中通常能提供比纯文本更高的修复成功率或相当的表现，并能显著减少模型输出的冗余信息。然而，其实施增加了计算资源（CPU）的消耗。该方法适用于对修复准确性要求高且能接受一定计算开销的场景，具体效果取决于任务特性。

Abstract: Scientific coding agents receive equations, boundary conditions, and output requirements in writing, then must assess the programs they revise. Rules to Tools (R2T) supplies prepared executable checks of public scientific requirements. Matched SciCode repair groups share written checks, starting programs, model, and budgets; the tool group receives a callable implementation.
